dpal 'khor lo bde mchog grub chen lū hi pa'i lugs kyi rgyu dbang gnang ba'i dbang gral du 'gro dgos pa la sngar rgyu dbang zhu ba'i gral du phyin ma myong bas/ gcen po dge slong des dbang zhu ba'i dus na sta gon gyi tshe so shing 'dor lugs la sogs pa dang*/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su me tog dor ba la sogs pa 'di ltar 'ong bas de dus rig pa bsgrims te sdod la gzhan gyis ci byed ltos zhes bslab byung bar/ gal te rang gis nor song na gzhan gyis dgod 'phyas byed kyis dogs pa'i bag tsha chen po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dbang gral du bsdad pas/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa dus gsum gzigs pa'i dbang phyug chen po de nyid kyis bdag la yang yang gzigs nas dge tshul chung ngu 'di su zhig yin gsung byung ba der dge rgan zhig gis 'di bsod nams byams pa'i nu bo yin zhes gsol pa dang*/ slar yang ring zhig gi bar du bdag la gzigs nas/ ā 'di la slob gnyer byas na yag po 'ong las che'i go zhes gsungs par/ dge rgan des 'di ni rig pa bzang zhing de sngon yang bri klog 'don gsum ci la'ang mkhas shing 'dug tshugs pa yag po yod tshul zhus song bas thugs shin tu dgyes pa mdzad cing*/ de nas brtsams te dbang gi gnas skabs su zhal rtsed dang gsung gleng phal cher bdag kho na la mdzad pa ltar byung zhing*/ sta gon gyi nub mor rmi lam brtags nas sang zhu dgos zhes gzhan gyis zer bar/ de nub rmi lam ci ma byung na bla ma la nang par ci zhu bsams kyin sems 'phros nas mtshan phyed yol tshun chad la gnyid ma byung*/ tho rengs cung zad gnyid yur ba'i rmi lam du/ rje bla mas sta gon mdzad pa'i khang pa de'i gyang logs der/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal phyag rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa glang chen gyi pags pa brgyangs pa dang bcas te 'dzin pa la/ yum sku mdog dmar po can gyis 'khyud pa dang bcas pa/

sku tshad mi phal gyi khru gang tsam yod pa shin tu gsal ba zhig mjal ba rmis/ de 'phral nas gnyid sad byung*/ phyi nyin gcen dge slong la de 'dra zhig rmis pas ci zhu dris pas/ rmi lam dngos zhu mi dgos/ ci mthong zhes bla ma byon byung ba dang sna tshogs mthong 'dra ba zhig byas na'ang chog zer ba bzhin smras/ nam mkha'i kha dog brtag dgos pa ni ma shes/ gsang mtshan btags byung ba ma brjed par gyis min pa/ rgyab dus kyang lan gcig dris byung ba dang zhu dgos zhes bslab byung*/ dbang gi tshig don gyi go rtogs ni ci yang ma byung 'dug kyang ma yengs par nyan pa dang gzhan gyis ci byed blta ba'i rig pa gtad pa'i tshul byas te dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob/ de dus rje btsun dam pa de nyid nas 'jam dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po'i bstod pa'i rig gtad cig kyang gnang nas bsod nams byams pa'i nu bo la sogs pas kyang 'di 'don na byin rlabs chen po yin gsungs nas bstod pa'i lung dang 'don thabs bcas kyi bka' drin stsal byung*/ gzhan yang rje btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos kyi nang gsel 'jam dpal nag po skyil krung can gyi rjes su gnang ba dang de'i yig cha'i lung dang bcas pa dang*/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes su gnang ba'ang gzhan gyis zhus ngor stsal ba'i chos grwal du'ang tshud/ sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes su gnang ba ngor lugs thun mong ma yin pa bkru byab bsrung gsum dang bcas pa rnams legs par nos so// de'i phyi lor yang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje btsun thugs rje'i bdag nyid can de dgon der phebs nas 'jam dpal dkar po a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dbang bskur ba ras ris la brten pa sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi sgo nas stsal/ sgrub dkyil cho ga dbang gi brjed byang bklag chog yid kyi mun sel zhes bya ba mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i lung yang legs par stsal/

dbang de'i sta gon gyi nub mor nga rang gi khang pa'i nang der bdag gi lag na rtsis kyi legs bshad bstan bcos bai ḍūr dkar po yongs rdzogs kyi glegs bam zhig bzung nas zhal phye ste blta ba'i snang ba byung ste/ de'ang bstan bcos bai ḍūr dkar pos ni phyi nang rig pa'i gnas che chung bcu ga'i rnam par bshad pa thams cad ma tshang ba med par ston pa ltar rmi lam gyi 'bras bu'ang mi ring bar rig pa'i gtsug lag gi gzhung lugs 'ga' re la sbyong bstar byed pa'i skal ba yod pa'i ltas 'dra zhig yin snyam du sems so// gzhan yang slob dpon chen po kaṅka dā'i zhabs kyis bkral ba'i rdo rje phag mo dkar mo shes rab gsal byed ma'i byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du bskur ba dang de'i sgrub thabs dang byin rlabs kyi cho ga sgrub khang dpal ldan don grub pas mdzad pa'i lung bcas stsal/ rje btsun nā ro ta pa'i lugs kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod du grags pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dang*/ de'i sgrub thabs rje dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa dang*/ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub mchod dang byin rlabs kyi bdag 'jug mtshams sbyor du bcas pa dang*/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i bstod pa yan lag bdun ldan/ glo bo mkhan chen gyis mdzad pa'i de'i bkra shis/ rig ma bcu drug gi mchod phreng dang*/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam bshad mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i gsang lam rnams kyi lung yang legs par thob bo// de bas na rje btsun bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon po 'di nyid ni yul thun mong ma yin pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la brten nas thun mong ma yin pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa dang byang sems sdom pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sdom pa dang bcas pa'i sdom pa gsum po cig car du dang por thob pa'i bka' drin bla na ma mchis pa'i bdag nyid chen po 'di ni rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid/

bdag cag gi skal bar rjes su 'tsham pa'i ngur smrig 'chang ba yongs kyi mchog tu gyur pa'i skur bstan pa ni gdon mi za ba nyid do// smras pa/ gtsug lag phyi nang yul la ches sgrin pa'i// kuṃn dgaṃ' gsar pa'i dus ston ga la bar// rgyaṃ mtshoṃ'i gos can yangs pa la brten pa'i// lus can mgrin du gnyer mchog bla ma las// mi bslu nges pa'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum// ji srid 'tsho bar skyabs kyi yul du stsal// bslab gzhi lnga dang skyabs gsum bslab byar bcas// tshangs par spyod ldan skyabs kyi 'os su bsgrubs// ming gis nye bar mtshan min de srid du// ming gzhi'i khyad par dpyod pa mi nus phyir// ming thog kuṃn du dgaṃs mdzes bsod namaṃs can// ming tshig smra ba de la tha snyad gdags// mkha' dbyings rgan las thos pa'i tshon ris kyi// shis pa'i gzugs brnyan brgya phrag bkrag tu che// 'on te thun gsum yur ba'i bden min gzugs// cir yang 'char 'di 'khrul pa kun gyi gshis// dbang phyogs chu 'dzin shing rtas legs drangs pa'i// mtshan bzang 'bar ba rgyal sku'i nyin mor byed// thun mtshams lang tsho sar pa'i kha dog dang*// lhan cig 'grogs pas mtshon min 'dren byed dpyid// rjes su srid pa'i skyon bral dgra bcom 'khor// zhi dul sgeg pa'i 'gros dal 'di mthong tshe// mkha' dbyings ngur pa'i rgyal po'i phreng lding yang*// ngal brgya'i 'dab mnyen bsgyur bas shin tu dman// 'dzam gling thub pa'i rgyal tshab kuṃn daṃga' bzang*// gang baṃstan dri med 'dziṃn pa yongs kyi phul// phyi tshul dgra bcom 'phags pa'i rnam par thar// nang du gsang chen smra ba'i rdoṃ rjeṃ 'chaṃng*// gang des thun mong min pa'i rdo rje'i theg /lugs mchog phyi nang gsang ba'i dkon mchog gsum// skyabs su bsten pa'i cho ga rnam dag gis// sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rigs su bskrun// bla ma'i byin rlabs tsam gyis sgrib pa'i dri// ma lus bkrus pa min na bskal pa brgyar// bsgrub 'os lhag pa'i lha yang skad cig gcig

/mjal ba'i ya mtshan 'di 'dra cang srid dam// zhes chos smra ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pa'i skye ba phal pa'i rkang 'thung dge sdig 'dres ma'i las kyi yal ga phan tshun 'dzings par bde sdug gi lo 'dab dus kyi rgyal mos re mos su bsgyur ba'i tshul mchid pa las/ dam pa'i chos sgor zhugs pa'i sarga ste gsum pa'o// //phyi dang nang gi shes bya'i gnas// gang dang gang la mkhas pa'i bshes// nyer bsten rig pa'i nor bu de// nam yang rang gzhan phan pa'i gzhi// gsum pa rten der brten nas thos bsam byas pa ni/ spyir dam pa'i chos sgor zhugs tsam nas blang dor gyi gnas rnams tshul bzhin du legs par 'doms pa po dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag gus par bsten nas/ bslab par 'os pa'i gzhung lugs rnams la thos bsam bsgom pa'i stobs las byung ba'i yon tan rin po che rang rgyud la bskyed pa ni legs par 'dod pa kun gyis bsgrub bya'i gtso bo nyid du nges pa ste/ sdud pa tshigs su bcad par/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la rtag tu bsten par bya// ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung*// zhes dang*/ byams pas zhus par/ gang nyan thos dang rang rgyal dang bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi rnam par grol ba dang*/ ye shes mthong ba'i phung po ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen yongs su bsten pa las byung bar rig par bya'o// byams pa gzhan yang sems can rnams kyi phan pa dang bde ba'i shas ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang rang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ste de'ang dge ba'i bshes gnyen las byung bar rig par bya'o// zhes dang*/ bshes spring du'ang*/ dge ba dge ba'i bshes la bsten nas 'phel// sdig grogs bsten pas sdig pa 'phel 'gyur bas// skyes bu dam pa bsten bgyi rgyal ba la// brten nas sems can mang pos zhi ba thob// ces bshad pa ltar legs pa thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la gnas pa des grogs mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skyes bu dam pa la brten nas thos pa'i tshogs ci rigs pa bsags pa la 'bad par bya dgos kyang*/

de la thog mar tha snyad kyi gnas las nye bar brtsams te rim gyis slob dgos pa'ang*/ ji skad du/ tha snyad la ni ma brten par// dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur// zhes 'byung bas so// 'o na de lta bu de ni blo gros dang ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kho na'i 'jug tshul yin no snyam na/ kho bo cag lta bu'i blo dman pa dag ni thos pa bsgrub pa la brtson 'grus lhag par brtsams dgos par thal/ da lta'i blo rmongs pa'ang sngon rabs ma sbyangs pa las byung ba'ang legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter las/ rig pa nang par 'chi yang bslab// tshe 'dir mkhas par ma thob kyang*// skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yi// nor la rang nyid len pa 'dra// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na sbyangs pa'i bag chags kyi mthu med par mkhas pa'i yon tan rang rdol du byung bar smra ba rnams ni rang nyid che 'dod kyi gtam du smras par zad kyang las 'bras kyi rnam dbyer rmongs pa'i rang nyid dman pa nyid du khas 'ches pa ste/ de nyid las/ ma bslabs pa la mkhas pa zhig /byung na rgyu 'bras ga la bden// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa 'di// thams cad mkhyen pa'i khyad chos yin// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ tshe 'dir shes bya'i gnas la mkhas par ma gyur kyang skye ba phyi mar sbyangs pa'i bag chags 'jog pa'i phyir dang*/ tshe 'dir mkhas pa'i go sa sgrub pa'i thabs kho na ma yin par/ mthar thug bsgrub bya'i snying po thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mngon par 'dod pas rig pa'i gnas rnams la thos bsam gyi rgyun bskyang dgos pa'ang mdo sde rgyan las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na// 'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te// de bas gzhan dag tshar gcod rjes gzung bya phyir dang*// rang nyid kun shes phyir na de la de brtson bya// zhes 'byung ngo*// des na phyi nang gi grub pa'i mtha' shes pas blang dor gyi gnas la mkhas pa dang*/

tshul khrims kyi bslab pa thob nas kha na ma tho ba las ldog pa dang*/ sems kyi bslab pa thob nas don med pa'i 'dod pa yongs su spang ba dang*/ shes rab kyi bslab pa thob nas zag zad mngon du byas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur// thos pas sdig las ldog par 'gyur// thos pas don med spang bar 'gyur// thos pas mya ngan 'das pa thob// ces dang*/ lung rnam 'byed las/ mang du thos pa la phan yon lnga ste/ phung po la mkhas pa dang*/ khams la mkhas pa dang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la mkhas pa dang*/ de'i gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa gzhan la rag ma las pa yin no// zhes dang*/ skyes rabs las kyang*/ thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron me yin// rkun po sogs kyis mi 'khyer nor gyi mchog /kun tu rmongs pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha yin// thabs tshul man ngag ston pa'i grogs kyi mchog /ces sogs rgya cher 'byung ba'i rjes su slob/ 'dun dang po ni/ thog mar sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ rang la dgos pa'i yon tan rnams// nyi ma re la tshig re zung*// grog mkhar dang ni sbrang rtsi ltar// ring por mi thogs mkhas par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa yid la gcags te/ bslab bya yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi mar gyur pa ni yi ge'i sbyor ba nyid de/ khyad par thu mi sam+bho ṭas/ bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing*// rig byed smra ba rnams kyi rgyu// ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi// yi ge'i sbyor ba bshad par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yi ge'i sdeb sbyor mtha' dag la mkhas pa ni chos thams cad kyi nges pa'i tshig mtha' yas pa rnams tshul bzhin shes pa'i sgo nas 'jug ldog tshul bzhin du bgyid dgos mod/ de ni ji skad du/ so so rig bzhi sa dgu pa// ma thob de srid chos kun gyi// nges tshig shes min de yi phyir// mtha' dag sdeb sbyor su yis shes// 'on kyang phyogs re'i brda dag kyang*// 'bad pa du mas btsal bar bya// yi ge'i sbyor ba la 'khrul na// don rnams 'khrul pa smos ci dgos// zhes bshad pa bzhin chos thams cad kyi nges tshig mtha' yas pa'i phyir brda'i sbyor ba ji snyed pa dpyad bzod pa shin tu dka' na'ang*/

las dang po pa'i bslab bya/ ming gzhi/ de la rtags gsum gyi dbye ba/ sngon 'jug rjes 'jug mi 'jug pa/ bya byed las gsum/ dus gsum gyi dbye ba rnams so sor nges par byas nas da gzod yi ge'i brda sbyor ba la 'jug dgos pa'i phyir/ de'i lag tu blang ba'i rim pa rnams 'jig rten mig gcig lo chen chos skyong bzang pos mdzad pa'i brda gsar rnying gi rnam par dbye ba za ma tog dang*/ skyogs ston gyis mdzad pa'i ngag gi sgron ma/ khyad par gangs can bod kyi brda sprod pa'i gzhung bzang po slob dpon thu mi saṃ bho ṭas mdzad pa'i sum cu pa dang*/ rtags kyi 'jug pa'i rtsa ba dang*/ de'i rnam 'grel zhwa lu lo chen gyis mdzad pa rnams la rtog dpyod 'dris par bgyis shing tshe bh+rūm̐ pa chen po'i drung nas kyang rtog dpyod bgyis/ phyi nas dbus kyi se ra nas byon pa'i rab 'byams pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba las kyang ri mor brgyab pa'i lag khrid kyang cung zad bgyis par brten/ bod skad lugs kyi brda'i dag byed che long tsam la blo ldan rnams kyi mdun sar ngo gnongs ma dgos tsam byung ngo*// gnyis pa gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i gnas bzo dang gso ba gnyis las/ dang po bzo'i gnas kyi rig pa la/ gong du smos ltar lha ris pa'i tshad kyang ri mo'i lag khrid kyi rgyun sngar nas yod pa ni/ karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje'am dbyangs can bzang po'i zhal snga nas rim par nged kyi yang mes sprul sku sangs rgyas lha'i dbang po khu dbon/ mkha' ri gdong dbon po rgya bo/ 'gru dge yag lha bzo/ de las bdag gi skyed byed ngag dbang chos 'phel bas bslabs pa ltar/ lha ris pa thun mong bar grags pa la ji ltar mnga' ba'i cha tshad kyi thig dpe rnams la goms 'dris mi dman tsam sngar nas byas yod kyang*/ cha tshad kyi rgyud gzhung rnams nas bshad pa'i tshad kyi gtan la phebs pa zhig ma byung na rang gis a pha dang a ma'i kha phor gtsang mar bzung ba tsam gyis thams cad la khyab pa med pa ltar/

rnam par dpyod ldan rnams kyi khrod du sbyangs pa'i yon tan phal cher rang nyid g.yar tsha'i rgyu las mi 'gyur bar bsams nas rtsod bral mkhas pa'i gzhung don dang 'brel ba zhig cis kyang dgos so snyam nas/ sngar smos pa'i blo ldan dge ba'i bshes su gyur pa sangs rgyas chos 'phel zhes bya ba la dogs pa'i gnas rnams 'dri brtsad dpyad pa dang bcas te/ sprul sku sman bla don grub pas mdzad pa'i sku gzugs kyi cha tshad kyi rab tu byed pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba dang*/ 'phrang kha ba dpal ldan blo gros bzang pos mdzad pa'i sku gzugs mchod rten bcas kyi cha tshad dang*/ kun mkhyen bu ston dang stag tshang lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i cha tshad kyi yi ge dang*/ kho bo'i yang mes bla ma sangs rgyas lha dbang pas mdzad pa'i skor thig gi 'grel pa sogs gang 'byor byas pa rnams dang*/ phyis su mi'i dbang phyug mkhas pa chen po sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bstan bcos bai ḍūr dkar po las 'phros pa'i drin lan g.ya' sel zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos rnams las 'byung ba'i bris 'bur gyi sku'i cha tshad lag tu blang ba'i thig 'debs ji ltar byed pa'i dper brjod bgyis pa bcas pa rnams la sgro 'dogs legs par dpyad pa na/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang 'grel chen dri med 'od dang*/ bde mchog sdom 'byung*/ gshin rje nag po'i rgyud 'grel bcas dang 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ bslab pa kun las btus pa sogs nas gsungs pa dang*/ rje btsun byams pas/ sku ni n+yā gro dha ltar chu zheng gab// ces pa'i don dang rjes su mthun par sman bla don grub pas mdzad pa'i yig cha nyid ni/ lugs 'di la rgya gzhung bzhin du 'khrul bral tshad mar khas blang dgos te gzhung der/ rgyal ba'i sku gzugs thal mo bcu pa dang*// rgyal sras rnams kyi mtho bcu zhan pa dang*// rgyal yum sogs kyi zhal tshad dgu pa dang*// rgyal dbang khros pa rnams kyi gdong brgyad pa// mi'u thung gi lus tshad mtho drug pa// zhes sogs kyi don rgyas par bshad pa'i sgo nas lag tu blang ba'i rim par bstan/

de dang mthun par sprul sku 'phrang kha ba'i yig cha'ang tshad thub tu nges pa sman bla don grub pa'i de dang mi mthun pa yod pa ma mngon yang*/ der de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi tshad kyi skabs su mchan bu zhig tu sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa 'bur gyi dbang dang brgya nyi shu pa bris kyi dbang du yin pa'i nges bzung 'dug par phyis kyi blun po gzu lum can zhig gis mchan btags pa yin nam snyam pa de la brten/ phyis byung gi mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i tshad la dus kyi 'khor lo nas bstan pa'i sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa ni 'bur gyi lugs dang*/ sdom 'byung nas bshad pa'i brgya nyi shu pa ni bris kyi dbang du byas pa yin zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par gtsang dbus khams phyogs kyi lha ris pa rnams kyi thig dpe thams cad du'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i tshad dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku'i tshad gnyis char brgya nyi shu pa kho nar byas pa rnams ni bab col gyi rjes su rgyug pa nyid du zad/ de ci'i phyir na/ sdom 'byung gi 'grel par/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i tshad la sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa 'byung ba ni lan gcig ma yin par bstan te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas kyi gzugs nyid la phyed dang bcu gnyis pa'i zhal bya'o zhes dang*/ bcu gnyis cha zhes pa ni sangs rgyas las gzhan thams cad thun mong ba nyid du gsungs pa'o zhes dang*/ de bzhin du sngon gyi mkhas pa mang pos mdzad pa'i cha tshad kyi yi ge rnams las kyang sangs rgyas kyi sku la sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa bris 'bur khyad par med pa dgos par mthun par bshad pa'i phyir lag len la'ang de ltar du 'debs pa'i khul bgyis so// thig chen gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa ni/ sdom 'byung 'grel par mtshams dang mtshams la so sor cha chung gnyis gnyis chad par 'gyur te/ des na byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa zhi pa'i lha rnams la sku'i stod dang smad dag ni cha chung phyed dang bcas pa gnyis gnyis phri ba las cha chung nyi shus lhag pa'i brgya'i tshad kyi skur 'gyur ro zhes dgongs pa'o zhes dang*/

bslab btus las/ de dang rjes su mthun par mtho bcu par bshad pa ltar dang*/ thig chen gsum pa rgyal yum yid 'phrog pa'i gzugs can rnams ni/ sdom 'byung las/ yid du 'ong ba'i rang gzugs ni// thal mo dgu pa mngon par 'dri// zhes rgyal yum sgrol ma la sogs pa ni mtho dgu par bshad pa ltar dang*/ thig chen bzhi pa sbom thung gtum drag can rnams ni/ rgyud de nyid las/ khro bo khro mo dbang phyug ma// bran pho bran mo ci bgyi ma// drag cing 'jigs pa'i gzugs rnams ni// thal mo brgyad pa rnam par 'dri// zhes khro bo gtum drag can rnams ni zhal tshad brgyad par 'dri ba dang*/ thig chen lnga pa mi'u thung ltar khros pa rnams ni/ kri yā sa muñca/ rā hu la dang*/ mi'u thung dang tshogs kyi bdag po rnams ni mtho lnga pa bya'o zhes gsungs pa ltar thig khong 'dir gur gyi mgon po dang tshogs kyi bdag po sogs mi'u thung gi tshad du bstan no// thig chen drug pa mi rnams kyi tshad ni/ dri med 'od las/ de nyid sems can rnams kyi khru bzhi ste// mi rnams ni sor dgu bcu rtsa drug go /steng dang 'og tu sor brgyad cu rtsa bzhi ste// de ltar mi rnams ni mtshan dang mi ldan pa'o zhes srid du khru phyed bzhi dang zheng du khru bzhi par bshad pa sogs gsungs pa dang*/ thig chen bdun pa sku'i rnam 'gyur rdo rje skyil krung la sogs pa bzhugs tshul gyi khyad par bshad pa rnams la go rtogs bgyi ba'i tshul bgyis nas de dag gi cha'i dbye ba'i rnam par gzhag pa de dag dang mthun par lag len du 'debs pa'i khul byas so// gsang chen rgyud sde mang po nas nye bar bstan pa'i rten gzhal yas khang ngam snying po bde ba chen po len par byed pa'am snying po rdzogs pa'i nges tshig can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cha tshad ni/ thog mar sa dkar dgon du sngar kye rdo rje'i sgrub mchod ras bris la brten pa zhig las med par/

shug ra dgon nas mkhas pa dang btsun pa dang grub pa'i yon tan du mas rgyud phyug pa'i rdo rje 'chang kun dga' dpal 'byor pas dgon der chos sbyin gnang ba'i ched du phebs byung ba'i skabs der dkyil 'khor rdul tshon la brten par bsgyur nas sgrub mchod bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga bcas nyin grangs gsar 'phar gyi gtan bzhag rten dang bcas pa gnang ba'i dus der/ shug ra dgon gyi dbu mdzad pa sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin zhes pa'ang dkyil 'khor gyi thig dang rdul tshon 'khrid pa'i slob dpon du byon 'dug par der thig tshon slob pa'i gral du kho bos kyang phyin nas gzhal yas khang gi thig 'debs lag khrid rdul tshon ri mo bcas bslab sbyangs bgyis/ 'on kyang slob dpon de nyid nas gung ru sogs kyi yig cha dang sbrags nas bslab pa zhig ni mi 'dug par/ phyis su dbang bla rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin pa nas gung rus mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi thig rtsa'i dpe cha zhig gnang byung bar rang gis zhib bltas bgyis pa'i tshe/ de'i nang du gzhal yas khang spyi'i thig rta babs snam bu bzhi pa dang gsang ba 'dus pa dang rdo rje phreng ba'i lugs kyi rta babs snam bu bcu gcig pa bcas dang*/ gzhan yang gur dang saṃ pu ṭa dang bde mchog dang gsang ba 'dus pa dang gshin rje'i gshed skor/ sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis sogs kyi phyi thig nang thig gi khyad par bcas so sor 'dug pa rnams la rtog dpyod kyis rgyud la sbyar nas lag len du bstar/ gzhal yas khang blos bslang gi cha tshad rnams kyang zhib dpyad bgyis pas rang nyid kyis bsgom pa dang gzhan la 'khrid pa dang blos bslang gsar du bskrun pa la'ang rang blo ma rmongs tsam du dpyad gzhig gi khul bgyis so// thugs rten mchod rten te spyir rten gsum gyi skabs chos kyi sku'i rten te/ de'i nges tshig ni legs par sbyar ba'i skad du tsat+yai zhes 'byung ba'i don ni/

dran pa ste chos kyi sku'i yon tan dran pa'i phyir ro// yang na bsags pa'am bsag tu rung ba ste/ yon tan gyi chos bsag tu rung bar mtshon pa'i phyir ro// de la dbye na nyan thos dang rang rgyal dang theg chen gyi mchod rten te gsum las/ nyan thos la ni chos gos bzhi ltab kyi steng du lhung bzed kha sbub pa la 'khar gsil btsugs pa lta bu dang*/ rang rgyal la ni rmang gru bzhi'i steng du ngos gru bzhi pa bang rim zlum po bang rim bcu gnyis pa 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa can no// theg chen la ni lhung bzed kha sbub pa lta bu dang khang bu lta bu dang rgyal mtshan lta bu gsum las/ dang po ni gdan pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lhung bzed kha sbub pa ltar yongs su zlum po ste/ 'dis ni chos kyi sku mtshan ma thams cad dang bral bar mtshon pa ste bim+pa zhes bya'o// gnyis pa ni khang bu ltar gru bzhi pa shin tu mdzes pa rkyang pa'am nyis brtsegs can yang rung ste/ 'dis ni chos kyi sku la yon tan rdzogs shing mnyam pa nyid mtshon pa ste da lta khang bu brtsegs pa zhes bya ba 'di nyid do// 'dul ba me tog phreng rgyud las/ de yang gnyis gsum bzhi dang lnga// 'bras bu'i rim pa gdugs kyi tshad// mchod rten byi bo yon tan can// so so'i skye bo rnams la 'os// 'di yi mthar ni ston pa yi// gdugs kyi tshad la nges pa med// brgya lhag ri rab bye ba snyed// mchod rten yang ni bya bar 'os// dman pa bse ru'i spyod pa la// gdugs kyi rim pa bcu gsum ste// de la char khebs med pa dag /bya'o zhes grags nyan thos yin// zhes dang*/ 'dul ba lung las/ chos 'khor rnams la gdugs dang*/ gdugs la char khebs zhes btags pas/ so skye'i gdugs med pa'i byi bo'o// nyan thos kyi 'bras bu'i grangs kyi gdugs/ rang rgyal gyi gdugs bdun/ sangs rgyas kyi gdugs bcu gsum/ char khebs tog dang bcas pa rnam pa thams cad par gsungs so// gsum pa ni mchod rten gyi rnam pa can te/

ston mchog thub pa'i dbang pos mdzad pa khyad par can bstan pa'i gnas su lha mi'i skye bo dad pa can rnams kyis brtsigs pa'i mchod rten brgyad la sogs pa ste/ de dag gi ngo bo dang rgyan gyi rnam dag dang bcas pa slob dpon shān+tiṃ gar+bha dang rje btsun rin po che grags pas rgya cher bshad pa rnams dang de dag gi cha'i dbye ba ston par byed pa kun mkhyen bu ston dang thar rtse brang ti pa dang*/ sprul sku 'phrang kha ba rnams kyi cha tshad kyi gzhung dang*/ dris lan bai ḍūr g.ya' sel la sogs pa las 'byung ba rnams la'ang tho yor mir 'khrul lta bu min pa'i goms 'dris bgyid pa'i khul byas so// gso ba rig pa ni/ yig klog slob pa'i slob dpon du gyur pa 'tsho byed lha mgon zhes bya ba/ tshe bh+rūm̐ chos rje karma bstan 'phel g.yu thog yon tan mgon po gnyis pa lta bu de nyid nas bslabs pa'i slob bu shin tu mkhas pa yin pas/ de'i sman rgyud rnams kyi dpe cha rnams klog 'don yang yang byas shing*/ khong gis sman gyi sdud kha nam mdzad kyi sman khug bkram bsdu byed pa'i lag bde ba byas pas sman gyi ngos 'dzin 'ga' re shes pa byung na'ang*/ dus der gzhan gyis bskul ba byed pa ma byung ba dang*/ rang gis kyang sman gyi rgyu dang dka' tshegs che ba mthong bas bslab dgos pa'i bsam blo ma skyes/ slad nas mno shes par dpyad pa na rig pa'i gnas kyi gzhung lugs che shos su go zhing*/ ji snyed shes bya kun la ma sbyangs par// thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' las ring*// zhes 'byung bas/ bslab rgyu byung na snyam pas phyi ma rgyud kyi dbu nas cung zad rtog dpyod bgyis par/ nad dang gnyen po gso ba'i thabs gsum las// gso yul nad la bzhi brgya rtsa bzhir gsungs// rgyas par phye na stong dang nyis brgya yod// mdo ru bsdus pas bcos dgos brgya rtsa gcig /gso byed gnyen po stong dang rtsa gnyis te// mdo ru bsdus pas sman dpyad zas spyod bzhi// zhes dang*/

gso thabs lag len sum brgya drug cu yod// mdor bsdus brtag thabs gso tshul bcos thabs gsum// zhes pa'i don rnams 'tsho byed pa nyams ldan 'ga' la sgro 'dogs drin lan gyi sgo nas brtsad pa dang*/ gzhan yang gso dpyad kyi gzhung pod 'ga' rer dpe bltas dang thos pa'i bag chags 'jog pa'i khul tsam dang*/ khyad par tshe bh+rūm̐ pa chen po'i slob bur gyur pa 'tsho byed karma ngag dbang legs grub ces bya ba las phyi ma rgyud kyi lung mnyan cing ngag khrid zhib pa'i sgo nas stsal ba ni/ rgyud de nyid las/ mdor bsdus brtag thabs gso tshul bcos thabs gsum// brtag thabs reg mthong gnyis kyis nad ngos bzung*// 'khrul gzhi gal 'gag bzhi yis dpyad 'phrang gsal// gso tshul dgu yis nad dang gnyen po sprad// gso thabs lag len bco brgyad nad dpung gzhom// sum cu rtsa gsum lag len snying po dril// zhes gsungs ltar reg pa rtsa dang mthong ba chu la brtag pas nad ngos bzung ba/ gso thabs la sman dang dpyad gnyis/ dang po la thang phye ril bu lde gu sman mar/ thal sman khaṇ+ḍa sman chang*/ rin chen sbyor sde/ sngo sbyor sde ste bcu/ sbyong byed la sngon 'gro'i snum 'chos dang*/ bshal skyug sna sman 'jam rtsi ni ru ha rtsa sbyang ste bdun/ dpyad la gtar ga me btsa' dugs lums byugs pa thur dpyad drug ste gnyen po bco brgyad de/ de dag gi lag tu blang ba'i tshul rnams legs par bslab pa'i tshul bgyis/ 'on kyang slob dpon gyi drung du nye bar bsnyen pa'i reg mthong gi yul la goms 'dris kyi lag khrid dang sdum sman rnams kyi ngos bzung dang sbyor sdeb rnams la sbyangs bstar ma song bas/ ji skad du sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ rig pa glegs bam nang gnas dang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar gzhan la phan 'dogs byed pa'i nyams myong ci yang ma byung ba 'di ltar lags so// khyad par sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter las/

dam pa'i yon tan sbas gyur kyang*// 'jig rten kun la khyab par gsal// sna ma'i me tog legs bkab kyang*// dri zhim kun du khyab par byed// ces gsungs pa lta bu'i yon tan 'dzad pa med pa'i gter du gyur pa tshe bh+rūm̐ dgon du karma mthu stobs pa'am 'chi med phrin las bstan 'dzin zhes bya ba rig pa'i gnas che chung kun la gzhan dring mi 'jog par mkhas par grags shing bye brag tu sgra dang snyan dngags dang sdeb sbyor rnams ni mdo khams kyi ljongs 'dir 'dren mchog chos kyi spyan ldan de nyid min pa/ gzhan gyi mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor du chud par gyur pa'i gtam tsam yang sgra 'dzin gyi dbang po'i yul na thos rgyu med pas/ yid kyi dbang po dri zhim pad+ma'i dga' tshal rjes su dran pa'i rkang drug gzhon nu bzhin du/ yid kyi brtan pa rang dbang med par phrogs par gyur nas 'di snyam du/ gang zhig mkhas pa yod bzhin du// de la yon tan mi slob na// mi de gdon gyis btab pa'am// yang na las kyis mnar ba yin// zhes gsungs pa rjes su dran pas/ 'dren mchog chos kyi spyan ldan de nyid kyi zhabs kyi mtsho skyes byin rlabs nyi ma'i 'od rdul 'bum phrag 'dzag pa gang de spyi bo'i rgyan du bsten cing*/ brda sprod pa dang snyan dngags kyi gzhung yan lag tu bcas pa bslab 'dod kyi 'dun sems dbrog tu med pa skyes nas/ bdag gi ma rgan a jo dge slong bcas la nga rang tshe bh+rūm̐ dgon par rig gnas slob tu btang dgos zhes yang yang smras/ de dag gi ngag nas rig gnas gzhan sa ris 'dra yin na 'di na'ang slob pa'i slob dpon 'dug la/ tshe bh+rūm̐ par de sngon yon mchod kyi 'brel 'grim tsam yang med pas zhu 'bul dka' zhing*/ gal te zhus nas bdag rkyen gnang ba zhig byung song na'ang*/ de sngon gzhan dag kyang de 'dra yod pa ma shes pa ma yin mod/ su yang slob mkhan dang lobs pa 'ga' yang byung ba mi 'dug pas/

bslabs kyang shes thub pa dka' ba zhig ni gor ma chag pas cis kyang bshol ba legs tshul gyi gleng brjod mang du byed kyin mchis mod/ legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter las/ blun po slob pa ngo tshar 'dzin// mkhas rnams ma bslabs ngo tshar 'dzin// zhes gsungs pa ltar gal te ma lobs kyang ngo tsha ba la 'dzem rgyu ci yod snyam nas/ bdag gis smras pa/ lobs dang ma lobs ji ltar gyur kyang der mngags pa shin tu legs/ gal te der mi mngags na dbus gtsang gi phyogs la sogs par/ de dag slob shes gang 'byor byed kyin btsal 'gro ba min pa 'dug bsam med ces nan gyis gleng bas/ mi ring bar sngon gyi las 'phro bzang pos pho nyas mgron du gnyer bar byas pa bzhin du dgon der bla ma kun dga' chos 'byung zhes bya sku tshe'i dus byas pa'i dgongs rdzogs su tshe bh+rūm̐ chos rje mkhas dang btsun pa'i dbang phyug de nyid spyan 'dren zhus nas byon byung ba na 'di snyam du/ da lam bdag gis bsam don gyi snying po 'grub par 'gyur ba gdon mi za snyam nas/ nan tan gyis der btang ba'i stong grogs dgos tshul gleng bas/ de ltar bgyi'o zhes bla ma dpon g.yog rnams rang gi bsti gnas su spyan 'dren zhus pa'i thog nged kyi a jo dge slong des nged kyi ban+de 'di rig gnas slob 'dun bzlog tu med pa 'dug pas tshe bh+rūm̐ du 'dren mchog dam pa'i zhabs drung du re zhig sgra dang snyan dngags bslab pa'i phyir 'dug chog par thugs rjes 'dzin pa'i bdag rkyen ci gnang ngam zhes gsol ba btab song bas/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun mthu stobs pa de nyid ni/ phyi dang nang gi rig pa'i gnas lnga dang*/ de'i yan lag tu bcas pa ste/ de'ang ji skad du sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ de yul brda sprod rtog ge dang*// gso ba phyi nang rig ces bya// gzhan las gzhan dag rnam bshad pa// 'di yi nang du 'dus zhes bshad// ces gsungs pa'i don brda sprod pa sgra dang*/

rtog ge tshad ma dang*/ gso ba rig pa sman dpyad dang*/ phyi rol rig pa bzo dang*/ nang rig pa lung gi chos shes pa ste/ lnga po de'i nang du gzhan nas bshad pa'i rig pa'i gnas rnams kyang de'i 'khor gyi tshul du 'dus so zhes pa ste/ ji ltar 'dus snyam na/ sgra zhes na don la mi rmongs zhes pa rjod byed kun gyi gzhi mar bzung nas/ de'i yan lag tu 'dur rung ba/ snyan dngags shes na tshig rgyan la mi rmongs/ sdeb sbyor shes na tshigs bcad la mi rmongs/ mngon brjod shes na ming la mi rmongs/ zlos gar shes na skad rigs la mi rmongs zhes pa'i gzhung rnams kyang sgra rig pa'i yan lag gam 'khor gyi tshul du 'du zhes pa'i don du snang ba'i phyir dang*/ der ma zad rtog ge la sogs pa gzhan bzhi po'i khongs su'ang rig gnas gzhan mang po dag 'dus so zhes pa'i don du snang ba'i phyir/ phyis su mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis ni gong du smos pa lnga po la rig gnas che ba lnga zhes dang*/ phyi ma bzhi'i steng du skar rtsis 'dren pa'i rig gnas chung ba lnga zhes pa'i tha snyad kyang mdzad do// de lta bu'i nang gsel gyi dbye ba dang bcas pa'i rig pa'i gnas mang po mkhyen pa'i bdag nyid du bzhugs mod kyang*/ thugs rgyud la khengs pa dang nga rgyal gyi rnam pa ci yang mi mnga' bar/ tshe rabs kyi phreng bar brtse ba dang byang chub sems la sbyangs stobs mi dman par goms pa'i dbang gis/ ring nas 'grogs pa'i mdza' bshes dang phrad pa ltar/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor zla ba rgyas pa lta bu'i 'dzum zer gyis bsu bzhin pa las 'di skad du stsal pa thos te/ legs so// de ltar mos 'dun che ba las bzang gi bag chags yod pa zhig yin las che bas/ gal te lobs par gyur na deng dus shin tu dkon pa'i rig pa'i gnas kyi rgyun mi nub par 'gyur ba sogs gang ci nas phan yon che ba'i tshul dang bcas/ sngon du sgra mdo dang ka lā pa byā ka ra ṇa bslabs na de'i shugs kyis dbyangs can byā ka ra ṇa shes sla bar 'gyur ba sogs thugs dgyes pa'i gsung snyan gyis mdun bstsu bas/

sngon du blo 'dzin rgyur ka lā pa byā ka ra ṇa'i mdo bskur 'ongs pa blor zin par gyis dang*/ slar nged cag sgar pa'i brel ba chod nas gnas khang du sdod pa'i skabs shig nas ngag gsal btang byung ba dang shog ces gsung snyan dpal ldan dbyangs kyi/ rgyal mo'i longs spyod kyi 'khor lo las nye bar 'phos pa'i legs par bshad pa'i glu dbyangs kyi spun zlar gyur pa'i dbugs dbyung dang bcas te bka'i gnang ba stsal/ gang gi tshe bdag gi yid la da ni bsam don gyi snying po mi ring par 'grub par 'gyur ro snyam pa'i dga' ba skyes pa ni/ rgyal ba'i sras rnams rab tu dga' ba'i sa la reg pa rnams kyi rgyud du'ang 'di las lhag pa'i dga' ba ci zhig yod snyam pa'i spro ba skyes/ gnam lo de'i ston mjug tsam nas ka lā pa'i mdo yang g.yar po stsal byung bar/ nyin mor sdum tshang gi bsam blor mthun pa'i lha ris 'dri dgos rnams la rtun pa bskyed dgos pa dang*/ nang nub tu blo 'dzin byed pa'i khul byas pas sgra dpe blo len dka' ba'i rgyus kun bshad kyi rkang pa dang po yan tsam song*/ de mtshams nas 'dren mchog dam pa nyid kyi zhabs kyi pad+mor bcar du deng skabs 'ong chog pa'i bka' gsung gi 'phrin yig phyag bris dngos ma snyan 'gyur gyi yan lag rdzogs pa gtsug tu stsal byung bar/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i bgrang gzhi'i gnam 'phyang zhes pa sa khyi gsar tshes kyi hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes grangs dge bar 'gru tshe bh+rūm̐ dgon zhes bya ba sngon dus spyan snga rnam pa gsum sogs grub dbang gong ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgrub gnas de'i gnas tshul mdun rgyab dang khor yug nas gangs ri dang brag ri dang nags tshal stug pos sgeg pa'i ri bo'i phreng ba/ dbyibs legs pa bkra shis pa'i mtshan ris can rnams kyis khor yug kun du mdzangs ldan skyes bu mang po mdun gros la 'khod pa lta bus mdzes par byas pa'i nang*/

sa gzhi rgya khyon ha cang che ba'ang min par phyogs 'ga' zhig tu ni dbyar skyes rkang thung gi phreng ba dang nags kyi tshang tshing 'khrigs par lo 'dab gos bzang gi lhab lhub lta bus bklubs pa'i khrod nas 'dab chags sna tshogs skad kyi 'gyur ba tha dad par bsgyur bas yid dga' bar byed pa/ skabs 'gar rtswa ljang gi myu gu dang lo 'dab gsar pas khyab par bkram pa'i dga' tshal dang spang ljang me tog gi tshom bu lta bus mdzes pa'i khrod nas/ dag byed rgyun gtsang mu tig gi do shal dpyangs pa ltar gya gyur 'bab pa'i chab sgra snyan par 'byin pa/ de'i nang gi byang ngos nas lhor bltas su gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten khang dang sgrub khang dang khang pa dang khang phran gyi phreng ba tshar du dngar ba dag la pu shu dang*/ lan kan skar khung dang*/ sgo dang sgo khang dang yol ba sogs kyis mdzes par spras pa de dag gi steng nas tog dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang rnga yab kyis mdzes par byas pa'i dben gnas de nyid du slebs/ lnga rig bstan pa'i snang byed chen po 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po de nyid ni lhag pa'i lha sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen mtshams kyi bcad rgya dam por mdzad de bzhugs mod kyis/ cung zad cig nas nye bar gnas pa btang byung ba'i ngag las thun mtshams su nas mjal kha 'ong tshul gyi gleng ba dang bcas byung ba de dang mnyam du bsdongs nas lha dar dkar po dri bral gyis thog drangs pa'i mjal dar mtshon byed rnams phul te zhal mjal thob/ 'dren mchog dam pa de nyid snying rje chen po dang byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gtsang mas yongs su bkrus pa snyam byed pa'i zhal bzang kun phan gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor las/ kun nas dgyes pa'i 'dzum zer dkar pos g.yar lam nas nye bar bsu bzhin pas/ legs gsungs dbyangs kyi yan lag rdzogs pa'i rgyud las 'phos pa'i bka'i 'dri ba nyung shas stsal ba rnams kyi lan phul/

de nyin gza' tshes sbyor 'phrod kyang legs par bsgrigs 'dug pa bcas thog mar brda sprod kyi gzhung rgyas par lha yul du dar ba'i tshul dang*/ de nas mi yul du ji ltar byung ba khyad par byā ka ra ṇa ka lā pa dang*/ byā ka ra ṇa tsan+d+ra pa'i sngon byung gi lo rgyus rnams sgra'i spyi bshad rnams nas 'byung ba ltar legs par gsungs nas/ 'jig rten mig gyur chos skyong bzang pos mdzad pa'i cha bsags kyi mdo'i 'grel pa bshad sbyar la/ slar yang karma pa mi bskyod rdo rjes rgyas 'grel mdzad pa'i ka ra ṭīka zhes bya ba'i steng nas mtshams sbyor gyi ri mo 'dri ba'i dbu brtsams/ de nas bzung ste zla ba gcig lhag tsam gyi bar la rtsol ba bskyed cing bris pas ming gi le'u drug dang kun bshad kyi rkang pa dang po yan gyi ri mo rdzogs pa byung*/ de mtshams 'dren mchog chos kyi spyan ras yangs pa nyid zur mang phyogs nas gdan 'dren zhus byung bar 'phral du phebs dgos byung song bar tshes zhag nyi shu lhag tsam 'gor byung ba de bar du sngar gyi bslabs zin rnams la sbyang bstar byas/ de nas tshur phebs byung ba dang zhag shas la bris pas kṛta kyi rkang pa gsum pa yan gyi ri mo grub/ der sdod skabs rnams su tshe bh+rūm̐ dgon gyi bla ma grwa rigs thams cad nas kyang kho bor bza' btung bsnyen bkur gyi rim pa dang mnyes gshin byams brtses legs par bskyangs pa'i sku drin ni gsob par mi nus par che ba byung*/ bdag gis sngar nas sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i mngon brjod tshig gter blo 'dzin byas nas/ de'i 'grel pa blo brtan bzhi pas mdzad pa sogs dang brda gsar rnying gi tshig rnams la yid 'jags goms 'dris cung zad byas yod pa'i stabs kyis rje btsun dam pa de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams mjal ba la'ang skabs 'ga' re nas min pa phal cher go ba rnyed pa rnams la khyod kyis tshigs bcad rnams go bar 'dug ces thugs dgyes shin tu che ba mdzad cing*/

de mtshams nas 'dren mchog dam pa nyid sgar 'gros su bteg pa'i grabs sgrig mdzad/ kho bor re zhig rang yul du bzhud de sngar lobs pa rnams la 'dris par sbyang dgos pa'i bslab bya gdams/ skabs der sngar nas klog 'dri cung zad shes kyang smyug 'gros dang khams tshad kyi gtan 'bebs la ma nges pas lāñcan ste/ de'ang spyir yi ge'i rigs la/ ji skad du/ mi 'gyur ba dang gsal byed dang*// rjod par byed pa'i nus ldan phyir// yi ge zhes ni brjod pa yin// zhes pa'i don yi ge la legs sbyar gyi skad du a k+ṣa ra zhes pa mi 'gyur ba zhes par 'gyur te/ yul gyi khyad par gyi skad tha dad du gyur pa yod kyang dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge ni gzhan du 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir/ yang na war+ṇaṇa zhes nus pa dang ldan pa ste/ brjod bya thams cad so sor ston nus pa'i phyir/ yang na byañja na zhes gsal bar byed pa ste/ brjod bya thams cad yi ger 'dus pas gsal bar byed phyir yi ge'i rigs mdo rgya cher rol pa las drug cu rtsa bzhi bshad kyang bod 'dir mkho bar tshangs pa'i yi ge lāñca na khong gsing dang sha chen gnyis wartu la'i yi ge dang dha ri ka dang nā ga ra la sogs pa'i yi ge'i rigs 'ga' zhig 'dri ba'i phyag khrid stsal ba'ang sbyang tshul byas/ sgar 'gros chibs bsgyur gnang ba'i nyin der gza' skar bzang po 'dzom pa dang bstun/ dpal ldan daṇ+ḍī'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i snyan dngags kyi gzhung me long zhes bya ba'i steng nas don rgyan sum cu rtsa lnga'i dbu nas rgyan gyi 'gro yul nyung shas kyi zhal khrid kyang legs par stsal/ rin spungs sa spyod dbang pos mdzad pa'i mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos sogs yig cha gang dgos rnams kyang g.yar po stsal ba rnams la dpe bltas byas/ sgar 'gros nas 'khor nas tshur phebs pa thos pa dang slar yang zhabs kyi chu skyes bsnyen pa'i skabs dbye ba dang chab cig tu/

brda sprod kyi gzhung la sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu rnam par dbye ba'i 'gro yul gyi go bab cung zad shar ba rnams rje sa skya pa chen po'i bstod pa tshangs dbang gtsug gi nor bus legs mchod can dang*/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i bstod pa dkon mchog gsum dngos yongs 'dzin mgon can gnyis la skad gnyis shan sbyar ba zhig kṛta rkyen las byung ba'i ming rtags 'ga' rer/ ming gi le'u'i skabs kyi rnam dbyes mtshams sbyar gang shes byas nas legs sbyar gyi skad du bsgyur nas sdeb sbyor gyis bcings pa med pa re bris nas rnam dbye sogs kyi 'gro yul 'di ltar byas na rung ngam zhes spyan ras kyi gzigs par phul bas/ mkhas mchog byang chub sems dpa' chen po de nyid kyi thugs ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyi dbal thob pa las kyang shin tu dgyes pa'i rnam pa mdzad pa zhig byung song*/ de skabs rje btsun dam pa de nyid sgar 'gros kyi phrin las la gzhol ba'i sta gon gyis thugs brel shin tu che skabs su 'dug kyang*/ bar skabs rnams nas bdag la grub pa'i slob dpon chen po rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas kyi ri mo prāstā ras 'ching ba'i tshul ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyi ri mo 'god tshul dang bcas pa phyag khrid zhib par stsal ba bslab sbyangs byas nas der zhag grangs nyung tsam bsdad/ slad char phyogs nas tshur 'khor ba dang sngar gyi 'phro bsdongs rnams byed par 'ong chog pa'i bka'i gnang ba stsal/ phyogs gzhan nas dbang lung don gnyer du byon pa'i bla ma dge slong rnams kyi ngor gnang ba'i sgrol dkar spyan ras gzigs thub pa rdo rje gdan pa phyag na rdo rje rta mgrin sogs kyi dbang bka' rjes gnang gi rigs mang du stsal ba rnams kyang thob/ lo de'i phyi lor 'dren mchog thugs rje mtshungs pa med pa de nyid tshe bh+rūm̐ pa'i gdan sar phebs yod pa'i bka' lung gi 'phrin yig son 'phral nas der phyin te/

sngar sgra mdo'i kṛta kyi ri mo'i 'phro lus rnams bslab pa dang*/ snyan dngags me long gzhung 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs sogs kyi steng nas ljags khrid gnang ste rtsom rgyug 'bul ba dang bcas sbyang ba'i khul bgyis pa na/ mkhas mchog byang chub sems dpa' chen po de nyid nas skabs 'gar khyod kyis rig gnas bstan pa'i rgyun la phan 'dogs bzang po 'ong ba 'dug ces thugs dgyes pa'i tshul dpag tu med pa mdzad kyin 'dug gtsug lag rgya mtsho smra ba'i dbang phyug de nyid kho bo slob gsar zhig la de bzhin dgyes don ga la srid kyang*/ mnal bltas legs pa'am ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i me long gi ngos su shar ba'i dge mtshan zhig yin las che snyam/ de skabs su lnga rig smra ba'i dbang phyug si tu sprul pa'i sku rin po che nyid dran thang sogs su phebs pa'i zhor la tshe bh+rūm̐ du gdan 'dren zhus nas phebs byung ba rang gi slob dpon la sogs pa mang pos kyang 'di nyid ni rig pa'i gnas thams cad la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhas pa chen po yin zhes thos pas dga' zhing dad pa skyes/ der zhag bdun tsam bzhugs nas lha mo 'od zer can ma sogs kyi rjes gnang gsum tsam mdzad song ba'ang thob bo// de nas mi ring bar sku drin rmad byung gi slob dpon de nyid tshe bh+rūm̐ pa'i gdan sa'i chos kyi khri la bzhugs tshun chad du byung ba'i dngos rdzas phal che ba rnams kyis rgyal dbang karma pa zhwa dmar nag sogs kyi zhal mjal dang 'bul skyes stobs pa dang*/ yul dbus gyur 'chang gi chos grwa chen po rnams su mang ja mchod 'bul gyi ched du dgongs pa gtad nas grwa 'khor mang tsam bcas te bteg nas byon song ba/ lam bar kun du nye zhos dben par bde bar phebs pa dang*/ de skabs rgyang mgar gyi sog po rnams kyi rgyu 'grul che ba'i skabs yin na'ang nyer 'tshe ci yang ma byung bar bzhed don thams cad legs par grub nas lo ngo tsam gyi nang nas gegs bral du lam yig ngo mtshar can phyag bris kyi legs bshad gsar pa'i skyes dang chabs cig phebs byung*/

phyi lo der rgyal ba dgyes pa'i phrin las shin tu rgyas par 'tsho gzhes su bzhugs pa'i ring nas bstan pa'i gegs chag bdo ba'i shugs kyis snyung gzhi bab lci ba zhig byung bar zhabs brtan gyi rim pa mang pos kyang ma bzlog par 'jam dpal gzhon nu ngur smrig 'chang gi rnam par rtsen pa de nyid tshur rol mthong ba'i skye bo'i 'dren byed kyi yul las rnam par bsgal te dge legs mtshan bzang gis sgeg pa'i gzugs kyi sku'i spros pa zab mo chos kyi dbyings su brtul te mya ngan 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pas bdag sogs ltos bcas kyi gdul bya rnams kyi ma rig pa dang the tshom gyi mun pa mtha' dag drungs nas 'byin par byed pa'i sku drin zla bral snang ba'i sgron ma lta bu de nyid dang bral ba'i mya ngan khri mun du chud pa ltar skal ba dman pa nyid du sbyar ro// lo der shug rwa dgon nas mdo sngags rgya mtshos nges par bstan pa'i lam mchog kun la thos bsam bsgom stobs mi dman pas thugs rgyud legs par sbyangs shing*/ khyad par gsang chen bstan pa'i yang snying zab mo'i rnal 'byor la brten nas sngags kyi dngos grub brnyes pa bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje dang gnyis su med pa'i 'dren mchog kun dga' dpal 'byor pas sa dkar du phebs nas/ dgon der rnam par rgyal ma'i stong mchod gsar 'dzugs zhag bdun mdzad nas/ bskal pa nam gnas bar du lo re bzhin gso sbyong len pa dang bcas pa'i sgrub mchod btang ba'i spyi pa bskos te/ de'i gtan gzhag rgyas pa gnang nas bstan pa'i srol btsugs pa'i skabs der 'dren mchog dam pa de nyid kyis grwa tshogs sbyin bdag thams cad la kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ rnam par rgyal ma'i rjes gnang sogs chos sbyin rgya cher stsal ba dang gzhi bsnyen sdod mkhan 'ga' rer dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa bsnyen dus kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal ba rnams kyang bdag la thugs dgyes pa'i ngang nas legs par stsal ba sogs chos thob pa'i bla ma sku drin che shos yin/

kho bos sngar rang gi yi ge 'dri ba slob pa'i slob dpon dang lha ris sogs kyi dwogs dpyod 'dri yul slob dpon sangs rgyas chos 'phel zhes bya ba des/ 'dren mchog dam pa shug rwa ba 'di nyid la khyod kyis sku bstod gsol 'debs sh+lau ka gsum yod pa zhig rtsoms shig ces bskul ba ltar/ legs byas kun nas bsags pa'i chu gter las zhes yod pa'i bsngags pa byin rlabs zla gzugs 'char ba'i rdzing bu zhes bya ba can bris so// bstod pa 'di dang dbu mdzad pa bsod nams rab brtan dang sangs rgyas dpal ldan gnyis kyis bskul ngor/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsang mchod kyi cho ga dngos grub char 'bebs 'di gnyis ni/ kho bos bstan bcos rtsom pa kun gyi thog ma nyid yin no// sgra ka lā pa'i ri mo slob 'dun chen po mdzad de slob pa'i grogs ldan dgos gsungs pa ltar bslab grogs bgyis pas kun bshad pa'i rkang pa gsum pa yan chad tsam lobs song bas khong sngar nas lha ris dang rtsis dkar nag dang 'tsho byed kyi gzhung rnams la shin tu mkhas shing*/ snyan dngags kyi gzhung la'ang go rtogs bzang po yod pa dang*/ sngags lam gyi bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i thugs dam la brtson 'grus che ba'i dge bshes chen po zhig tu bzhugs shing*/ brda sprod la'ang mthar phyin sbyang rgyu byung na go rtogs bzang po skye ba 'dug mod/ rtag tu bro 'tshal gyis sku gzugs sra khel med pa'i rgyus des tsam gyis thugs tshim par mdzad song*/ dge bshes mkhas btsun de nyid kyang bar chad rkyen dbang du ring zhig nas dus kyi chos nyid du yol song*/ de dus kho bo'i sems la'ang dpyod ldan mkhas btsun dam pa de lta bu'ang rtsol sgrub chen pos dpe cha 'dri ba dang slob gnyer byed bzhin pa'i sgang la 'das song snyam pa'i 'gyod sems dang skyo shas drag po yun ring du skye ba zhig byung*/ tshad ma rig pa ni thos chung 'ga' zhig tshad ma'i skor sbyangs pa ni nga rgyal dang zhe sdang chen po'i rgyu yin zhes smra ba sogs ni rang gis ma shes pa'i skyon mtshang bsgrib phyir/

shes bya'i gnas la brten nas kha na ma tho ba chen po gsog pa'i sgros ngan thos pa tsam la yang rna ba dgab par bya ba'i 'khyal gtam ste/ rig pa'i gnas lnga'i ya gyal don gyi 'gal 'brel dpyod par byed pa rgyu rig pa'am gtan tshigs rig pa ste/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel bshad las/ mngon sum dang rjes su dpag pa'i tshad mas zin pa'i tarka'i gzhung la mkhas pa ni rgyu rig pa zhes bya'o zhes 'byung zhing*/ gzhan don du thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas brnyes pa la mngon par 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni shes bya thams cad la mkhas par bya dgos te/ rgyan gyi 'grel bshad las/ rgyu rig pa byang chub sems dpa' tshol bar byed de/ 'di ltar legs par smras pa dang nyes par smras pa rnams kyi don phyin ci ma log par shes par bya ba dang*/ rgyu rig pa'i gtsug lag shes par rlom pa'i mu stegs pa dag tshar gcod pa dang*/ bstan pa 'di la ma dad pa rnams dad par skyed pa dang*/ dad pa bskyed pa rnams kyi dad pa phyir zhing 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir brtson par byed do zhes dgos pa khyad par 'phags pa du ma'i sgo nas tshad ma rig pa'i yul la sbyang 'dun chen pos ldan chos 'khor gyi chos rje mkhan po 'phags pa blo gros zhes bya ba rnam 'grel la sbyangs pa mthar phyin par bzhugs pa/ grwa sa chen po rnams nas kyang bsngags brjod bya ba'i yul du gyur pa thos nas de'i zhabs pad bcar 'dun gyi zhu 'bul bgyis par/ de nyid nas kyang dgyes bzhin pas tshad ma kun las btus dang rnam 'grel gyi rtsa ba dang rje rin po ches mdzad pa'i 'grel chen bcas bskur nas sngon du 'di dag la lta rtog gyis dang*/ de bzhin bgyid pa byung na nga yang 'dir bsdad pa don chen byung ba yin zhes pa bcas bka'i gnang ba rab snyan tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar sgra 'dzin dbang po'i yul du 'jebs par phebs kyang bar chad kyi dbang gis phyi lo der chos rje mkhas dbang de nyid zhing khams su sku gshegs pas bsam don nam mkha'i me tog gi spun zla zhig las ma byung*/

de tshun nas khams phyogs 'di'i nye skor du slob par 'os pa'i slob dpon mkhas pa ma 'byor/ 'on kyang ji skad du/ rig pa nangs par 'chi yang bslab// tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang*// skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yi// nor la rang nyid len pa 'dra// zhes 'byung ba ltar las bzang gi bag chags rgyud la 'jog pa'i phyir dbus kyi ldom bu chos 'khor nas 'ongs pa'i rab 'byams pa'i gral du son tsam bsod nams brtan pa zhes bya ba zhig rang dang nye bar gnas pa byas nas lo ngo gnyis tsam bsdad pa/ de las btus ra'i rtags gsal khyab gsum rags pa tsam sbyangs mod/ rnam 'grel 'grel pa zhig gi stod nas blo 'dzin tsam byas pa'i rjes shig las/ gzhan la 'khrid par nus pa'i go rtogs ci yang ma skyes par mngon pas ci byar yod/ rnam 'grel gyi rtsa ba dang tshad ma rig gter gyi rtsa 'grel rnams kyi lung brgyud ldan gyi bla ma las mnyan te rang dgas lta rtog cung zad byed pa'i khul tsam bgyis so// dkar nag rtsis kyi rig pa ni/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las bshad pa'i phyi dus kyi 'khor lo ste/ de'ang sngar smos pa'i dge bshes sangs rgyas chos 'phel zhes pa dkar nag rtsis kyi rig pa la byang chub par bzhugs pa de nyid las bslabs te/ de'ang aṅgi'i grangs kyi yi ge ste de dag 'dri ba dang dbri ba dang bsnan pa dang bsgyur ba dang bgod pa ste/ yi ge'i yan lag lnga dang gza' dang tshes dang skar ma dang sbyor ba dang byed pa ste rtsis kyi yan lag lnga po tsam la sbyang rtsol bgyis/ gza' lnga'i ri mo dang sgra gcan dang nyi zla 'dzin pa'i rtsis dang nyi ldog la sogs pa dang*/ dus sbyor zhag gsum gyi rnam par dbye ba la sogs pa dang*/ nag rtsis kyi rde'u btab pa'i 'gros rnams ngor du phyin skabs se ra nas byon pa'i mdo sngags rab 'byams pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes pa sgra dang snyan dngags dang rtsis rigs rnams la'ang shin tu mkhas pa zhig gong du smos pa ltar bzhugs pa nas bslab sbyangs cung zad bgyis/

phyis su sde dger bsdad skabs mnga' ris la dā rgyal po'i mnga' 'og nas yin pa'i ngor pa'i chos rje rin chen chos skyong zhes bya ba zhig gzhung sa'i sku tshab pa zhig las bslabs pa'i ri mo'i rgyun 'dug pa de nyid dang*/ gsar rnying gsang ba sngags kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pa lhur bgyis pas lung rtogs kyi yon tan mod mi dma' ba rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i bla mkhyen bsod nams rgyal zhes bya ba nyid la rtsis kyi rig gnas skor rnams la bslab sbyangs mkhas pa'i rtser son du bzhugs pa dang bslabs pa'i slob dpon gyi brgyud rim yang 'tshol sla bar mchis pa bcas/ de dag las kyang de dag gi ri mo'i mgyogs rtsis su 'dri ba'i tshul dang bcas par lag khrid gsar rnying 'ga' yang zhib par nod par byas mod/ rang nyid sngar gzhon nu'i dus nas tshogs mang gi bsgrig srol la 'dur rtsol byed pa ma byung bar/ rang dgar ci bder sos dal bgyis pas lang shor shog bu bsgril long du rgyug pa lta bu la goms pa'i shugs kyis brtson 'grus kyi yid bzhin nor bu dag ni bag med za nyal la zhen pa'i mi bsrun chom rkun tshogs kyi 'jab bus phrogs shor bar brten/ gang dag bslab sbyangs byas pa'i shes bya'i gnas rnams la/ nyin mtshan phyid pa lta bus sbyang bstar mi bzod pas grong chog pa'i 'don brjod dang 'dra ba'i byang chub rgyud la 'byar nges zhig ni mi 'byung 'dug 'on te rig pa glegs bam gyi nang du gnas pa lta bu'i sgo nas/ rang gis rtog dpyod bgyid dgos dang gzhan la bslab 'doms byed dgos byung ba dag la dpyad bzod nus snyam pa tsam re ni 'ong ba 'dug go /ring zhig nas bdag la'ang tsha ba'i bro tshabs che ba zhig gis non pas snga lam bgrod la khad par byung bar de skabs nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len la rtun pa bskyed pa'i skabs yin pas/ 'chi ba'i dus na'ang 'pho ba'i gdams pa zhig la goms 'dris byas yod pa bcas/

gal te de dus shi na'ang dkor gyi bag chags kyang cung zad bsrabs pa'i skabs yin pa dang*/ mtshams sbyor gyi gdams pa'i sbyangs pa'ang mi dman tsam 'ong snyam pa yong 'dug skabs der 'khrul ba'i snang ngor du rang nyid na ba'i 'khris kyi g.yon phyogs der lha'i bu mo gzhon nu ma dkar mo lo grangs brgyad tsam gyi na tshod can gyi lus stod gcer bu la smad dar gyi sham thabs byas pa gnyis 'dug pa gcig gi lag na shog bu lteb chag byas pa chung ngu zhig bzung ba 'di ci yin snyam pa na/ de ma thag kha phye ba'i nang na shog bu dkar po la dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs bris pa zhig tu mthong*/ rang gi rnam rtog la bdag 'chi ba'i tshe dkyil 'khor 'di'i steng du bzhag pa'i bca' bsgrigs pa yin snyam nas/ mi dga' ba'i rnam pas lag pa g.yon pa brkyangs nas dkyil 'khor de'i lte ba nas zin pa'i 'phral la zan kham bcangs pa bzhin du bcangs pas skad cig la spar bar chud par bcang thub pa dang mnyam du/ nga rang da dung rang gzhan gyi don mang po ma bsgrubs bar du sdod pa las 'gro ba'i dus min zhes smras snyam pa'i snang ba zhig byung*/ yang lan cig nga rang 'dug pa'i thad der khang pa rgya mthongs yangs pa gru bzhi dod pa zhig gi khar sngar gyi bu mo de 'dra mang po zhig gis ca co'i gtam sgra dang rgya mthongs de'i kha rgya dang mnyam pa'i gos chen bla re'i zur phur ma ring po yod pa zhig phyogs bzhi nas bzung nas mar brkyangs te rang gi steng du gdugs phubs pa ltar phub ste byung ba'i snang ba byung ba de dag ltar na 'chi ltas kyi rnam pa yin las che ba mchis mod/ rim gros bslus pa 'dra snyam/ 'on kyang tshad nad de'i ro lus pa lta bu'i lkog ma la skrangs 'bur byung ba des yun ring po'i bar du mnar ba'i mthar lkog 'bras su gyur pa 'tsho byed pas me btsa' btab pas rim gyis je bder song bas skyed byed zung gi drin gyis 'tsho thabs du mas bskyed pa'i dal rten gyi yol go 'di ko/

bstan pa'i snying po nang rig pa sdom pa gsum dang rjes su 'brel bar zab cing rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i chu gter chen po las/ rang gi skal ba bzang po'i skyogs kyis nyung shas shig bcus pa dag ldugs pa'i snod du bzang ba byung ngo*// 'dir smras pa/ g.ya' dris bsgos pa'i me long drir bcas sems// gzugs brnyan bkod pa'i rig gzhung ma shar bar// 'phrul bzo'i mkhas par bsten pa'i 'dag chal gyi// cho ga'i bslab sbyangs rtag 'grus ci yang bskyed// kha ba ri pa'i brda sbyor thu mi'i gzhung*// sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug rnam 'grel bcas// smra sgo za ma tog sogs gsar rnying brda'i// legs bshad yongs su grags 'ga' nyams su bstar// bde mchog sdom pa 'byung ba gshin rje'i gshed// dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel che la sogs// mdo sngags dri med kyis bstan 'phags bod kyi// lnga rig mkhas pas legs bkral tshad mtshan nyid// ston byed legs par bshad pa'i rgod ma khas// mi shes rmongs pa'i dug can gnas 'thung la// cher rngam lung dang rigs pa'i 'od kyi lce// rgyal gsung lho phyogs nam mkha'i ngos su 'gyu// 'chi med ring 'tsho tshe yi rig byed kyi// nyal 'gro ji snyed dpyod ldan ṛ k+ṣar+bha'i// khyor chur song ba legs bshad skyugs pa'i rgyun// don gnyer yid kyi sa gzhir cang 'khyil ba// gso dpyad yan lag brgyad pa rgyud chen bzhi// cha lag dang bcas lta byed yul gyur las// lag len snying po 'chi med tshe'i zil dngar// rang blor 'tsham pa thos bsam yul du bgyis// skabs gsum lha yi bla ma kārti kaḥ /rgyal ba kun yum dbyangs kyi rgyal mo yi// zhal lung rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur gsum// brjod byar ston pa'i brda sprod zung gi mdo// legs sbyar brda sprod mkhyen pa'i 'jo sgeg gis// 'phags skye'i snying gi brtan pa 'phrog bzod pa// chos skyong bzang sogs dran dbang mdzes dga' mas// 'grel bshad byas pa'i sgyu rtsal 'ga' yang myong*// bṛt+ta dzā ti'i sdeb sbyor rigs gnyis su// rnam dbye'i nang gsel du ma mnga' bsgyur ba'i// yi ge phyi mo bgrang ba ngo mtshar gnas// rtogs byed rig pa'i 'phrul sgo 'byed la dbang*// 'khor ba mya ngan las 'das chos thams cad// dngos btags ming gi mngon par brjod pa'i sde// rtags gsum rnam gsal sgra gcig don mang can// 'phags bod mkhas pa'i 'chos skyob 'ga' zhig thos// dri za'i 'phang 'gro bye ba'i snyan 'gyur dbyangs// tshig don bzang pos rnam dben gang gi phyir// brjod bya'i chos rnams thams cad rgyan gsum glur// rtag 'jo snyan dngags dam pa'i rjes 'gro min// shar lhos nyer mtshon lam srol smra ba'i lce// dbyangs kyi rgyal mos mchog dngos grub pa'i bar// ches cher bsrings pa daṇ+ḍi'i snyan dngags gzhung*// me long rnam 'grel bcas pa'i thos bsam dpyad// ring nas sbyangs stobs dman pa'i shes rgyud gzhir// gti mug sra brtan gor mas yongs khyab pa// mngon sum rjes dpag tshad mas gshin byas par// 'gal 'brel dpyod pa'i sa bon 'jog tshul bgyis// mngon sum lkog gyur dngos po bsgyur bgod kyi// re khās legs 'doms bde sdug 'bras bu'i bzhin// rjen 'char ston pa phyi rol dus 'khor lo'i// byed grub yi ge'i rnga chen ldir ba'i khrod// lnga bsdus sgra gcan dbugs sgang khyim slebs dang*// lo bdag gza' skar gza' lnga dus sbyor sogs// nyi ldog mjug ring ṛ ṣi sa rlog zhag

/dal myur ri mos ston pa phal cher thos// tsī na'i yul gru'i mi srun kun rdzob rtsis// bden pas rjes su gzung phyir 'jam dpal dbyangs// rtse lnga'i ri bor bus pa'i tshul bltams nas// legs gsungs spor thang rtsis kyi gtsug lag mthong*// de nas nang rig pa'i thos pa bsags pa'i phyir mi ring bar rang lo nyer dgur son par grwa sar 'gro ba'i nyer bsdogs brtsams/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad kyi gtso bo 'phags pa'i lam phyin ci ma log pa ston par byed pa/ kun shes par byed pa nang don rig pa ni rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa'i tshogs chen po gnyis ni/ mdo las/ sdug bsngal dag ni thams cad dang*// sgrib pa kun sel dam pa'i chos// zhes dang rgyan gyi 'grel bshad las/ nang rig pa byang chub sems dpas 'tshol bar byed do// ci'i phyir zhe na bdag nyid kyis 'phags pa'i lam dang de kho na nyid phyin ci ma log par shes pas nyon mongs pa spang bar bya ba dang*/ byas pa chud zos pa dang ma byas pa 'ong ba med pa phyin ci ma log pa shes par bya ba dang*/ gzhan la'ang mngon par rgya cher bstan pa'i phyir 'tshol bar byed do zhes gnas skabs su sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las nges par skyob pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i lam gyi yon tan thams cad rgyud la bskyed cing rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa dang*/ mthar thug rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang don du gnyer ba rnams kyis bsgrub bya'i gtso bo nyid de/ de nyid bsgrub pa'i 'dun pas ldan rag chu rnam rgyal dgon du sa skya'i 'bul sdud bla ma dpon slob dbang phyug nyi ma zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan sa skya sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis pa'i bka'i slob bur gyur pa mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan dang ldan pa de nyid bzhugs yod pa/ de lor 'bul skyel du bteg grabs su 'dug pa de pa dang sngon nas yon mchod 'brel zab par brten de nyid la bcar nas sa ngor gyi grwa sar 'gro ba'i nyer bsdogs brtsams/

hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bzang la sa dkar nas bteg lam bar kun du nyer 'tshe'i rnam pa ci yang ma byung bar hor zla bdun pa'i tshes nyer bdun nyin bod yul dbus kyi rdo rje'i gdan chen po/ 'od gsal lha las babs pa'i gdung sras 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon gyi sgyu 'phrul rol pa chen po rgyun mi chad par byon pa rnams kyis/ rgyal ba'i ring lugs kyi rgyal thabs chen po phan bde'i gzi byin 'bum phrag 'bar bar legs par bskyangs pa dang da ltar bskyang bzhin pa dang 'byung 'gyur bskal pa ji srid gnas par bskyang bar 'gyur ba'i gdan sa chen po/ mkhas pa dang btsun pa dang grub pa'i yon tan yid bzhin nor bu du ma'i 'byung gnas zla ba'i ma ma lta bur gyur pa'i gdan sa chen po dpal sa skya zhes pa rje btsun rin po ches/ sa dkar po seng ge'i gdong pa 'dra// dpal ldan sa skya seng ge'i lus// zhes yul gyi dge mtshan la de ltar du yod pas rten dang brten pa gnyis ka'i mtshan la de ltar du grags pa'i dpal sa skya zhes snyan grags lha'i rnga gsang lta bur srid pa gsum gyi khongs su ldir ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mtha' yas pa'i zhing gi yon tan gyi bkod pa mtha' dag sa la 'phos pa snyam byed pa de nyid du bde bar slebs/ lha khang chen por bstan pa'i snying po sdom pa gsum gyi bslab pas rgyud gtams shing mdo sngags chos kyi spyan ras rnam par yangs pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun 'dus tshogs rnams bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i sgrub mchod chen po tshugs nas ring zhig song ba'i tshogs dbur bcom ldan 'das kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che mtha' dag gi mnga' bdag mkhas pa dang btsun pa dang grub pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu ston pa kun gyis ngag gi 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa'i gling bu 'bum phrag bsgyur bas bla nas bla mar mngon par bsngags pa'i yul dam pa/

legs bris yul gyi bdag po rnams dang*/ lto 'phye dang grul bum gyi dbang po dang*/ mi'am ci'i rgyal po dang*/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po rnams dang*/ mi'i dbang phyug 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ rgyal po dang rgyal phran la sogs pa 'jig rten na che bar rlom pa rnams kyis do ker nor bu'i rtse mos lan gcig min pa btud par byas pa/ gcig tu rnam dkar phrin las kyi gru bo ches sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gi chu gter mtha' med par bying ba'i 'gro ba thams cad gnas skabs mthar thug gi bde ba dam pa'i skam sar gdon pa'i ded dpon chen po/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dpal sa skya pa bdag chen ngag gi dbang po kun dga' bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa de nyid/ bsnyengs bral gdong lnga'i dbang pos mngon par sgeg pa'i chos kyi khri mthon po gang la bkra shis pa'i rtags kyis rnam par bkra ba'i zhabs zung dag gis mngon par bkod de lham mer bzhugs pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mthong don che ba nyid kho bo cag rnams kyi lta phyed yul gyi dga' ston du nye bar thob pa dang*/ bkra shis re khās mtshan pa'i lha dar dkar pos thog drangs pa'i mjal rten cung zad yod pa phul te/ mtshan bzang zla 'od dkar po'i snang bas sgeg pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal zhing 'dod 'byung phyag gi dpag bsam yal ga brkyangs pa'i grib bsil du chud pa'i dga' ston gya nom pa myong ba'i 'phral der/ dal brgyad ldan pa'i lus kyi rten la mchog gi snying po can du dang por gyur to snyam pa'i dga' ba thob/ nyer brgyad nyin der bdag chen rin po ches thog drangs pa'i tshogs pa rnams kyis rdo rje phur pa'i 'chams bsgrigs pa dang*/ nyer dgu'i nyin phur 'chams rgyas pa'i ltad mo rnams mjal bas ngo mtshar mig gi bdud rtsir gyur/ rim gyis gzhi thog dang lha khang chen mo'i steng shod dang gzhi thog kho ra khor yug gi lha khang byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba phal cher dang*/

bse 'bag mgon khang dang pu tra'i bla mtsho sogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du ba'i mgon khang rnams mjal/ sngar sa skya'i gdung rabs chos 'byung sogs la dpe bltas yid 'jags su yod pa'i dkar po rnam gsum gyi sku 'bum rnams dang*/ rje sa chen gyi sgrub gnas 'jam dbyangs phug sogs kyang brtsad cing dris nas mjal/ gzhi thog chags tshul rnams lha khang chen mo'i lcags ri'i steng nas tshur mjal bar/ sa dkar po seng ge'i gdong pa 'dra ba sogs gnas bstod ji lta ba bzhin ngo mtshar dge mtshan che bar mthong bas zhing bkod shog dpe zhig kyang bris yod pa phyis su bor song bas ma rnyed/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi tshogs su chos dung dkar po rgyang grags bskul ba'i mang ja rgyas pa zhig btang ba'i steng*/ lha khang mkhan chen dkon mchog rgyal po tshogs dbur spyan 'dren zhus nas bsngo rten dang rnam gzhag gi rim pa so sor gang dgos phul/ gzhan yang nye kor gyi lha khang rin chen sgang g.yu thog phru ma lha khang*/ kha'u byas 'gyur/ bsam gling gi lha mo'i rten rnams kyang mjal du phyin nas mchog dang thun mong gi 'dod don 'grub pa'i gsol gdab byas/ der 'dod don rags rim rnams grub par byas nas/ ngor du 'ong ba'i lam zhor du lto bcas dang bca' lag bsgrub dgos 'ga' re'i phyir dang*/ paṇa chen sprul pa'i sku rin po che blo bzang ye shes dbang po'i zhabs nyid mjal 'dun che bas gzhis rtser phyin/ der paṇa chen rin po che bcad rgya'i skabs su bab pas/ stobs ldan gzhan gyis mjal zhor ma 'phrod pas zhal mjal ma thob/ bkra shis lhun po'i lha khang gi rten mjal 'ga' re byung*/ de 'phral nas 'ongs te rtogs ldan la brgal ba na/ der ngor pa'i grwa pa mnga' ris pa blo gros rgya mtsho zhes bya ba zhig dang 'phrad/ de dang bsdongs nas song ba na ngor zhes pa sngon dus sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta hor yul du se chen gan gyis bla'i mchod gnas su spyan drangs nas phebs pa'i dus su ye shes gzigs pa'i me long du ji ltar shar ba bzhin lung bstan cing phyis su lhag pa'i lha gtsug tor rnam par rgyal mas rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab chen po rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la lung bstan pa ltar legs par btab pa e waṃ chos ldan gyi chos grwa chen po zhes dpal ldan stug por bkod pa'i zhing gi yon tan gyi bkod pa ltar/

mkhas btsun grub pa'i yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas chen po la co 'drir bzod pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i phrin las kyi sgra dbyangs rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba/ gang gi phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor kun du snang bar byed pa'i dben gnas dam pa de nyid la'i tshur nang rdo'i maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod pa yod pa'i phyogs nas legs par mjal/ der dge slong blo gros rgya mtsho bas bla brang dang khang tshan so so 'di dang 'di'o zhes kho bor legs par bstan te/ gnas de'i yon tan gyi bsngags pa ḍā ki rnam par bzhad pa'i glu dbyangs las/ kun dkris nyes brgyas gzings pa'i grong khyim las// lam ring bgrod dkas phyin pa nyer zhi'i gnas// ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las rgyal byed tshal dang ni// myang 'das thar pa mchog gi gzhal med khang*// 'du 'dzi'i klung brgya brgal ba ri bo'i nang*// bya dang ri dwags rtse ba'i do rwa mchog /grub pa drang srong rig 'dzin dga' ba'i tshal// 'brog dgon shin tu dben pa'i bsti gnas gang*// zhes bsngags pa don dang ldan pa'i chos grwa de nyid du slebs pa na dge slong chos bstan 'dzin zhes bya bas brda sprad de/ sngar rang gi pha yul nas yin pa'i dge slong shes rab phun tshogs can gyis khrid de ldan khang nub tu bsdad/ ring nas brnag pa'i snying po smon lam dge ba'i sa bon ma rmas par btab pa'i snye ma nyid mi bslu bar bden pas g.yur du za bar gyur to snyam pa'i dga' ba dpag tu med pa skyes so// de'i skabs mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub pa'i zhal snga nas khri 'dzin gyi khur len mi dgos pa'i dgongs grol zhus pa ltar zhu don grub nas/ mnga' ris rab rgyas gling na bzhugs pa'i mkhan po mdo sngags rab 'byams pa rong po lnga bcu par grags shing*/ mtshan dngos kun mkhyen tshul khrims lhun grub ces bya ba bsko bzhag mdzad dgos pa'i bka' shog

gdan sa gong dang gzhung sa chen po bcas nas phebs pa la/ rtsis sprod rnams ma grub par las 'dzin rnying pa mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub pas bla brang du bzhugs pa la mjal dar dang bsngo rten gyi bskur ma yod pa rnams der phul nas mjal kha zhus par gsung gleng thor tsam byung ba dad cing dwang ba 'dren bzod pa brjid chags su khums/ dbang lung sogs chos kyi bdud rtsi stsal ba'i zhar la bka' drin gyis bskyang dgos tshul gsol ba btab/ rim gyis dge rgan zhig gis sna shan byas te bla brang khag gzhan rnams dang phan bde khang du rdo rje 'chang dpal ldan chos skyong pas bzhugs pa rnams mjal dar mtshon tsam re dang bcas te mjal kha zhus par so sos bka' 'dri nyung shas stsol ba rnams lan 'debs dang dbang lung gi thugs rjes bskyang dgos tshul gsol ba btab/ ldan khang pad+ma dkar po'i gtsug lag khang du grwa ja rgyas pa zhig btang bar/ ga zi/ zil gnon/ 'bum pa/ rong po mi nyag bcas pa'i khang tshan nang gshin gyi grwa pa brda brgyabs tshogs par chos spyod yongs rdzogs kyi gdangs 'don bsgrigs legs shing snyan brjid dwang ba 'dren bzod pa mngon/ gos ljang gi 'phan la bsngags brjod bsngo byang gi tshigs su bcad pas mdzes par byas pa phul/ rab byung 'dod pa'i bi shwa ban+tu ste sna tshogs dbyig ces shing mo sbrul gyi lo de'i nang gsel hor zla dgu pa tha skar gyis nya ba'i tshes brgyad gza' skar sbyor 'phrod legs pa'i nyin/ bdag sogs gdul byar gyur pa rnams kyi bsod nams gzhal du med pa'i khyung sngon skyes kyi kha lo pas nye bar son pa dang*/ rje btsun dam pa de nyid kyi bgrang yas bskal pa'i phreng bar thugs bskyed smon lam mod mi dma' ba'i rlung shugs kyi shing rta'i 'gros mgyogs pa bcas/ tshogs gnyis rmad byung bi shwa karmas legs par brdar ba'i sku'i dkyil 'khor dge mtshan gyi gzi brgya 'bar ba'i mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes rnam 'dren bstan pa gsal ba'i nyin mor byed pa'i nor bu de nyid/

e waṃ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang chen por rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po zhes yongs su grags pa nyid/ thub pa'i dbang po'i rgyal tshab chen por gyur nas mkhas pa'i phrin las gsum gyis bstan pa skyong bar mdzad pa'i bzhugs khri bsnyengs pa bzhi dang bral ba'i brdar gdong lnga'i dbang pos mtshan pa ga la ba der/ zhabs mthil ban+dhu dzī ba ka'i spun zlar dmar ba la bkra shis rtags kyi 'khor lo'i re khās sgeg pa dag rnam par bkod cing khams gsum chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i dbang phyug nyid du gzhung sa chen po'i sku tshab dang gdan sa gong gi sku tshab pa dang bcas nas bka' shog legs 'bul gyi tshogs dang*/ ngor gyi bla brang khag rnams dang khang tshan so so nas kyang sku gsung thugs rten gyis thog drangs pa'i khri 'bul gyi rnam grangs bstabs te bzhugs khrir mnga' gsol/ gang gi tshe 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po de nyid ni bsnyengs bral bzhi ldan gyi spobs pa dge bas gong nas gong du 'degs pa snyam byed pa'i dpal gyi mgur bteg cing*/ dung gi tshems bar nas 'phrul gyi ljags dmar yangs par brkyangs te dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs pas khor yug gi tha gru yangs pa 'gengs bzhin pa'i gdangs kyi dkyil 'khor gang las/ dpal stobs bcu mnga' ba gdung 'tshob chen po dang bcas pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che dge legs 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas su/ rnam pa thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba'i bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas gdab pa la sogs pa sngar gyi srol bzhag bzang po'i ngo mtshar bkra shis pa'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag dus gcig tu phye ba lta bu'i mi 'gyur phreng ba bstar ba gang de/ 'jug pa bcu pa'i stobs kyi lag pa stong gis kyang gzhar yang gsub tu med pa ni gor ma chag snyam pa'i thog mar dge ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i dus der/ sngon chad mig dang rna ba'i dbang po'i yul du ma myang ba'i ya mtshan ltad mo che ba dang chabs cig tu dga' ba rgya chen po thob bo// tshes bcu gsum nyin bdag cag grogs bcas rnams kyis bla brang mkhan chen de nyid kyi sku zhabs su mjal dar 'bul ba mtshon tsam re yod pa rnams 'bul du phyin nas/

srid zhi'i 'jigs las skyob pa'i skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya brkyangs pa'i grib bsil du chud pa'i byin rlabs thob/ 'ga' zhig mkhan po'i zhal snga nas ming 'dogs zhu ba de nyin nas srol yang yod ces gleng 'dug pa ltar zhus pas bdag la tshul khrims rin chen zhes pa ming du stsal/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang de nyid nas lo de'i ston ka'i dus chos su khams mnga' ris nas 'dus pa'i grwa tshogs thams cad la/ grub chen dze tā ri nas brgyud pa'i bya rgyud pad+ma'i rigs kyi tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang tshan gshar ba thob pas rje btsun dam pa de las chos 'brel thob pa kun gyi thog mar byung*/ mkhan rnying pa 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub pa sgrub khang du zur bzhugs mdzad song*/ der mi ring bar bka' dbang zhig yod pa thos te zhur song bas dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor rgyal mo'i rjes gnang shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis kyi yi ge ltar thob pas chos 'brel gyi thog ma byung*/ phan bde khang du sku dbon thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong pa nas zur chos 'ga' zhig gnang skabs yin 'dug par zhur phyin pas rje dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i yig cha ltar rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad bskor gyi rgyu dbang thob pa'i thog ma byung*/ khang gsar phan bde gling du gnas lnga'i rig pa smra ba'i dbang phyug mkhan chen byams pa bsod nams bzang po bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bzhugs par mjal du phyin te/ skyabs sbyin gyi grib mar chud pa'i byin rlabs legs par thob/ rang gi blta 'dod kyi dpe cha 'ga' zhig dgos zhus pa'i tho chung zhig bris nas phul ba spyan lam du bab song 'dra bas/ ring zhig na ldan ma khang du yi ge 'dri shes pa'i gsar bu zhig yod 'dug par de 'dir yi ge nyung tsam dpe chod byed par shog gsung byung bar song*/ khang steng gi rab gsal du dbus kyi chos grwa chen po se ra nas byon pa'i rab 'byams pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba mkhas btsun chen po zhig der chos gsan du byon nas bzhugs pa de dang lhan cig sdod du bcug ste/

dmag zor ma'i cho lang gi mo yig brda ma dag par yod pa cig 'dri rgyu bskur byung bar sdeb bcos byas nas bris phul/ de dus kho bo'i bod yig gshar ma sgar dris kyi lugs 'dra ba'i bris gsar 'bring zhig las mi thon na'ang*/ yi ge'i dag sdeb brgyab pa la thugs dgyes byung ba 'dra bas shin tu thugs dgyes chen po 'dug pas da dung re zhig yi ge 'dri grogs dgos gsung byung ba ltar phyag dpe 'dri dgos rnams bris nas phul/ de nas brtsams te nang nub tsam ma gtogs par khang gsar bla brang kho nar bsdad cing yi ge bris/ se ra rab 'byams pas mkhan chen pa la snyan dngags me long ma'i rgyan gyi gshar khrid tsam dang grub rtsis lugs kyi lnga bsdus kyi ri mo 'bul zin nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i rnam thar dū ku la'i gos bzang gi po ti rnams kyi lung 'bul gyin yod pa 'dug kyang gsar bur song bas zhu ma spobs pas bdag gis ma thos so// mkhan chen rgyal ba'i sras chen rigs kyi skyes bu dam pa/ phyi gnas lnga'i gtsug lag gi gzhung don ma lus pa mkhyen pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam pa la/ nang du gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam rgyud sde mang po'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa'i rnal 'byor la gnas nas skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya mang po gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bder sbyor bar lhur mdzad pa/ gsang bar bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin par mnga' ba'i sa'i yon tan thams cad thugs rgyud la mngon du bgyis pa la/ skal ba mnyam pa'i ngor byams pa bsod nams bzang po bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan can zhes grags pa de nyid kyi zhabs stegs dam pa'i chos kyis mngon par mtho bar byas pa gang der/ yan lag mchog gis gus par bsten pa'i rab 'byams pa de nyid kyis tshur la sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho'i rgya gzhung dang*/ gur mgon gyi snyan brgyud po ti dang*/ dud sol lha mo'i sgrub skor po ti/

tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i kye rdo rje'i rnam par bshad pa nyi ma'i 'od zer rnams kyi lung dang*/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i rgyu dbang dang*/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs/ mgon po dkar po yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ gnyan gyi thugs dam sgrol ma yan lag drug pa/ gur gyi mgon po lcam dral lha brgyad/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa bsnyen dus kyi rjes su gnang ba rnams gsan song ba'i zhar byung bdag gis kyang legs par thob/ rab 'byams pa des bla brang gzhan rnams nas kyang gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi thog drangs pa'i dbang lung ci byung thams cad zhu ba'i thugs rtsol bskyed pa'i dge bshes chen po zhig tu bzhugs so// bdag gis gsung ngag rin po ches nye bar mtshon pa'i chos zhu ba'i bar mtshams rnams su dmigs rkang rnams sbyang lo tsam bgyis pa'i tshe ma gtogs par phyag dpe kho na 'dri ba dang*/ rim gyis khang gsar bla brang nyid nas khams 'gros rnams la thum lan gyi yi ge btang dgos phal cher yang khyod kyis brtsams nas bskur dang legs po 'ong 'dug ces gsungs pa ltar brtsam chos gang dran byas nas bskur/ de lta bu'i ngang nas khams 'gros bteg khar sku zhabs chen po de nyid kyi bka' lung dbyangs can rgyud mangs lta bu'i rgyud las bdag cag la 'di skad du stsal ba thos te/ 'di lor drung yig khyod khams la 'gro mi chog par sdod dgos/ rgyu mtshan khyod rig gnas thams cad la mkhas po 'dug cing khyad par snyan dngags 'di de sngon yang bdag gis rab 'byams pa las tshar gcig mnyan khul byas kyang da dung go bab che ba zhig ma byung bas khyod las nan gyis mnyan te snyan dngags yongs rdzogs kyi rtsom rgyug dang bcas pa zhig dang*/ ka lā pa byā ka ra ṇa bcas pa'i ri mo bslab 'dun shin tu che zhing*/ sku gzugs kyi cha tshad dang ri mo'i 'gros dang cha tshad rnams kyang sbyang 'dun yod gsungs pa'i nan tan mdzad 'dug pa de ltar yin na rang gis 'bad rtsol byas pa bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po 'di lta bu la 'bul rgyu byung na de bas don che ba'i bsgrub bya mi 'dug snyam nas bsdad/

se ra rab 'byams pa de nyid dang nged rang zla ba brgyad tsam gyi yun la steng gi rab gsal du mnyam du bsdad cing de skabs kho bos bla brang khang gsar ba'i lto bcas bza' zhing yi ge 'dri dgos rnams mi 'dri bar slob gnyer bslab sbyangs dang lung mnyan pa sogs byas nas bsdad na mi 'gab bsams nas stabs bde ma byung ba ma gtogs rtsis skor sogs la khong shin tu mkhas shing bka' 'gyur dang rgyal dbang lnga pa'i bka' 'bum sogs gsan rgya chen po bzhugs 'dug khong nyid las bdag gis grub rtsis gza' lnga'i ri mo dang*/ nag rtsis kyi lo keg gi rtsis kyi rde'u zhe bdun pa brgyab pa'i tshul dang sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug gi ri mo 'dri tshul cung zad re bslabs/ bdag gis phyag dpe'i rgyab yig sogs tshigs bcad lhug 'ga' zhig la skad gnyis shan sbyar bsgyur nas lāñca na dang wartu la bcas bris nas phul bas/ rab 'byams pa des kyang khong gis sgra dang snyan dngags 'di dag slob dpon las bslab tsam byas nas/ de phan chad sbyang bstar chen po byed rgyu ma byung bas/ 'di dag la nga las khyed byang cha che bas mkhas par 'dug ces yang yang gleng zhing thugs dgyes shin tu che ba mdzad/ bdag gis lung yun ring por zhu ba'i gral du rab 'byams pa de dang mnyam du yod pa'i tshe gzhan dang gtam lab cung zad byed pa'am gnyid yur 'gro ba'i grabs yod pa'i tshe bdag la rna ba gtod ces pa'i phyag gi brda byed cing rgyun par yang khyod gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug pas chos nyan rgyu 'di dag la gtam lab sogs kyi dbang du ma song bar tshig chad pa med par rig pa bsgrims nas mnyan dgos tshul gyi bslab bya bzang po gnang ba zhig yod pas ji skad du/ dge ba dge ba'i bshes la brten nas 'phel// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i chos grogs bzang po de lta bu dang 'phrad pas skal ba bzang snyam pa byung ngo*// de nyid kyis sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas kyi ri mo sngar bslab ma myang 'dug par/

bdag gis sdeb sbyor gyi prāstā ra 'god tshul dang ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyi ri mo dang bcas pa de nyid la phul grub par byas/ slar yang rab 'byams pa de nyid dang bye ba'i dus na'ang kho bo la bslab byar 'di skad du gdams pa thos te/ slad char du'ang khyed rang khams phyogs su 'gro snga mi byed par grwa sa 'dir slob gnyer thos bsam bsgom pa spel te re zhig bsdad na/ ma 'ongs par bstan par nyan bshad kyi phan 'dogs dang las 'dzin byed pa sogs byung na/ phyogs mtha' dag gi gdul bya 'du ba'i chos grwa 'di nyid sngon gyi srol bzhag bzang por mchis pas legs/ der ma zad nga rang da ltar stod kyi shel dkar du bla ma zhig la bka' 'gyur ro cog gi lung 'bul du 'gro dgos pas lo phyed gnyis tsam 'gor/ de mtshams nas mar dbus la 'gro rtsis yin pas/ de skabs lta bur 'phrod na/ khyed kyang dbus phyogs su 'ongs nas se ra'i chos rwa 'dra la re zhig bsdad de/ da dung rig gnas kyi rtsal 'don dang*/ dbang lung thob dgos kyi rigs btsal ba sogs byed na nga rang gis gcar ba'i mthun grogs byed/ khyad par mtshan nyid skor gyi rigs pa zhig sbyong ba mdzad na khyod lta bu la mi dgos thabs med du mchis/ de ltar byed pa byung tshe mar lam gyi brgyags chas tsam ma gtogs pa bsnams rgyu ma byung na'ang mi gnod de/ nga rang chu mig spyi khang du yod pas rtsad chod gyis dang*/ chos brgyags 'tsho ba nga rang rkyang pa la brten na'ang thabs chags pa mi 'ong bas de ltar yid 'jog gyis zhes dang*/ da lta bla brang khang gsar sku zhabs mkhan chen pa'ang dbus su rmor chen pa'i drung du chos gsan la ci sngar phebs pa'i nyer bsdogs brtsam gyin mchis par/ de dus khyod kyang drung yig par byed nas 'gro dgos zhes phebs 'ong las che ste/ gal te de ltar byung na 'gro rgyu gyis dang sngar ma thob pa'i chos mang du thos par 'gyur ba sogs shin tu stabs legs pa 'ongs zhes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas 'phos pa'i bslab bya bzang po gdams pa la sogs pas 'bral dka' ba tsam du stsal to// me pho rta'i bgrang gzhi shar ba'i hor lugs zla ba bzhi pa'i nang der khang gsar mkhan po chen po nyid sngar nas rmor chen rab 'byams pa kun dga' lhun grub pa las zab cing dkon pa'i dbang lung kha shas gsan par mdzad nas/
