de 'phro'i zhu dgos rnams gsan pa'i dgongs pas sngon du yul dbus gyur 'chang phyogs su bteg pa shin tu gal che ba yod pas sngon la der 'dong dgos par/ gang gi tshe chos kyi tshul gang dag thos pa rnams kyi dpe tshogs mang po 'dri dgos bcas yod pas/ khyod kyang phyag g.yog drung yig lhan cig pa'i phyir du 'dong dgos/ chos ni nga rang gi gang dag thob pa de mnyam du thob 'ong zhes bka' stsal snyan 'gyur rdzogs pa'i dbugs dbyung bcas phebs pa ltar der song*/ lam zhor du mtshur phur byon der karma pa zhwa dmar nag lhan cig gdan 'dzom par bzhugs pa'i zhal mjal phyin pas byin rlabs thob/ der bzhugs pa'i rten mjal rnams zhib par byung*/ bod yul sa'i lte ba rdo rje'i gdan gnyis pa lha gdan du 'byor/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi rten gyi gtso bor gyur pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i rgyal po dngos dang mi gnyis par bod rje byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi bsod nams gser gyi 'do lir brten nas spyan drangs pa'i jo bo shākya mu ne dang mi bskyod rdo rje rnam gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i rten mchog khyad par 'phags pa mthong don mchog gi snying pos mngon par lci ba rags rim rnams kyi zhal mjal/ chu gter chen por chu thigs kyi 'brel 'jog lta bu'i mar me'i phreng bas bstar ba rnams kyi kha 'gengs dang snyan dar dang phyag mchod yan lag bdun pas mdun bdar te gsol ba btab pas rnyed dka'i mi lus thob pas skal ba mi dman pa'i bdud rtsi'i ro la longs spyad pa'i rigs su son/ rim gyis chu lho khar bteg pas she'u lots+tsha ba kun dga' chos grags la sogs pa mkhas grub mang pos byon pa'i gdan sa dben gnas dam pa rmor zhes bya ba'i dgon par slebs/ der zhabs drung chen po de nyid yon tan rgya che zhing phrin las rgyas pa'i shugs kyis bla brang de nyid stobs che zhing dpal 'byor mnga' thang phun sum tshogs pa zhig tu mchis so// cung zad cig nas spos reng thogs pa'i phyag mdzod pas byung nas sngun bsu ste/

mkhan chen dam pa nas mjal dar gyi dngos po gser dngul ja dar sogs ltos che ba dang spo 'bor bla ma shākya bstan 'dzin pa dang nged rang phyag g.yog tu gtogs pa so so nas kyang mjal dar mtshon byed yod pa bcas te mjal du dong ste lhags pa na/ zhabs drung rin po che de nyid dgung lo drug cu stod tsam phebs 'dug kyang gzims chung sgo bar du mdun bsur byon te phan tshun phyag lan gnang ste gdan la bzhugs so// rje btsun chen po de nyid mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang sngags kyi theg pa'i gzhung lugs zab rgyas zla ba'i ma ma lta bu'i pha rol du brgal ba gting mtha' gzhal du ma mchis pa'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od zer 'bum phrag bdo bas 'jig rten gsum gyi dge legs sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan dga' tshal bye ba phrag brgya cig car bzhad pa'i rtsa lag chen po mkhas par 'os pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i phrin las kyi 'od zer rnon pos chos min smra ba'i phyogs kyi mun stug ma lus pa zad par za ba/ yongs rdzogs thub pa'i lugs bzang phan bde'i 'dod dgu 'jo ba'i yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po gang de/ bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi 'khor lo'i lha gos lhab lhub tu g.yo ba'i rtse mor bskal par brtan byed kyi sman pa chen por gyur pa/ mtshan dngos thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan gyi snyan pas srid gsum dog por bgyid snyam du bzhugs par mjal te/ legs bshad chos kyi 'byung khungs bzang po nas legs par 'phos pa'i 'dren pa mchog zung chos dang srid pa'i gtsug lag gi bka' dri dang lan ldon gyi gsung snyan sngon chad thos ma myong ba'i ngo mtshar gleng ba du mas sgra 'dzin dbang po'i gsos su 'gyed pa ci yang thos pa'i spro ba skyes/ de'i phyi nyin nas chos 'brel gyi thog ma nyid du rje btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan tshe dpag tu med pa sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyi rjes gnang yig rnying rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa dang*/

rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang yi ge bklag pas don grub ces bya ba dang bcas pa'i steng nas nos pa/ gsung gi sgra dbyangs thos pa tsam nas smra ba mkhas dgu'i yid kyi brtan pa rang dbang nyid du 'phrog pa'i skyes bu chen por go /de nas brtsams te zhag gi phung po phyed gnyis lhag tsam gyi bar du gzhung sa'i mi drag dbang chen gyis rgyun lugs byed pa yod dus su nyi ma gnyis gsum re bshol 'gro ba ma gtogs par nyin re bzhin du snga chos dang dgongs chos spel ba'i sgo nas smin byed kyi dbang bka' dang rig par gtad pa dang byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ rjes su gnang ba dang bka' gtad dang nyams khrid zab mo la sogs pa shin tu zab cing dkon pa'i gdams pa'i rigs mang po stsal/ de skabs shig nas zhabs drung rin po che nyid gzhung sar sbyin bdag sde pa chen po rnams kyi ring 'tsho'i cho gar tshe dbang dang tshe sgrub sogs mdzad dgos pa'i phyir lha sar phebs dgos byung song*/ de bar du khang gsar mkhan rin po che nyid kyang jo bo shākya mu ner zhabs bskor bsag pa'i dgongs pas dpon g.yog tshang mas lha sar byon/ dar po gling par gnas g.yar te der bzhugs nas nang bskor 'bum ther gsog pa gnang song ba'i zhar byung*/ bla ma shākya bstan 'dzin dang nga rang gnyis kyis kyang bskor ba bsag thub pa byung*/ slar mkhan chen pas rten mjal dang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i bka' 'bum skor sogs phyag dpe mang rab par brgyab dgos pas 'bras spungs su phebs/ zhag bdun bzhugs nas de dag grub/ slar zhabs drung rin po che rang gnas rmor du phebs chog pa byung ba mnyam du mkhan chen pa'ang rmor du byon chos 'phro zhu dgos rnams zhus/ de dag gi snga phyi rnams su'ang yar klungs bkra shis chos sde nas gnas gsar zhabs drung rin po che ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas dang lcags zam sprul pa'i sku rnams kyi kyang byon nas chos thun 'ga' re gsan song*/

'bras spungs nas stod phyogs su 'bul sdud la btang rgyu'i bla ma zhig gis kyang byon nas 'jigs byed rwa khrid mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud kyi nyams khrid sogs chos thun 'ga' re zhur byung ba rnams dang yang mnyam du thob/ zhabs drung rin po che'i bkas/ lcags zam sprul sku'i drung yig pa 'di blo gsal po yod pas khyod kyis sgra kā la pa'i 'go nas ri mo zhig bslab grogs gyis gsungs nas dpe cha rnams gnang byung bar mdo tshig blo la 'dzin du bcug nas ri mo rnams bslabs pas mtshams sbyor rkang lnga'i ri mo rdzogs tsam zhig las long ma byung bar bteg song*/ snga phyir chos thos pa'i rkang grangs rnams ni 'og tu phyogs gcig par smos par 'gyur ba las 'dir mi 'dri'o// de mtshams ngor nas mkhan po rin po che mdun bsu ba'i bang chen chibs drel mang po'i tshogs dang bcas te 'byor byung*/ da dung zhu dgos rnam thar rgya can skor sogs chos sna kha shas bka' drin stsal ba'i zhal 'ches mdzad byung na'ang*/ der chibs drel mang por rtswa bzan dkon pas mi bteg thabs bral byung bas chibs bsgyur gnang nas rim gyis phebs lam du zhugs/ lam bar du gong dkar dang rong byams chen dang zhwa lu rnams su tshugs mtshams byung yang mkhan chen pas rten mjal mdzad dgos pa'i zhar byung ma 'phrod pa dang nyi ma dgongs mor sleb pas rten mjal long skabs ma byung bar ngor du phebs so// ngor bla brang gi mkhan chen khri thogs pa thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa nas/ lo de'i dbyar chos su grwa rgyun thams cad la mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i bka' 'bum glegs bam bzhi yod pa'i glegs bam dang po gnyis kyi lung dang rjes gnang kha shas mdzad zin nas/ de mthar rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs ro langs brgyad skor gyi rgyu dbang thams cad la bstar bar mdzad song ba thob/

ston chos su'ang bka' 'bum lhag ma'i glegs bam gnyis kyi lung dang rjes gnang 'ga' zhig mdzad pa dang*/ dgun chos su rdo rje gur mkha' 'gro lnga'i rgyu dbang bsgrigs par stsal ba rnams thob/ khang gsar mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang ba nyid nas dbus phyogs nas byon skyes lta bur ku ru kul+le lha lnga'i dbang paṇa chen thar rtse pa'i yi ge'i steng nas gshar rgyu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor ma rnyed par kho bos 'phral du grub par bris nas phul bas rab gnas mdor bsdus sngon du 'gro bas grwa rgyun thams cad la khyab par mdzad pa dang*/ de dag gi bar skabs rnams nas zur chos 'chad pa rnams las chos ma thob pa rnams ci thob byas shing*/ gang gi tshe 'dren mchog dpal ldan chos skyong pas khu bo bstan 'dzin lhun grub zhing gshegs pa'i pur ras kyi gzhi la gtso bor dpal mgon bram gzugs la/ dmag zor dang*/ beg tse 'khor du yod pa zhig bris gsungs pa ltar bris pas/ rje nyid nas kyang gtor bsngo phrin las bcol bar gzabs gtad byas ma gtogs rtsub mo zhig byung bas chos skyong 'khor nges pa zhig byung gsung gin gda'/ der bstan 'dzin lhun grub pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrub phyir sku dbon rin po che nyid dpal sa skyar 'byon rgyu'i nyer bsdogs su lha khang dang mgon khang gi rten khyad 'phags rnams su 'bul rgyu'i bla re dang gos 'phan snyan dar rnams kyi gsol 'debs bsngo byang dang 'bul yig gi rim pa rnams kyang rang gi gang dran brtsams nas 'dri grogs gang dgos bsgrubs/ de bzhin du sgrub khang pa mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub pa'i zhal nas kho bor snyan dngags kyi tshig rgyan dang mngon brjod kyis bcings pa'i tshigs bcad kyi dri ba mang po nyams sad kyi tshul du gnang 'dug pa thams cad kyi go don rnams zhus pas thugs dgyes shin tu che ba stsal/ de nas bzung ste dpon slob thugs brtses gzigs pa shin tu che zhing lam 'bras dmigs rkang rnams nyams su len skabs kyi dogs sel dang rtogs 'bul phal cher der 'bul chog pa byung zhing*/

nyams myong zab mo'i dri gtugs bya ba'i yul gyi rdo rje slob dpon chen po zhig la de lta bu mjal mi thub pa lta bur go /chos gsan pa'i tho yig rje btsun nyid kyis phyag bris gnang ba'i 'phro rnams kyi 'dri grogs dang*/ sga stod phyogs su bsring rgyu'i thum yig 'dri dgos sogs kyi grogs ldan zhabs tog gang 'grub zhus pas 'dren mchog bla ma de dag thams cad mnyes par 'gyur ba'i rgyur song ngo*// sga stod skye sku dgon gyi dge slong mkhas btsun tshul khrims phun tshogs pas dbyangs can ma la snyan dngags don rgyan so lnga tshang ba'i dper brjod byas pa'i bstod pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ dbyangs can ma la bsngags pa don rgyan pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba zhes bya ba brtsams te/ mkhan chen byams pa bsod nams bzang po'i spyan sngar gzigs phul bar shin tu legs 'dug pa'i thugs dgyes chen pos nga la'ang tshar gcig dpe shus shig ces gsungs pa ltar bris nas phul/ gang gi tshe khang gsar bla brang du sde dge'i phyogs nas slob bu zhig gis zhu yig 'gor sh+lau ka sdeb sbyor bsgrigs pa'i skad gnyis shan sbyar lāñca na bcas byas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa re legs shig phul byung bar mkhan chen chos 'chad sogs kyi brel bas ma skabs par/ de'i yig lan khyod kyis skad gnyis shan sbyar sdeb sbyor gyis bcings pa bcas yod pa bris shig ces phebs pa ltar bris nas phul ba shin tu legs 'dug ces thugs dgyes pa'i tshul stsal ba na/ phyi dang nang gi gzhung lugs rab 'byams 'dzin cing legs par 'doms pa'i dbang phyug mtshungs zlas dben pa/ gcig tu mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon chen po skye ba du ma'i tshogs bsags bsod nams kyi phung pos mnyes par bsgrub dgos pa/ rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i so so skye bo gzhan dag gis phyag rten gyi skyes bzang po dang bcas te zhal gyi dkyil 'khor thang re gnyis tsam mjal du thob cing gsung snyan thos pa tsam la'ang skal ba sbom po'i rtse mor phyin par bltar 'os pa'i yon gnas dam pa rnams kyang thugs kyi dkyil 'khor kun nas dgyes par bskyed bzod pa 'di 'dra byung ba ni skal ba bzang snyam pa byung ngo*// ring zhig nas e waṃ bla brang pas lor dar gyi dus chos chen por gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu bcas pa'i gdams ngag gi khrid chen 'chad pa'i dbu tshugs byung bar/

lung gi chos tshan chung ngu zhig tshun chad la'ang chag nongs med par legs par mnos shing dmigs rkang rnams sbyang ba'i khul byas/ 'di lor bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar zur pa rnams kyi lung phal che ba 'chad pa dang*/ kye rdo rje'i rnam bshad zla ba'i 'od zer dang*/ ngor pa'i rgyud gzhung bzhi'i lung la sogs pa gang 'gro stsal bas snga chos shin tu yun ring ba byung*/ phyi dro snang ba gsum gyi khrid kyi snga rol thams cad du rjes gnang zur pa re stsal nas khrid dmigs rnams shin tu rgyas pa mdzad byung*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa bdag byin gyis brlabs kyi rim pa'i sngon du 'gro ba lus sbyong rgyas bsdus rnams dang phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi 'khrul 'khor rnams mi dgos thabs med 'dug kyang de skabs su de'i lag len yod par brtsad cing dris par/ mi nyag pa'i dge bshes sangs rgyas tshul khrims pa min pa su la'ang bzhugs par ma thos pas lhag par nan tan gyis bslab dgos par gsol ba btab pas zhib par bka' drin stsal byung ba ltar mi brjed par byas/ phyis su rang la nad gzhi che ba lan 'ga' byung ba rnams gtan yal du 'gro nus pa dang sems can gzhan mang po la phan thogs che ba byung*/ de lo'i khams 'gros pa rnams brdzang bstar grub pa'i mtshams nas thugs brel chung bar brten/ mkhan chen khang gsar rin po che nyid nas sngar yang lan cig sbyang lor byas pa yin yang shin tu nges pa zhig ma byung bas da lam khyod kyis zhib dpyod kyis bslab grogs dgos gsungs pa ltar/ 'phags yul gyi snyan dngags mkhan chen po dpal ldan daṇ+ḍi pas byas pa'i gzhung me long rtsa 'grel gyi steng nas snyan dngags me long gi ngag khrid kho bos tshe bh+rūm̐ pa chen po 'chi med thub bstan rab gsal gyi drung nas ji ltar thos pa ltar zhib gzigs su phul ba na/ mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs chen po nyid sngar nas yon tan gyi gzhung rgya che ba dang gsung rtsom la thugs 'dris che ba'i rgyus/

'dir dper brjod yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtsom rgyug gnang ba mdzad song ba rnams la ngal dub chen po mi 'byung bar rtsom sgo yangs pa dang tshig don shin tu 'brel chags pa byung ba da lta rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum khrod na bzhugs pa gor ma chag de mthun khams kyi ldan stod yer dgyes dgon nas yin par dge slong mgul par lba ba yod pas ldan ma lba ba can nam/ gzhung chen mang po thugs su chud pas ldan ma rab 'byams zhes grags pa mtshan dngos sangs rgyas lhun grub tu bod pa de ni ji skad du/ rgyud sde'i dum bu rnam gzhag mngon rtogs dang*// stong thun gnyis kyi sa bcad bstod pa gnyis// bdag med bstod pa'i rnam 'grel dang bcas pa// kun du dgos pa'i gzhung bdun 'thor mi bya// zhes rgyud sde spyi dang bye brag tu kye rdo rje'i rgyud gsum shes par byed pa la rnam pa kun tu dgos nges pa'i gzhung bdun dang mngon par rtogs pa'i don rgyas par bshad pa'i legs bshad gong ma'i dgongs rgyan dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam rdzogs par ston par byed pa'i bstan bcos thub pa dgongs gsal dang*/ rgyan gnyis 'byed gnyis rgyud bla ma ste byams chos lnga dang*/ mdo sngags thun mong gi rnam par dbye ba ston pa sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba rnams kyi gzhung tshig tsam ma yin par de dag gi brjod bya phal che ba de dag khong du chud cing legs par smra ba la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros mtshungs zlas dben pa'i rab 'byams pa de nyid kyis brda sprod slob pa'i grogs dgos zhes byung bar/ thog mar sgra mdo ka lā pa byā ra ṇa'i mdo blor 'dzin du bcug nas/ zhwa lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang pos mdzad pa'i cha bsags bshad sbyar steng nas ri mo rdzogs par 'dri ba'i grogs bgyis/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas kyi gzhung gi steng nas bṛt+ta dzā ti'i prāstā ra'i ri mo'i 'god tshul rnams kyang brda 'phrod par bslabs/

'on kyang phyis su nga rang khams su sleb dus ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyi dogs pa 'ga' zhig skyes nas gsal byed 'bul tshul byung yang bskur rgyu ma byung bar lus song*/ slar yang snyan dngags me long gi rgyan gyi ngag khrid dgos gsungs pa ltar brel g.yeng gi gseng nas don rgyan so lnga'i 'go nas bslabs pas rtsom rgyug byed pa la dogs gnas mang pos yun 'gor tsam gyi nang nas gsal byed kyi rgyan yan tsam zhig rtsom rgyug byas/ de yan chad rgyan rnams gzhung 'grel gnyis kyi steng nas rgyan gyi 'gro yul rnams ngag bshad zhib pa tshar gcig byas nas dogs gnas rnams dris lan gyi tshul gyis nges par byas/ gnam lo me lug gi dkyil 'khor shar ba'i nang du mkhan po chen po byams pa bsod nams bzang po bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa dgung lo so dgur phebs pa na gzhung sa dang glo bo 'dzum lang rgyal po ma 'cham pa'i chings 'dums kyi 'gro don la 'byon dgos par dpal sa skya gong sogs nas nan rten phebs par brten/ 'phral nyid glo bor gdan bteg kho bor khams su 'gro ba'i rta sga 'khor tshang ma dang chas zur rnams khang gsar bla brang nyid nas 'ong rgyu'i bslab bya dang bdag la khyed kyis phan 'dogs chen po byung ba'i bka' lung snyan 'gyur rdzogs pa'i legs so dang chabs cig gnang*/ skyes bzang po zla med pa dang bka' bsgo smon lam rgyas par stsal/ skyabs mchog rgyal ba'i sras chen de nyid dang kho bo 'bral shin tu dka' ba'i skyo ba skye ba byung ngo*// mi ring bar sde dge sa skyong bstan pa tshe ring pas kyang e waṃ pa'i mkhan zur gang rung zhig bla'i mchod gnas su sde dger 'byon dgos par gzhung sa chen po dpal sa skya bcas nas dgongs pa zhus gnang byung ba ltar du/ mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub pas da bzod sa sprel gnam lo gsar tshes kyi nang du phebs par zhal gyis bzhes song ba dang mnyam du bdag kyang pha yul du 'dong chog par zhus par bka'i gnang ba stsal byung*/

bla brang mkhan chen kun mkhyen nyi ma'i rtsa lag chen po mkhan po chen po'i zhabs drung du dbang lung zhu dgos rnams zhu ba dang*/ rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab tu 'byon 'gyur gyi skyes bu dam pa/ dus gsum shes bya'i lha lam yangs par sgrib bral ye shes kyi snang ba dag pa'i ri bong 'dzin pa'i cha shas kun nas rdzogs pa gang las/ yid srubs thul gyi dbang po dgyes pa'i rnam dkar phrin las kyi bsil zer bye ba 'dzag pas/ ston mchog rgyal tshab tu bcas pa'i lugs mchog dbyar skyes sman gyi nags tshal du sman 'dogs bla na ma mchis pa'i sa dga' me tog gi dga' tshal cig car du bzhad pa thar rtse pa rje btsun nam mkha' bsam 'grub pa zhes grags pa gang de/ gzhan don la dgyes pas 'dzum pa'i zhal sgo nas legs par gdams pa'i ga pur gyi thigs pas lhung ba ni/ bya rgyud rigs gsum spyi'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa'i rtsa ba'i lha sum cu rtsa bdun/ mgron thabs kyi lha dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba gnyis dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa rnams kyi lung thos pa'i skal ba bzang ngo*// thar pa rtse zhabs drung rje btsun nam mkha' bsam 'grub pa'i zhal snga sogs nas dbang lung zhu dgos rnams gzhan gyi zhar byung la gang thob byas/ lo de'i ri klung gser dang ldan pa'i mjug der ldan a gro khang du 'dug gnas bcas te/ chos grogs dam pa skye sgu don grub gling pa'i mkhas btsun dge ba'i bshes tshul khrims phun tshogs pa sku mtshams bzhugs pa'i phyag g.yog dang stabs bder bcas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zla bsnyen sreg blugs bcas grub par byas/ bsnyen mtshams kyi sgang der nub gcig gi rmi lam du nged rang bla brang rdo cal phyi sgo'i gtsug lag khang grwa der mchis pa dang*/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub pa'ang sku la chos gos dang dbu la sa zhu dang bcas te der phebs nas/

phyag g.yas pas mi ro dgun dus kyi sha 'khyags rengs pa 'dra ba zhig gtsug lag khang gi gyang logs la brten pa'i tshul gyis mgo nas 'dzin cing*/ bdag la kho de lus kyi rtsa 'khor rnams kyi gnas tshul la sgro 'dogs dpyad na 'di ltar shes dgos so zhes g.yon pa'i phyag mdzub rtses rtsa 'khor rnams kyi thad 'di 'dra zhes ston pa na/ gang bstan pa'i phyogs kyi snying ga dang lte ba'i rtsa 'khor rnams ro de'i khog pa na ji ltar yod pa thams cad me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar phyi nang mi sgrib par gsal lam lam mthong 'ong ba zhig rmis pa/ phyis su skye sgu dge slong ba la bsnyad pas de rmis ltas shin tu bzang bas/ rdzogs rim gyi lam bsgoms na yon tan bzang po rgyud la skye ba'i rtags zhig 'dra zhes gsung gin mchis/ de las gzhan pa'i 'khrul snang bden med kyi rmi lam za zi'i snang ba ji snyed byung ba rnams ni 'ga' re brjed pa dang dran pa rnams kyang ma bris so// de nas mi ring bar bla brang chen po'i mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa nyid nas dus chos lam 'bras kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i snang ba gsum gyi khrid tshugs nas/ de mthar dbang gi sngon 'gro'i brgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis ldan gyi sems bskyed sdom pa stsal te/ dbang bskur gyi ched du bsnyen mtshams kha gso'i bcad rgyar bzhugs so// chos mtshams nas phyi lor mdo khams su bteg rgyu'i rtsis kyi slar yang dpal ldan sa skyar mdos chen gyi skabs dang bstun pas mjal kha thob pa rgyu mtshan du byas te/ lha mi'i skyabs gcig chen po'i zhal mjal zhu ba'i ched du dong ste phyin/ der lung rtogs chos kyi mnga' bdag dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba'i zhal bzang dge legs mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs shing mthong don thar pa'i snying pos lci ba nyid/ dbang po'i dwangs ma'i rdzing bur shar ba dang lhan cig srid zhi'i rgud pa 'jil ba'i phyag ring dpag bsam gyi yal ga brkyangs pa'i grib bsil du chud pa'i skal ba sbom por bskyed de slar e waṃ gyis mtshan pa'i dgon par 'ong*/

rim gyis e waṃ bla brang gzhung nas gnam lo de'i dus chos gsung ngag rin po che'i chos sbyin gyi dbu tshugs byung ba rnams slar yang chag nongs med par zab rgyas su smin par nod/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims lhun grub pa de nyid snga phyir sdom pa gsum dang rjes su 'brel ba'i chos kyi sku drin gzhal du btub na bskal pa grangs med mang por yang gzhal du mi rnyed par che ba byung*/ kho bor rtag tu gzhan dang mi 'dra bar thugs kyis brtse skyong zla med par che/ khyad par khams su 'dong khar khyod da lam khams su dal rten bskyed pa'i drin chen ma nyid yod 'dug par de nyid dang 'chi khar ma 'phrad na 'gyod gzhir 'gyur ba'i nyes pa che bas mi 'gro thabs med du mchis mod/ slad char nged rang lus bde zhing bla brang 'dir yun ring tsam bsdad par thos par gyur tshe khyed rang gis ma rgan gyi don rnams grub pa dang yar shog dang yar lam rgyu chas 'dang tsam byung na 'dir 'dug pa'i bca' lag dngos chas gang dgos nga rang gis bton te bsnyen sgrub dang mdo sngags kyi gzhung la blo 'dzin rtun pa bskyed na rje rdo rje 'chang gi bstan par phan 'dogs 'byung ba'i re ba byed/ de ltar byung na don chen yin no// nga rang yang tshe gcig sgrub pa byed pa zhig byung na bsam don snying por mchis mod/ da ni las 'dzin 'di 'dra zhig gis khur len byed dgos pa re mos bab phyin rang lus gang lcogs shig gi bar du chos 'chad nyan ci nus shig rtsol ba byed rtsis yin pas de lugs yid 'jog gyis/ zhes thugs shes bya ji snyed mkhyen pa'i klong yangs nas nye bar 'phos pa'i legs 'doms kyi zil mngar/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug don gyi srog 'tshor gyur pa ci yang gdams te bka' bsgo smon lam legs par stsal to// hor zla bzhi pa'i dus tshes bzang por mkhan chen 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub pa sku 'khor du bcas pas sde dger chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba dang mnyam du ji skad du/

gus pa'i pho nyas mgron gnyer lam ring gis// ngal brgya'i khur bcas lam du bgrod ma thag /thos bsam bsgom pa'i bya ba lhur byed las// tshe 'di'i zang zing g.yeng ba ngang gis spong*// bud shing la sogs nyer spyad btsal dka' bas// bza' btung rnyed bkur lhur byed mi 'du zhing*// dbang lung man ngag chos kyi char che bas// thar 'dod skal ldan skye bo ngang gis 'du// zhes sogs kyis mngon par bsngags pa'i dben pa'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid kun nas rdzogs shing nye bar brten na/ legs pa'i yon tan yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bye ba'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa/ saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du e waṃ ma ya shrū taṃ zhes pa/ bod skad du 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes bya ba la sogs pas dam pa'i chos thams cad kyi 'byung sgor gyur pa'i gleng gzhi'i sgra don can gyi 'phags pa'i bsti gnas dam pa de nyid nas bteg ste rta babs su ngor gyi bla brang khag khang tshan so so nas/ mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po phebs skyel bar ngur smrig bla gos thogs pa'i 'dus tshogs thun mtshams sprin gyi dmar mdangs gzhon nus phyogs kyi kā shi mdzes dga'i mkhur tshos rnam par brgal ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bkab pa lta bu'i tshogs kyis ja chang gi phud ka mang po dang khams bzang zhu ba'i bsgrigs dar sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ris gsar pa lta bu dag dang*/ kho bo cag la'ang dge legs 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel ched du bsgrigs pa med par lhun gyis grub pa rang 'grigs su byung snyam pa'i dga' ba dang spro ba lhan cig brtas pa zhig byung ngo*// der ma zad mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal pos thog drangs pa'i 'dus tshogs de dag thams cad kyis spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams las rnam par rgyal ba'i bkra shis kyi sgra dbyangs srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du lud par 'gyur ba snyam byed pa dang*/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa rgyas par 'gyur ba dang*/

bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi tshogs chos spyod kyi bya ba dang bcas pa 'phel rgyas su 'gyur ba dang*/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tu gyur pa rnams dang*/ 'jig rten khams kyi bde legs su bcas pa phyogs thams cad nas dar rgyas su 'gyur ba'i gsol 'debs kyi gdangs snyan 'bum phrag bsgyur ba rnams kyang ched du gnyer ba med pa stabs 'grigs kyi rten 'brel legs pa'i sgo 'phar brgya stong dus gcig tu phye ba lta bu zhig ni byung ngo*// de nas bzung ste mgyogs 'gro'i theg pa dang rkang thang gi bgrod pa spel mas 'ongs pa na/ bdag gi mgyogs 'gro khang gsar bla brang nas gnang ba nyid snga mo nas smyung bar gnas pa'i bslab bya blangs pas/ kho bo'i gzugs ljid theg pa lta zhog kho rang gi sga stan tsam gyi khur 'degs pa la'ang kha drin brtsi ba bzhin du lus grabs byung*/ bla brang dang phyag mdzod dam chos bcas la ni rang rta dang bsu rta bsdams pa'i brje lan byed rgyu bcas lhag yan mang po 'dug kyang*/ snga sor nga rang la sde dger phyag g.yog rtag 'dug byed par 'gro na gos rgyug gnang ba sogs bdag rkyen 'ong zhes nan gyis gsungs kyang de ltar khas ma blangs/ de'i ngo mnongs lta bus rta g.yar ni zhu ma spobs/ rta lus po 'di la thabs ci drag zhus par/ sman tshe kha gang gnang nas 'di gu ru bkra shis la zhog la rta lus po 'di la ja thang zhig bskol nas ldud pa'i bdag rkyen zhus zhes gdams ngag de bslab byung ba ltar byas pas dgongs ja lan gnyis gnang song bas/ phyi nyin nas khrid lam du gom pa 'dor thub tsam byung ba khrid kyin rkang thang gi 'gros dal gyis mdzo khal 'ded pa rnams kyi rkang rjes snyegs tsam byung*/ rong po 'dam phyin chad rtswa kha rgyas pa'i zas sne zin tsam nas/ sha lus 'tsho ba nas rim gyis nga rang gi gzugs ljid 'degs pa'i grogs ldan pa la rta rgan kho rang nyid drin che ba byung*/

rgyab dus phyag tsha gu ru bkra shis par dpon dang nga rang zhus dag par byas tshe/ de dus khyed la dka' las byung song yang phyag mdzod dam chos sogs kyis khyod de ltar yin tshul sgros tsam yang btang ma byung ma gtogs/ rta yan mang po yod pas phan thogs pa yod tsam zhes 'gyod kyin 'dug go /'on kyang lag do sogs kyi las 'gan ci yang med pas thugs dam kha 'don gyi rigs chag nongs ma shor bar rim gyis dge rgyas rdza dkar nag yan chad du gzugs gzhi bde mor byung bar/ de mtshams bla brang gi 'gel g.yag rked tshigs chag pa'i nang khrol dmar tshod bskol ba zhig lag do rnams la 'gyed pa'i skal ba nod byung ba btung bas rkyen byas pa lta bus/ bza' btung gang byas 'phral nyid nas skyugs par lud pa'i nad gzhis thebs/ par thang stod nas mkhan chen sku 'khor bcas dang so sor gyes te ldan ma'i 'gros pa dang bsdongs nas 'ongs par a gro rong du bsu rta slebs pa bcas rang khyim du 'byor/ 'on kyang bro 'tshal gyi gzhi de bad kan smug po'i gzhi chen gyur nas sman bcos pas kyang lo grangs brgyad dgu tsam du zas 'dzem dang sman dpyad la brtson na min par cir 'gyur mi shes pa'i gzhi che zhes mthun par smra ba byung*/ dngos su'ang zas zos pa nyid kyang ltor mi chags par de ma thag tu lud cing lus stobs kyang nyin re zhing je chung la shin tu rgud por song*/ rgyun par bsten pa'i 'tsho byed pas kyang sman pa gzhan zhig la gcar na min pa bdag gis ni de las lhag pa'i bya thabs ma shes zhes gsung 'dug de 'phral sman dpyad thams cad bzhag nas gur mgon brag rdzong gi bsnyen mtshams sbags te gsung ngag lam 'bras pa'i lugs kyi lus sbyong rgyas bsdus dang phrin las so gnyis kyi 'khrul 'khor sbyangs pa gtso bor byas pas mi ring bar bza' btung dwangs ka 'byed cing phal cher zhu gnas 'bab pa sogs byung bas mthar gyis zla ba gcig dang zhag po bcu skor tsam nas lus la nad kyi rnam pa ci yang med pa'i bde ba dang ldan par gyur pa dkon mchog la blo gtod byas pa'i thugs rje dang gdams ngag gi byin rlabs 'phral nyid du gzugs can lta bur mngon sum du snang ba zhig byung*/

sngar gyi 'tsho byed mkhas pa rnams kyang ngo mtshar shin tu skyes nas gdams ngag rlung gi nus pa la 'di 'dra skyabs su mchi/ de min nged lha rje rnams kyi sman dpyad kyis ni bskal pa'i gangs rgan nyi ma'i drod kyis cung zad re bzhu bas 'dzad sgugs byed pa lta bur rgyun bsrings na ma gtogs nad gzhi chen po de la bya thabs ci yod ces smra ba zhig byung ngo*// de nas rag chu rnam rgyal dgon du bstan pa rin po che la sman 'dogs sgrub pa'i lhag bsam dge ba'i lang tsho dar babs a dran dge slong phrin las phun tshogs pa rang nyid la thob pa byung ba'i dngos rdzas rnams kyis/ rag chu rnam rgyal dgon gyi gtsug lag khang gi phug na lha khang ka ba zung gis mngon par bteg pa zhig gsar du bskrun pa'i nang du/ bdag cag gi ston pa mchog gi sngon rabs skye ba bzhengs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i skyes rabs brgya phrag gcig dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang bcas pa ldeb ris su 'dri ba'i kha ta pa dang gtso bo 'dzin pa lhan cig par byed dgos zhes phebs par song*/ der 'bri chu gdags kyi gzhi ru lha ris pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho khu tsha gnyis dang sga stod pa'i lha bzo gcig karma'i mda' nag gi lha bzo tshe ring bsam 'grub pa dpon g.yog gnyis nged cag ser skya gsum bcas te/ kho bos gtso bo dang g.yas logs rnams bzung ste ngag gi bkod pa byas nas bris pas legs rab zhig byung song*/ der sde dge'i phyogs nas gnyer pa gzungs rgyal ba'i bla ma ldan ma sangs rgyas dpal bzang zhes bya ba'i mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan bye bas 'byor pa de nyid der byon byung ba dang stabs 'grigs byung ba'i rten 'brel legs mtshon du lha khang che thon tsam gyi dus nas gtso bo rnams kyi spyan phye ste/ bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid kyis rab gnas nyin gang pa zhig mdzad pas kho bos bla ma de nyid zhal mjal ba'i thog ma byung zhing*/

chos kyi gleng ba'i dri tshig nyung shas phul bas lan 'debs dang thugs dgyes chen po byung song lo rgyus thos/ ngor gyi zur chos pa mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub pa sku 'das pa'i pur ras kha gang dpal ldan chos skyong pa nas stsal ba yod par/ nga rang gis dad rten du gur mgon lha brgyad dmag zor dur khrod bdag po/ steng gi char bla ma 'ga' re dang*/ kye rdo rje lha dgu phyag rdor dang bcas pa tshang ba nag thang du byas nas bris pa phyis su bla ma sangs rgyas dpal bzang pas thugs dgyes par brten der phul/ de nyid nas kyang khang gsar mkhan chen byams pa bsod nams bzang po pas bzhes nas thugs dam rten byas par grags/ de rjes mi ring bar slar yang blo ster zur phud lnga ldan lhag pa'i lha gang de/ deng 'dir phyi nang gtsug lag gi gzhung lugs rab 'byams kyi bzhed pa rnam par 'grel ba'i slad du gnas lnga rig pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta'i skye bar bzhes shing*/ gcig tu brtson ldan dag la tshe gcig nyid du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi go sar sbyin nges pa gsang ba chen po rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa'i rigs kyi cod paṇa dam pa 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang pas sa dkar du byon nas khong gis sgra ma gtogs par snyan dngags bslab ma zin pas khyod kyis snyan dngags slob pa'i grogs dgos zhes bka' stsal gnang ba ltar/ snyan dngags me long gi gzhung 'grel steng nas phul te/ rtsom rgyug blang zhing bsgrims pas don rgyan so lnga'i rab brtag rgyan gyi bar slebs tsam byung ba dang gzhal yas blos bslang gi skor nas kyang dogs gcod mdzad dgos rnams kyang gang dgos zhus/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag bla ma de nyid nas der dgon pa'i grwa pa yongs rdzogs la kye rdor rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur nyer lnga'i tshan grangs gsum tsam mdzad/ kho bos zhus pa'i ngor grwa pa bdun tsam la nā ro mkha' spyod rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi khrid rgyas pa nyin bcu gcig tsam la mdzad/

gzhan yang rjes gnang mkho dgos 'ga' re stsal ba'ang thos/ de mtshams nas sa dkar gyi grwa mang 'byon pa'i nus yod pa sde dge lhun grub steng du/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub pa zhal mjal du 'byon pa dang mnyam du bsdongs nas kho bo'ang zhal mjal tsam du phyin pa na/ bdag la khyod kyis 'dir lo gnyis gsum zhig tu drung yig byed pa dang*/ kye rdo rje'i rnam bshad zla zer par gzhi bris yod pa la'ang zhus dag gi grogs ldan bcas dgos pas yar 'gro mi chog gsung byung bar/ bdag gi sha nye dge slong bsod nams byams pa can gyis kyang khyod 'dir sdod pa shin tu phangs che ba mchis na'ang mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang 'di nyid dang khyed gnyis sngar ngor du bzhugs pa nas brtsams te chos dam tshig bzang pos legs par sbrel 'dug pa bla ma'i bka' bzhin ma bsgrubs na dam tshig dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa shin tu lci bas re zhig sdod la/ slar yang kye rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen sngon du thon dgos pas de'i tshe dgongs pa zhus nas rang yul du mtshams bsdad pa dga' zhes dang*/ de ltar snyan sgron du phul song ba de ltar du chog par gnang*/ de skabs su'ang sa dkar ba'i grwa pa rnams dang mnyam du kye rdo rje'i rgyu dus dang lam dus kyi dbang bskur stsal ba thob/ yar klungs bkra shis chos ldan gyi zhabs drung yongs rdzogs bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag tu gyur cing legs par smra ba'i ngag gi dbang phyug chen po grub pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas pa nyid kyang der bzhugs pa'i drung du chos 'brel du kha'u brag rdzong lugs kyi mgon po khro bcu'i rjes gnang zhus nas gnang ba thob/ de nas brtsams te kho bos mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang ba'i sku drung du bsdad cing gtso cher kye rdo rje bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad zla zer gyi zhu dag dang par byang bcas pa dang le'u tho brgyab pa dang*/

bskur yig 'dri ba sogs gang 'os bgyis/ gang gi tshe kho bo phan bde gling bla brang gi gnyer mdzod khang du rnam par bshad pa zla ba'i 'od zer gyi zhu dag sogs byed kyin bsdad par/ de'i dus na bdag cag gis tha ma'i ka'i du ba sred pas rngubs kyin yod pa'i dus yin pas/ nub cig gi rmi lam du/ 'dug gnas de nyid du nga rang bsdad yod pa'i snang bar/ der bu mo gzhon nu ma lo bcu drug tsam lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan ma gzugs po thung tsam mdzes pa'i lus la gos dkar po ha cang gsar pa rang yang min pa zhig gyon pa/ rgyan cha cung zad tsam las sgeg 'chos su ma byas pa cig dal gyis byung nas/ nga rang gi mal khri'i glo skyor gyi steng der ming sring gi snang ba ltar stegs 'dug zhig byas nas/ shin tu dal ba'i nyams kyis bdag la rig byed pa'i gtam rgyud snyan po mi 'dra ba mang zhig gleng gin bag phab nas bsdad yod par/ nga rang gi gtam rgyud de ma mnyan pa'i zhar la'ang sngar gyi bag chags ngan par goms pa'i shugs kyis tha ma'i ka zhig rngubs bsams nas du ra de lag tu blangs pa'i snang ba zhig byung ba dang*/ bu mo de ma thag par langs te/ phu dung gi nang nas yi ge 'dri ba'i smyu gu mtho gang cung med tsam zhig blangs nas nga rang gi pang thog der bskyur nas shar gyis song ba'i snang ba zhig shar te/ gang gi tshe tha ma'i ka'i du ba rngubs pa des gegs su gyur pa de lta min na/ bu mo de lha mo dbyangs can ma'i sgyu 'phrul zhig yin pa 'dra bas de las dngos grub mchog cig thob rgyu yin nam snyam ste/ sngar ngor du bsdad pa'i skabs nas kyang mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub pa'i zhal nas bdag la khyod snyan dngags mkhan ni/ dbyangs can mas rjes su 'dzin yang los 'dzin mod/ khyod lha mo dbyangs can mas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rtags kyi rmi lam zhig nga la byung gsungs pa dang mthun par byung ba'i phyir/

'on te yi ge 'dri ba'i smyu gu byin pa de ni da ltar rtsom chos phran tshegs 'di rnams 'dri rgyu 'ong ba'i mtshan ltas su yin nam snyam pa byung*/ rig byed pa'i gtam rgyud snyan po de rnams rmi lam du gsal po 'dra zhig yod kyang gnyid sad pa na ci yang mi dran par brjed ngas kyi dbang du song ngo*// mkhan chen nyid nas kyang sngar ngor du bzhugs skabs nas snyan ngag gi don rgyan so lnga'i dbu nas cung zad gzigs pa de'i 'phro nas/ rang bzhin brjod pa dang dpe rgyan dang gzugs can gyi skor sogs mkho che ba 'ga' re nas thor tsam re'i ngag khrid 'bul ba'i tshul yang byas/ skabs der 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa de nyid kyang phan bde gling bla brang du byon nas yun ring tsam bzhugs pa gnang song ba de'i tshe'ang sngar gyi snyan dngags don rgyan gyi 'phro lus pa nas rtsom rgyug gnang ba'i dogs dpyod kyi zhabs phyi zhus par da dung yang smad nas cung zad ma rdzogs lus pa dang*/ lam 'bras lugs kyi lus sbyong rgyas bsdus dang phrin las so gnyis kyi 'khrul 'khor rnams kyang gzigs pa'i thugs rtsol mdzad pa bzhin 'bul ba'i tshul byas/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid kyi drung nas gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags pa'i lugs mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang dang beg tse lcam dral rjes gnang dang*/ kye rdo rje'i gtso che'i chos sna sum cu'i lugs sogs nos tshul 'ga' re dang rdo rje 'chang rong po sangs rgyas bstan pa nas kye rdo rje'i rgyu dbang thob/ slar yang rje btsun de nyid 'khor lo mdo'i pho brang du phebs pa dang*/ nga rang ldan yul du chos 'khor dbon gyi blon po ja'i sang dbon po zhes bya bas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sngon gyi skyes rabs brgya rtsa mdzad pa bcu gnyis bcas pa'i thang ka dgu tsam nga rang gi lag bstar byas pa zhig bri rogs dgos zhes byung bar khas btsan che ba'i dbang du song bas mi bri dbang med byas 'dug pa de dbyar ngo der bri ba'i ched du 'gro ba'i lam zhor la 'khor lo mdor zhag nyi shu skor tsam bsdad nas/

snyan dngags don rgyan gyi 'phro dang sgra rgyan sogs kyi khrid rdzogs par phul/ brag rdzong gi rjes gnang phyi khrid shin tu rgyas pa/ nang khrid drag po sngags rgod/ gsang khrid sems nyid ye shes kyi rtsal 'don bcas pa'i nyams khrid rgyas pa dang*/ kye rdo rje'i gtso che'i chos sna sum cu'i glegs bam dang*/ mgon dkar dang dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub skor dang*/ dbyu gu spun gsum gyi sgrub skor gyi lung sogs thob pa dang*/ gzhan yang rdo rje 'jigs byed drug cu pa dang mgon po che chung du grags pa'i bskang gso'i dbyangs dang rol mo rnams rang gis bslab sbyong dgos pa rnams kyang de nyid kyi zhal snga nas bslab sbyangs byas/ der yod skabs sde dge'i dgon chen nas bka' 'gyur ro cog gi zhus dag pa bla ma kar+m+ma dpal grub pas/ mkhan po rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub pa'i sku bstod rje rang gis mdzad pa de nga la bskur nas tshigs bcad sh+lau ka lnga po 'di la skad gnyis shan sbyar sdeb sbyor dang bcas bsgrigs nas bskur cig ces sde dge'i mdun chen nas bka' gsung phebs pas 'phral du bsgyur la bskur thong zhes bya ma rta bcas mngags byung ba'i ngor/ ji ltar phebs don gyi bstod pa de la skad gnyis shan sbyar byas pa da ltar par du bkod pa 'di ko bsgrigs nas phul bar thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dgyes sam ma yin cir gyur ni ma 'tshal to// de nas rim gyis rang yul du bteg nas sdum par phyin to// mi ring bar 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa nyid kyang der byon nas ngan song thams cad sbyong ba'i rgyud nas bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis ras bris la brten pa'i dbang rnams grwa rigs sbyin pa'i bdag por bcas la nyer lnga'i tshan pa gnyis bstar ba de'i tshe kho bos kyang legs par mnyan te/ lo de'i dbyar ngor ston pa'i skyes rabs brgya rtsa thang sku rnams bris zin par byas nas sbyin bdag la phul lo// dgun ngo der bsnyen mtshams shig la bsdad/

dpyid kar mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang gi bka' 'phran thogs pa'i 'bod par bang mis slebs pa dang lhan cig tu mkhan chen pa'i sku rtsar dong ste phyin nas bsdad/ der gang 'tsham bgyi bar 'os pa'i zhabs phyi rnams snga mkho bzhin dang*/ mkhan chen pa'i gsung 'bum thor bu 'ga' re'i zhu dag bgyis/ phyag mdzod dam chos can dbus gtsang phyogs kyi yon gnas dam pa rnams su 'bul skyel brdzang ba'i dus kyi mchod rdzas gos yol dang bla re dang*/ gos 'phan dang snyan dar gyi rigs ji snyed mchis pa rnams la yan lag bdun pa dang*/ 'dod gsol zhal byang du bcas pa 'dri dgos pa rnams dang*/ gdan sa gong dang gzhung sa chen po rtse shod dang*/ rgyal mtshan mthon po dang*/ ngor bla brang khag rnams su dbul rgyu'i zhu yig gi rigs rnams bris so// ston mjug der rang nyid lhag pa'i lha kye rdo rje'i gzhi'i bsnyen pa bya ba'i phyir/ slar yang mkhan po chen po rdo rje 'chang ba nyid dang*/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang ste mkhan slob gnyis ka nas lam dbang dang*/ lam 'bras mgon rkyang gi rjes su gnang ba dang bcas pa'i zhu dgos dang dogs dpyad dgos pa rnams zhus grub nas rang gnas sa dkar dgon du 'ongs pa na/ sga thag lung du klu sdings bla brang pa'i 'bul sdud par phan khang dbon po dpal ldan chos skyong pas bzhugs yod pa nyid/ skabs der chos grwa btsugs nas bzhugs pa dang mjal zhing*/ gzhi bsnyen mtshams kyi sngon 'gro gtor ma btang ba dang*/ the tshom dogs gnas langs pa rnams der yang dpyad nas bcad rgyar zhugs pas/ zla ba bdun gyi nang du sngags grangs thems pa zhi ba'i sbyin sreg nyin gsum pa zhig bcas grub par byas/ de'i sngon zhig tu chos 'khor ba'i dpon bstan 'dzin gyis dge slong dkar sdog ces pa gnyer pa chos skyong blo gros pa'i gnyen tshan dang mgo gtad byas pa gnyis ka yin pa zhig bsad pa'i rtsod gzhi byung bas/

sa dkar pho brang nang nas sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' blo gros pa'i sku gdung gser zangs kyi mchod rten phal thog gcig lhag tsam yod pa/ gang de bzhugs su gsol ba'i lha khang dang bcas chos skyong blo gros par 'bul dgos par sde dge sa skyong chen po'i bka' khrims kyis bcad pa na/ gser gyi mchod sdong gi nang rten chos kyi sku'i ring bsrel gsar bsgrigs dang*/ sngar yod pa mi srun gyis dbrog pa bcas tshur bsdus nas gsar du phul bar mdzad de/ lha khang mchod sdong dang bcas pa'i rab gnas cho ga rag chu'i sa skya'i 'bul sdud bla ma slob dpon du bzhugs pa'i 'dus tshogs rags btus kyis rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga nyin gsum pa zhig mdzad pa'i gral du phyin/ gang gi tshe sde dge'i mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang ba'i sku rtsar bcar sdod dgos pa'i bsu rta bcas bskur nas 'phral du 'ong dgos pa'i bka' lung gis nye bar son pa bzhin/ gnyer pa blo gros pa dang bsdongs nas mkhar gsum mdor brgyud nas rim gyis skyabs mchog dam pa'i zhabs kyi chu skyes la bsnyen te gang 'tsham gyi zhabs phyi rnams snga mkho bzhin bsgrubs/ de'i dus su'ang 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang pas phan bde gling bla brang du byon nas mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang ba nyid nas rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga gsang 'dus pa ye shes zhabs pa'i lugs kyi dbang bskur dang*/ gser chos dmar mo skor gsum dang dmar chung ma skor gsum gyi byin rlabs/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa lha mangs rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba dang*/ rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po pa'i bka' 'bum thor bu/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog pas bsgrigs pa'i gdams ngag gi khrid brgya rtsa brgyad pa rnams kyi bklag lung dang*/ gzhan yang mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas chen por dbang bsgyur zhing*/

rmad byung mkhas pa'i phrin las dag byed kyi rgyun chen phyogs brgyar 'bebs pas zla bral bstan pa'i srog 'tshor byed pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'i chu bdag gi dbang phyug rje bkra shis bzang po pa nas/ 'khor lo bde mchog grub chen nag po pa'i lugs dang*/ bong zhal can gyi dbang bskur gsan pa rnams dang*/ gnas skabs gzhan dag tu'ang 'dren mchog mkhas btsun bzang po de nyid las/ dpal kye rdo rje rgyu dus dang lam dus kyi dbang gnyis/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho lha nyis stong lnga brgya'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ gshin rje'i dgra nag po lha bcu gsum pa'i dbang*/ gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dbang dang*/ spros med kyi khrid nges don rdo rje'i them skas kyi steng nas nyams khrid stsal ba/ rgyab brten lung gi skor 'ga' re dang bcas pa/ jo bo rje'i lugs kyi gsang ba 'dus pa spyan ras gzigs lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ gur gyi mgon po lha bcu gnyis pa'i rjes gnang ngor lugs dang*/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i dkar po tshe 'phel/ ser po rgyas byed/ dmar po dbang sdud/ sngon po bgegs 'joms te bzhi dang*/ gnyen sgrol yan lag drug pa dang*/ grwa pa mngon shes pa'i lugs kyi dzam+bha la dmar po dang*/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba dang*/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster gyi tshe dbang*/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed chen po'i byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa legs par phog nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i lung dang*/ dgra bcom pa blo gros dpal gyi lo rgyus can gyi sgra mi snyan gyi rang gzungs dang*/ tshe sgrub zab mo sa skya pa'i gdams pa ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis grub rgyal gling pa sa rgyal gyi thugs dam du gnang ba rnams kyi lung rnams thob bo// gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bka' lung rin po che dang dgongs 'grel bstan bcos tshogs kyi thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son cing*/

mkhas btsun grub pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rje nam mkha' dpal bzang pa nas/ dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga'i gsung rab rin po che po ti bcu drug gi lung rnams phan bde gling bla brang du bzhugs nas stsal ba rnams kyang tshang bar legs par thob/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po 'dis kho bo rjes su bskyangs pas dus gzhan dang gzhan dag gi tshe'ang grub chen lū hi pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba/ sgrol ma bla med kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor/ rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor rnams su dbang bskur ba/ pu tra ming sring dang*/ dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor ma/ beg tse 'khor mangs rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba dang*/ grub thob lugs kyi tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster gyi tshe dbang rnams thob/ bdud sde 'joms pa'i shan pa'i steng nas dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i gsang khrid dang*/ lung la rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen pa'i bka' 'bum/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub pa'i bka' 'bum/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub skor phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa rwa pod du grags pa'i glegs bam gong ma/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub skor po ti/ gnod sbyin beg tse lcam sring gi sgrub skor po ti/ bha ya nā sa'i sbyin sreg 'jam dpal mtshan brjod dang mdo sdud pa la sogs chos chung gi lung sngar ma thos pa rnams kyi lung gi chos kyi bdud rtsi mang du thos pa'i bka' drin gzhal du med par che ba byung ngo*// de dag gi gsing nas sngar blo 'dzin ma grub par ngor pa'i rgyud gzhung bzhir grags pa'i nang nas sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba dang*/ tshul dang po gsum mdzes pa'i rgyan dang*/

ljon shing mdzes pa'i rgyan gnyis blor 'dzin pa'i khul bgyis/ gang gi tshe bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa'i zhal snga nas 'di skad du mchid pa thos te/ khyod kyis rtsom chos byas pa'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ 'dod gsol gyi rigs dang yig lan bris pa bla ma mi chen 'ga' zhig la 'bul rgyu'i zhu yig bris pa rnams dpe chod byas pa yod dam zhes phebs par/ ci yang bris pa med do zhus par/ de lta'i le lo byed pa de ma legs/ da lta phan chad du gang bris pa rnams dpe chod tsam re byas nas slar phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas bzhag na/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na'ang*/ zhu yig la sogs pa la'ang grong tshig gi brjod pa dang sla chos su byas par mi 'gro bar skad gnyis sbyar ba dang snyan dngags kyi rgyan las drangs nas grwa sa chen po'i yig bskur lugs kyi bstan pa'i srol rgyun bzang po mi nub par gnas pa'i ched dang*/ blo gsal gzhan dag la'ang phan pa'i rgyur 'gro bas de ltar yig 'jog gyis zhes bkas gnang ba stsal ba bcas sngar bris pa rnams ni bstod pa gnyis gsum tsam min pa nyar tshag ma chud la/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa lug gi bgrang gzhi shar ba mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub pa sku gshegs rjes kyi tshun nas zhu yig tshig lhug pa bsgrigs legs byas pa rnams kyang dgos pa chung bar bsams nas ma bris pa dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa'ang snga mgyogs su btang dgos pa rnams dang*/ 'dri bar mi 'os pa'i rigs 'ga' ni ma bris kyang de dag ma yin pa'i thun mong du 'dri bar 'os pa'i rigs dang don gnyer dag gi ngor/ 'don chog pa rnams kyis lag tu mi longs pa'i rigs kyi gsal byed dang*/ gdon bya rgyas bsdus bar ma'i rnam par gzhag pa'i gsal byed dgos pa'i rigs dang*/ bsngags 'os rnams la bstod pa dang*/ gsol mchod la sogs pa'i cho ga gsar bskrun byas pa nyung shas byung ba 'ga' re rnams/

rang dang rang gi nye bar gnas pa dge slong kun dga' bsam gtan dang*/ lhun grub phun tshogs gnyis kyis rang gis bris pa gzhan 'drir bcug nas bsags pa'i khul byas pa rnams da ltar glegs bam du bsgrigs pa 'di dag lags so// slar yang mi ring bar mkhan chen pa'i bkas/ sa dkar dgon du gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang*/ bde mchog nag po lugs gnyis kyi sgrub mchod cig gsar 'dzugs byed pa byung na byin rlabs phan yon che zhing grwa sa'i slob gnyer 'phel ba'i rgyur 'gro bas/ 'di nas kyang zhal gsos sogs kyi phan 'dogs bgyid par bka' phebs par/ de ltar du bgyir btub pa dpal bzang pa dang nged gnyis char gyis gsol bas/ de dag gi dbang bskur mdzad par 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa nyid brdzang ba dang mnyam du bdag gis kyang pha yul du song*/ der sha nye dge slong bsod nams byams pa can 'bam nad tshabs can gyis zin par/ rkyen sel dang gso dpyad kyis ma 'tshos par snga lam du yol/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa nyid nas rnam shes gnas spor gyi gdams pa 'bogs pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur dang*/ phung po sreg blugs dang*/ rus bu sbyong ba/ sāts+tsha'i cho gar bcas pa'i sdig sbyong rnams yang dag par stsal ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ dus 'das nyid sdig sgrib ji ltar che na'ang ngan 'gro'i skye sgo khegs tsam 'byung snyam pa'i nges shes skye ba zhig mdzad song*/ gang gi tshe 'dren mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid nas kho bor bka' stsal phebs par lam 'bras pa'i lugs kyi lus sbyong dang 'khrul 'khor 'di rnams deng sang shin tu nyag phra bar song bas khyod kyis 'di rnams la byang chub par slob cig ces bka' stsal ba ltar/ zul sga len steng nas byon pa'i bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug pa dang*/ bla ma bzang po bkra shis pa/ rje nyid kyi sku dbon bla ma tshul khrims dbang phyug

byang sgo'i dge slong la sogs pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la/ lus sbyong rgyas bsdus 'khrul 'khor bcas pa rnams zhib par phul/ sa dkar dgon gyi 'dus tshogs su kun rig gi cho ga stong tshar dang*/ zhe dgu'i dgung tshigs cho ga bcas btang bar bsnyen bkur 'bul nod gzabs par phul/ 'bri chu gdags kyi rag chu dang chos sde dgon gyi grwa pa rnams kyis zhus ngor/ 'dren mchog dam pa de nyid nas zab chos ni gu chos drug gi sgyu lus dbang chen sngon du btang ba'i ni gu chos drug gi nyams khrid stsal ba'i dmigs khrid so so'i thad nas dgos bka'i byin gyis brlabs kyi rigs gang dgos rnams stsal te/ de'ang khog phub kyi nang tshan bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang bzhi lus bsgrigs kyi byin rlabs/ grol byed khrid la mkhas grub rgyal mtshan 'bum gyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig dang*/ grub chen thang stong rgyal pos mdzad pa'i gnad yig snying po kun 'dus kyi steng nas rtsa ba ni gu chos drug gi khrid/ yal ga lam khyer rnam gsum/ 'bras bu lus sems 'chi med/ sdong po phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i khrid rnams brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes kyis brgyan pa legs par thob cing khrid gzhung de dang 'brel bar/ nyon mongs pa'i rtsa mdud 'grol bar byed pa gtum mo'i dbang*/ nyin par gyi 'khrul pa zlog par byed pa sgyu lus kyi dbang*/ gnyid kyi 'khrul pa bzlog pa'i phyir rmi lam gyi dbang*/ gti mug gi mun pa bsang ba'i phyir 'od gsal bde chen gyi dbang*/ btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir 'pho ba'i dbang*/ srid pa bar do dag pa'i phyir bar do'i dbang dang bcas pa'i dgos bka' drug ste gzhung shing chen po dang 'brel ba'i bka' brgyad/ phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i dbang*/ bla ma lam khyer gyi dbang*/ yi dam lam khyer gyi dbang*/ sgyu ma lam khyer gyi dbang*/ lus sems 'chi med kyi dbang ste phyag rgya chen po'i bka' lnga dang*/

bde mchog lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi dbang*/ bde mchog gsang sgrub kyi dbang*/ rnam 'joms gsang sgrub kyi dbang*/ phyag rdor gsang sgrub skor lnga stsal ba rnams te lung gi skor ma gtogs pa phal cher rdzogs par nod/ kho bo cag gis gsol ba btab ngor thugs rje chen po bod kyi grub chen gnyen tshem bu pa'i lugs kyi smar khrid/ mkhas grub chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas mdzad pa'i nges don dpyid kyi thig le dang*/ sgrub khang dpal ldan pas mdzad pa'i khrid yig snying po gsal ba bsdebs pa'i sgo nas legs par stsal to// de mthar tshad med thugs rje'i bdag nyid can gyi 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid ngur smrig 'chang ba mchog gi skye ba'i zlos gar gyis slar yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che mkhas pa'i bya bas bskyang ba dang*/ 'gro ba rgya mtsho lta bu dag mngon par mtho ba dang*/ nges par legs pa'i lam du smin pa dang*/ grol bar byed pa'i lam gyi snang byed chen po bkye ba'i dgongs pas/ dpal ldan sa skya dang*/ ngor e waṃ chos ldan phyogs su byon nas bzhugs par thugs rje gtad nas dbus gtsang phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur bar 'gru mda'i bar du phebs skyel bgyis/ re zhig rang gi bsti gnas su sos dal bsnyen mtshams spel mar byas nas bsdad cing*/ de dag gi skabs su ma zad mkhan po chen po rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub pa de nyid las sngar yang lan gcig thob cing*/ phyis su sku dbon sangs rgyas ye shes pa la jo bo a ti sha'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig dang*/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes su gnang ba rnams sku mtshams kyi 'og nas mdzad pa rnams kyang*/ nged gnyis kho na la gnang ba'i dus su sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang gi skabs shig tu mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid kyi zhal nas 'di skad cig tu mchid pa thos te/ nga la mdang rmi lam du brag gi ngos 'dra ba zhig nas chu 'go phyug po gnyis chab kyi sgra shin tu snyan pa 'byin cing lhug lhug 'bab kyin yod pa'i sgang de la/

ring zhig nas chu 'go gcig de rbad kyis chad de chu thigs cung zad re min pa 'bab rgyu med par song ba zhig rmis pa de su la blta ba yin zhes gsung gin 'dug par/ bdag gis deng gi dus na nged gnyis la rjes gnang mdzad pa'i sgang du song bas/ mnal ltas de nged gnyis la blta'am zhus pas de yin dgos rgyu 'dra zhes gsung ngo*// 'on kyang chu 'go 'bab rgyun chad 'gro ba de su zhig la blta rgyur ni ma shes shing der zhu yang ma spobs so// rjes sor mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan nas/ mkhan po dpal ldan chos skyong pas 'dir byon nas 'tsho gzhes su bzhugs pa na/ nga rang gis snga mkho'i dgongs 'grel rin po che'i zhus dag rnams grub nas/ de'i dkar chag rtsom pa'i bar der/ bdag nad gzhi che tsam zhig gis re zhig mnar bar byung ba'i rkyen sel gyi ched du/ sde dge bla ma chen po kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i sdes par khang nas btang sgo spom chen mdzad pa dang*/ rang gi lus chas dang bdog pa thams cad spong dag tu bcas te ring 'tsho bsgrub dgos byung ba'i skabs der/ sngar mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub pa'i mnal lam de nga rang la gegs chag che ba yod par blta rgyu yin nam snyam pa byung mod/ phyis su brtags pa na nges par 'jam dbyangs chos kyi bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes par bltas song ste/ khong nyid rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las dang gzhan don shin tu rgyas par bzhugs pa'i khar/ ngor du mkhan po'i khri la bzhugs tshar tsam na gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su yal ba byung ba'i phyir/ de dag las gzhan pa'i gnas skabs rnams su'ang bstan skyong skyes bu dam pa/ grub pa'i gzhung lugs kun gyi thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol du lan gcig ma yin par son cing*/ thos don rnam par dpyod kyin bsgoms pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyi 'dren byed rnam par gsal bas/

dam pa'i chos dang chos ma yin pa'i chu gter chen po'i mtshan ma dpyad pa la shin tu sgrin pas/ gang la gang 'tsham sna tshogs thabs la mkhas pa'i gru gzings chen po bskyod 'gros kyi tshul la shin tu mkhas pa/ sde snod rin po che ris gsum dang rgyud sde rin po che ris bzhi'i rin chen gling chen dag nas byung ba'i/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sdom pa ste bstan pa'i snying po gsum dang rjes su 'brel ba'i yid bzhin nor bu rin po che'i khur chen ci yang bzhes nas/ mtha' yas gdul bya'i mos blo dag dang rjes su 'tsham pa'i dpal 'byor 'dod dgu'i dga' ston 'dzad pa med pa'i gru char gyi rgyun chen po bsnyil nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don gyi mngon par 'dod pa'i shing rta ji snyed pa rnams phyur bur 'gengs par brtson pa'i chos tshul rab 'byams 'doms pa'i mchog gi ded dpon gang dag kho bo cag gi skal bas thob pa rnams kyi zhabs kyi mtsho skyes dri bral yan lag mchog gis bsten te/ sku gsung thugs kyi dge ba rmad byung lhag pa'i lha'i gsang ba gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin las gzhar yang ma g.yos par/ gang dag gdul byar gyur pa'i sems can su zhig gi mi shes pa'i 'thibs bu bsal bar bgyi/ su zhig gi mngon 'dod kyi chu gter g.yo ba skems par bgyi/ su zhig gi zhe sdang me dpung 'bar ba gzhil bar bgyi/ su zhig srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las gdon par bgyi/ su zhig mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba la dgod par bgyi snyam pa'i dmigs pa med pa'i byams brtse byang chub sems kyi dag byed kyi phung pos yang yang bkrus pa snyam bgyid pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa las/ 'dzum sgros ut+pal dmar po rnam par bzhad pa'i 'dab ma rkang drug 'phur lding bskyod pa'i gshog sgras bsnun pa ltar mdzes par g.yo ba'i gsing nas/

bcu phrag bzhi ldan gyi thags bzangs tshems dkar mu tig dkar po'i 'od zer ring du spro ba/ gang gi khrod nas srab 'jam chu skyes gzhon nu'i 'dab mnyen la co 'drir bzod pa'i ro 'dzin gyi dbang po rnam gsal glog 'gyu stong gi zlos gar gyi rtse dga' yang dal bur bgyid pa dang chabs cig dpal gyi mgrin pa shis pa'i dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil pa'i ri mo can mngon par bteg pa las nye bar 'ongs pa'i gsung snyan yan lag drug cu'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i rgyud las legs par 'phos pa gang las/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos tshul thog mtha' bar gsum du ji snyed thos pa'i brgyud pa'i rim pa dang bcas pa rgyas par ni dam pa'i chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter zhes bya bar bkod pa yin la/ 'dir yang mtshan byang tsam smos pa'i sgo nas bsdus te brjod na/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang chen por/ ji skad du/ bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa nyi ma'i gnyen gyis 'phags pa dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ de tshe 'jig rten mgon po'i sprul pa sprul// de tshe dge slong kun dga' bzang po 'byung*// tshul khrims kyis kyang khyad par 'phags gyur la// thos pa mang zhing pha rol phyin pas 'phags// thabs dang shes rab la ni shin tu bslabs// de dag chos kyi sems rgyud brjed mi 'gyur// rtag tu 'phags pa rnams dang 'grogs par 'gyur// dpa' bo de yi yon tan gang yod pa// mang du thos kyang mthar thug 'gyur ba med// dpa' bo shin tu gnas pa de yi ming*// de tshe bud med gang gis thos gyur pa// de ni phyin chad bud med dngos mi 'gyur// de ltar rtsi sman 'dra ba'i ming des ni// ming gi'ang sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur// de tshe phyogs bcu dag tu bsgrags pa na// dpa' bo de yi ming ni sus thos pa// de yi ming gis las ni de byed de// bud med gang zag la ni reg mi 'gyur// gang gis mthong dang bsti stang byed ci smos// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa dang*/

dam chos pad+ma dkar po las kyang*/ ngas ni dge slong dge 'dun mos par byas// kun dga' bzang po nga yi chos 'dzin pa// bde gshegs bye ba drug cu mchod byas nas// ma 'ongs dus kyi tshe na rgyal bar 'gyur// zhes lung bstan pa'i bskal pa bzang po'i rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i bstan pa la mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi phrin las gzhal du med pas 'jig rten khams kyi skye 'gro ma lus pa skal ba mchog gi dpal la 'byor bar mdzad pa'i dus kyi chos khri pad+ma rā ga'i kha dog can gang la zhabs kyi mtsho skyes gang dag bkod pa dang dgod par 'gyur ba dang*/ da ltar 'khod bzhin pas mtshon pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar thos pa la/ khri'i las 'dzin bgyis mthar zur bzhugs pa/ dang po ni shes bya bcu phrag rig pa'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag mkhyen cing chos smra yongs kyi rgyal po chen po byams pa bsod nams bzang po bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa las legs par bshad pa'i bdud rtsi'i dga' ston brnyes pa'i rnam grangs ni gong du smos zin la/ zur bzhugs pa gnyis pa/ mkhas btsun grub pa mchog gi yon tan dpag bsam gyi yongs 'du chen pos/ ci 'dod mkhas pa'i phrin las kyi gtong phod mtshungs zla med pas/ mtha' yas gdul bya'i mngon 'dod kyi shing rta ji snyed snying po byang chub bar du bde bar 'gengs pa'i thugs rje'i gter chen 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i bgrod byed kyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po yan lag mchog gi rgyan du bkod pa gang gi tshe dam pa'i chos thos pa gong du smos ma thag pa rnams dang*/ der ma thus pa brgyud pa'i khyad par nyis ldan gyi sems bskyed pa/ zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor phyi nang gnyis/ dpal rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i bsrung ba/ bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan/

brda don gsal ba/ nā ro mkha' spyod rnams kyi byin rlabs/ kye rdo rje'i rgyu dus dang lam dus kyi dbang gnyis dang*/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dbang rnams dang lam 'bras po ti dmar chung gi lung bcas stsal/ rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ mgon po'i bka' babs bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang rnams bskur ba/ jo bo rje nas brgyud pa'i dme brtsegs ljang nag ba ri nas brgyud pa'i dme brtsegs dud kha/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge yab yum/ dbyangs can dkar mo/ nor rgyun ma ser mo/ sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo thun mong ma yin pa/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma/ mai tri mkha' spyod/ rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le/ kag chol 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ tshogs kyi bdag po dmar chen phyag bcu gnyis te dmar po skor gsum/ nyang lugs gu ru drag dmar rjes gnang*/ rta mgrin zla rgyal lugs/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po lugs kyi tshe dbang*/ ras chung ba'i lugs kyi tshe dbang*/ rgod ldem lugs kyi tshe dbang lcags kyi sdong po can/ gur gyi mgon po lcam dral gsum/ lcam dral lha brgyad/ lha bcu gnyis pa/ mgon po khro bcu/ zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang po bsnyen dus/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo/ nor skyong dur khrod bdag po yab yum/ mgon po phyag bzhi lha mang*/ phur srung dkar mo nyi zla/ bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba rnams dang*/ gnyos mgon trag shad lcam dral gyi rjes su gnang ba rnams legs par thob bo// gnyos mgon 'di ni 'dren mchog dam pa de nyid las chos thob pa kun gyi mtha' ma nyid yin no// smra ba'i dbang phyug grub pa thams cad mkhyen pa chen po tshul khrims lhun grub bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya ba/

de'i yon tan gyi khyad par ni/ dper na/ chos mngon rgya mtsho'i mthar son mkhas pa'i rje// legs gsungs 'dul ba lhur len btsun pa'i mchog /zab mo mdo sde'i don gzigs bzang po'i phul// ma pham chos kyi spyan ldan la phyag 'tshal// grub pa mchog gi ring lugs gzings chen gyis// mtha' yas rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i pha rol son// rim gnyis nor bu'i dpal la dbang 'byor ba// rig pa 'dzin pa'i ded dpon la phyag 'tshal// zhes bsngags pa'i mkhas pa dang*/ btsun pa dang bzang po dang grub pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba/ gcig tu stobs bcu mnga' ba sras dang bcas pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa dpal kun 'byung ba'i gzhi ma gcig pur gyur pa gang la sman 'dogs par 'dod pa'i lhag bsam dang*/ mtha' med pa'i srid par sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pas khor mo yug tu nyes pa'i 'gro ba rnams la bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba'i dbang phyug gang gi zhabs zung bkra shis rtags kyi re khās sgeg ldan nyid rnam par bkod pa'i skabs gdul bya mchog dman bar pas bsdus pa la zabs yangs chos kyi snang byed chen po sbar ba'i skabs der/ kho bo cag gi bsod nams kyi puṇ+ḍa rī kas cung zad btung ba ni/ bdag cag gi thob yig du gsal bzhin tshigs gsum rim par nos pa'i sgo nas so sor thar pa'i sdom ldan du bsgrubs pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa thams cad kyi gzhi mar stsal/ de nyid nas bzung ste de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ mdo sde dang rgyud sde thams cad kyi don gyi bcud phyung ba/ 'jigs bral rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpal ldan chos skyong gi bzhed gzhung*/ mkhas pa rnams kyis bgrod par bya ba'i 'jug ngogs/ bsod nams dang mi ldan pa rnams kyis rtogs par dka' ba/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'gro ba rnams kyi them skas/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid ston par byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rang bzhin/

gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag gi nyams khrid zab mo zil gnon zhes pa me rta nas phur bu sa sprel gyi bgrang gzhi gsum du lo ltar gyi dus chos lan gsum rdzogs par thob pa'i thog mar/ snang ba gsum gyi nyams khrid rgyas par dgongs chos su byas nas zhag grangs bco lnga stsal ba/ de dag gi skabs su chos tshan thob pa'i rnam grangs la/ rje ngor chen gyis mdzad pa'i rnam dag dkyil 'khor can gyi gsol 'debs ni/ snang gsum dad pa bskyed pa'i khrid kyi skabs su brgyud 'debs gang rung zhig lung byin nas kha ton byar gzhug ces pa'i don du gnang*/ gang gi tshe snga chos la/ e waṃ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang chen por bsgrigs 'don du yod pa'i chos spyod po ti'i lung ni/ dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i mdo nas bzung ste 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i 'dod gsol gyi bar thar rtse paṇa chen gyis bsgrigs pa la/ bla ma phyi ma rnams kyi bstod pa kha 'gengs dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa grub chen bir+wa pa nas bzung ste brgyud pa'i rnam par thar pa thor bu gnas pa la/ rje sa skya pa chen po sogs gong ma lnga'i rnam par thar ba dang*/ nyan chen pa bsod nams brtan pa/ zhang ston dkon mchog dpal ba/ na bza' brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ tshogs sgom pa kun dga' dpal/ dkar po grags pa rin chen seng ge bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i rnam thar mus ches dang gu ge paṇa chen dang sangs rgyas phun tshogs rnams kyis mdzad pa dang*/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ kun mkhyen chen po bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/

'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas seng ge mtshungs med dkon mchog dpal ldan/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas nas/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i rnam thar nges 'byung gtam gyi rol mtsho'i bar/ rgyas pa rnams kyi chos tshan rnam grangs ni rang gis chos thos pa'i yi ge don gnyer gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter du 'khod pa ltar dang*/ bsdus pa gdan rabs nor bu'i phreng ba mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas mdzad pa bcas pa'i lung rnams dang*/ khog phubs kyi bshad pa gsung ngag bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od kha skong kun mkhyen go rams pas mdzad pa sogs nas drangs te legs par bshad pa dang*/ snang ba gsum gyi khrid ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i snang gsum mdzes rgyan gyi steng nas mdzad pa rdzogs nas brgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis ldan gyi lugs kyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa phog de'i dgongs ka nas slob ma rjes 'dzin dang*/ bsags sbyong gi dmigs pa rnams stsal to// de nas mkhan chen pa rang nyid bsnyen pa'i kha gso zhag bdun du mdzad nas/ gsang chen zab mo sngags lam thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa thabs rgyud kyi thog ma bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal dang 'dra ba'i cho ga'i gzhi chen po brgyad dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du/ kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur ba dang de'i skabs su aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung dang bcas pa dang*/ lam gyi dngos gzhi'i khrid dmigs rgyud gsum mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan ji lta ba bzhin smin rgyas su stsal ba thob/ nang bskyed rim gyi sngon du 'gro ba'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor du lam dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub par bskur ba'i skabs nas kyang yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas lung dang bcas pa dang*/ dbang 'bring po dang bsdus pa gnyis kyi ji ltar blang ba'i tshul bcas dang*/

lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bsags sbyong gi khrid dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa'i byin rlabs/ tshar gsum khugs pa'i byin rlabs dang bcas pa rnams legs par stsal to// de dag gi rgyab brten lung la lam 'bras glegs bam pod ser dmar gnyis su bzhugs pa las/ pod ser mar grags pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs rje btsun mchog gis bsgrigs pa 'phyugs med kyi rkang grangs su smos na/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ rnam 'grel gnyags ma/ bar skabs kyi gsal byed la/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud/ gdan sogs dang lam sogs nyi shu las lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ bum dbang gi 'da' ka ma'i skabs su 'chi ltas 'khrul 'khor 'chi bslu dang bcas pa/ bum dbang gi snang ba bsgyur ba'i 'da' ka ma/ gsang dbang gi thig le'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ shes rab ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ dbang bzhi pa'i 'da' ka ma bum dbang dang*/ thun mong du yi ges sgo dgag pa dang bcas pa/ bar do bzhi/ gdams ngag drug rten 'brel lnga/ grib sel gyi sbyin sreg grib ma khrus kyis sel ba dang sāts+tshas sel ba/ thig le bsrung ba/ yi ge brgya pa'i 'don thabs/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi skabs su rlung gi sbyor ba bdun/ bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi/ 'das pa'i lam la gsang dbang gi skabs su 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ bzhi pa'i skabs su dbang phyug gi don brgyad/ sa bcu gsum pa'i phyed kyi mngon rtogs te gsal byed kyi yi ge nyer gnyis so// de thams cad kyi don bsdus pa'i tshigs bcad a seng ma ste bstan bcos tshad ma la dgos pa'i yig sna nyer bzhi dang*/ de dag las 'phros pa la/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud las 'phros nas 'khor 'das dbyer med rtsa 'grel/ gdan sogs las 'phros nas dbang bzhi'i cho ga mtha' dag mdor bsdus pa'i man ngag gi gnad/ mchog dbang gsum grol lam la brten te bskur ba/ lam sogs nyi shu las 'phros nas phyi bskyed rim mdor bsdus pa/

dam tshig las 'phros nas bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub thabs/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams par bskur ba'i yi ge bsrung ba sum cu dang man ngag gi gnad bdun bcu las 'phros nas gegs sel la/ bsam gtan 'dor ba'i 'phrang bdun/ byung rgyal du mi gtang ba'i gnad bzhi/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs rlung dang spyod lam gyis bsal ba/ rnal 'byor gyi phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis te bzhi dang*/ las dang po pa dang thun mong du dgos pa'i chos la/ dbang gi chu bo'i lag len rgyas pa/ bum dbang gi bsrung ba'i dam tshig bye brag tu bshad pa 'khrul ba spong ba/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga yab kyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa yan lag bzhi pa/ 'bring po yan lag drug pa/ yum gyi sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang bdun te 'phros pa bcu bdun no// de dag ni lam rgyas pa'i cha lag yin la/ rtsa ba med pa'i lam 'bring po dang*/ rang gzhung dang bcas pa'i lam bsdus pa/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du bkri ba/ gnad drug gnad bcu gcig dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyis bkri ba ste gzhung shing bzhi dang*/ lam 'jug ldog phyag rgya 'jug ldog shes pas phan 'dogs pa'i man ngag lam bsre ba 'gros bzhi dang bcas pa/ phyi nang gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis te rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga dang*/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor te nyams myong tshad ma la dgos pa'i yig sna nyer dgu dang*/ bla ma tshad ma la bla ma rgya bod kyi rnam thar gnyis/ lung tshad ma la lung 'di nyid dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba dang*/ lung mtha' dag dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba dang*/ de gnyis dang zhib tu sbyar ba re re ste bzhi dang*/ man ngag phra mo'i rkang grangs te chos sna drug cur grags pa las/ glegs bam 'dir cis kyang dgos pa'i yig sna zhe dgu/ las dang po pa dang thun mong du dgos pa'i chos bdun/ de rnams kyi dkar chag dang bcas pa rnams lan gsum gyi bar du legs par thob bo// gzhan yang slob dpon ngag dbang grags pa'i phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i gdams ngag

slob dpon tog tse pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi man ngag slob dpon klu sgrub kyi mchod rten gyi drung du sems thag bcad pa'i man ngag slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i gtum mo lam rdzogs kyi man ngag slob dpon nag po u tsi tra 'chi ba med pa'i yon po bsrang ba'i man ngag dang*/ mi dbang in+d+ra bhū ti'i phyag rgya lam rdzogs/ grub chen pad+ma ba'i mar me'i rtse mo lta bu'i lam/ grub chen ḍom+bi pa'i lhan cig skyes pa grub pa'i lam ste lam skor chen po brgyad du grags pa rnams legs par thos so// gzhan yang kye rdo rje bya ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa 'brog mi lo tsā ba'i 'gyur gyi steng nas dang*/ kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi rgya cher bshad pa bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer dang gtor ma'i cho ga'i rnam bshad rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa/ kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi rnam par bshad pa/ lus dkyil gyi rnam par bshad pa bde chen bcud kyi nying khu bcas kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa/ kye rdo rje lam dus kyi bshad pa bklag pas kun shes gtor chog gi bshad pa dang bcas pa rdo rje 'chang bkra shis dpal ldan gyis mdzad pa rnams kyi lung legs par thos so// byin rlabs kyi rim pa la/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang byin gyis brlabs pa bcas pa/ phyi'i bar chad srung ba'i thabs gtso bor gyur pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi byin rlabs/ de nyid thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs zab mo chig brgyud ma dang*/ gsung ngag gi gnad bsdus te nyams su len tshul ston pa brda don gsal ba byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ tshar gsum khug pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ de'i yan lag drug dang bcas pa thos so// gzhan yang de dag dang rjes su 'brel ba'i gsung rab thor bur gnas pa man ngag phra mo'i rkang grangs su grags pa rnams bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen pos phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa po ti dmar chung du mtshan gsol ba kha skong dang bcas pa gsan pa'i rnam grangs ni/

bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ de'i kha skong*/ sa bir mjal ba'i lo rgyus/ bra ston zhus lan/ sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnal 'byor/ rtsa sngags kyi bzlas lung bya tshul/ rtsa sngags kyi gzhi bshad/ bdud rtsi 'byung ba/ dbang gi rab dbye/ dga' ston la gdams pa/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal/ de'i kha skong*/ lus sbyong nyi shu pa/ lus gnad kyi man ngag bdag med ma'i byin rlabs/ gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi pa/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa nyer dgu/ gegs sel gsang bdun ma/ bar chad gsum sel/ bla ma chen po'i nyams che chung gnyis/ gegs sel gces bsdus/ gleng gzhi ma/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs sogs sel ba/ bka' rgya ma/ gegs sel gyi yi ge bzhi'i gsal byed/ phrin las so gnyis kyi sdom/ de'i zhal shes bris pa/ dbang bzhi ngo sprod rtsa 'grel gnyis/ sgrub pa lung sbyin/ gsang bcu'i gdams ngag gnad du che ba drug rten 'brel lnga/ lam bsdus pa 'dod pa'i lcags kyu/ phyag chen gyi dbye ba/ 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ tshogs sbyor mngon rtogs/ lam bsdus pa'i bshad pa lung 'di dang zhib tu sbyar ba/ lam zab kyi khrid yig bla ma rin 'byung*/ lam sbas bshad/ pho brang lnga'i sbas bshad/ de'i 'khrul 'khor rtsa 'grel/ grub chen bcu dang phra mo brgyad kyi rtsa 'grel/ de'i gsal byed/ bir srung gi man ngag rnying pa gsum/ bir srung byin rlabs byed tshul dang bcas pa/ rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs bya tshul/ gzungs kyi mtshan/ de'i gsal byed/ de'i lag len/ brda don gsal ba rtsa 'grel gnyis/ lho pa'i zin bris/ tshar gsum khug pa/ yig brgya'i gdams ngag rnams dang*/ shān+ti pa'i mdo rgyud bsre ba/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ dz+nyā na shrī/ rin chen rdo rje gsum gyi bar chad gsum sel/ ngag dbang grags pa'i gnyug ma dran gsal/ nā ro pa'i sdug bsngal gsum sel te 'brog mis bi kra ma la shī la'i mkhas pa sgo drug la chos 'brel du gsan pa rnams te chos kyi rnam grangs drug cu rtsa bzhi/

de rnams kyi kha skong bla ma yab sras kyis mdzad pa la/ bshad thabs kyi man ngag gsang ba'i sgo 'byed/ rgyud gsum lam rim gyi sa bcad/ lam zab nang gi bla ma'i nyams len/ rgyu dus kyi dbang gi rtogs bskyed/ bir srung bar chad kun sel/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bir srung gi byin rlabs bya tshul/ de'i nyams len/ de dang gsung ngag mtshan mtshon sbyar ba/ bir srung gsar ma/ sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gi yi ge rnams bla ma rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa rnams lan gnyis kyi bar du legs par nos so// gzhan yang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po de nyid las byin gyis brlabs pa dang rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa thob pa la/ gong du smos pa rnams su ma chud pa ni/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rjes gnang bkru byab bsrung gsum/ 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na dmar ser gyi rjes gnang gnyis thar rtse pas mdzad pa'i yi ge'i lung bcas/ rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu'i rjes su gnang ba/ grub chen mi tra dzo ki nas brgyud pa'i tshe dpag tu med pa dkar po/ dge slong ma dpal mo lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal/ phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed/ phyag na rdo rje u tsar+ya/ mi g.yo ba dkar sngon gnyis/ dzam+bha la ser nag gnyis rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba rnams dang*/ de rnams kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa rje dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i lung bcas/ phyag na rdo rje gtum po khyung lnga dang*/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang me dbang rnam bzhir bcas pa/ de gnyis kyi sgrub thabs rjes su gnang ba'i yi ge sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas pa/ gser chos 'jam dpal nag po skyil krung can gyi rjes gnang*/ de'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi yi ge sa skya pa kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa dang*/ gu ge paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rnams kyi lung bcas thob/ chos rgyal rigs ldan nas brgyud pa'i khyung khra'i rjes gnang sgo rum pa'i yig cha/

yig rnying dang rjes gnang gi tho'i steng nas khyung dmar gyi rjes gnang lung bcas/ sman bla mched bdun/ spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa/ nor rgyun ma ser mo/ lha mo sna tshogs yum/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar po/ rta mgrin jo bo lugs/ seng ge'i gdong can sngo dmar gnyis rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba/ de dag thams cad kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi yig cha thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa rnams kyi lung dang bcas pa thos/ sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga'i rjes gnang dang*/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ rong ston gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa/ mchog legs pas mdzad pa'i yig cha rnams kyi lung bcas thos/ glo bo mkhan chen pa'i yig cha'i steng nas 'jam dbyangs bstod pa gang blo ma'i rig gtad/ ngag chos pa'i yi ge'i steng nas rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi rjes gnang*/ khro bo dme brtsegs kyi rjes gnang*/ de'i yig cha mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i lung bcas thos/ gzhan yang sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba/ rje ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i tshul gsum mdzes rgyan/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan/ kye rdo rje'i mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams kyi lung bcas phal cher lan gsum gyi bar du legs par thos// ༈ //dpal ldan ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs nyid snyigs mar gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhir rjes su 'brel ba'i lam srol/ gang dang gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur ba de dang de'i tshul gyis legs par 'doms pa la 'jigs bral brnyes pa'i sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin dbang chen po'i gar gyis rtsen pa rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i zhabs stegs chos kyi khrir bsnyen te zab rgyas chos kyi sgra dbyangs snyan dgu thos pa 'dzin pa'i skal bzang du nod pa la/

thog mar rje btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos lugs kyi tshe dpag med sprul sku'i rjes su gnang ba/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo dang rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bsam 'phel nor bu zhes pa'i steng nas dang*/ mnga' ris tshul 'od kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga phrin las lhun grub steng nas bya rgyud rigs gsum spyi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta gser gdugs can gyi bzhed srol 'jam dpal shes rab 'khor lo'i rjes gnang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi yum bcom ldan 'das ma bsrung ba lnga lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa chen mo'am gza' thams cad kyi yum gtso 'khor gyi rjes gnang yig cha'i lung dang bcas pa/ 'od zer can gtso rkyang gi rjes su gnang ba/ 'phags pa kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri med lha lnga'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa'i gzungs las gsungs pa'i thub pa'i dbang po lha bdun rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi yum gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du rig pa gtad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi khro bo'i rgyal po gtsug tor 'bar ba'i rjes gnang*/ de'i sgrub thabs las tshogs bstod pa'i lung dang bcas pa dang*/ rigs kyi pho nya dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi rigs kyi bdag po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa gtso 'khor lnga pa dang*/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa lha lnga rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba/ spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum gyi rig gtad mus chen stong rwa ba'i yi ge'i steng nas dang*/ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i rjes su gnang ba/ dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos bcu bzhi ya gyal seng ge sgra'i ngag bsrung 'grol gyi man ngag shin tu zab pa dang*/

sgrol ma'i man ngag rmi lam brtag pa lha mo shra wa ṇa'i sgrub thabs kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i lung*/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi khro bo jo bo dpal ldan a ti sha 'phan yul lan pa'i spyil bur bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bran kha dpal yon gyis tho btsams par rta mgrin shwa na bzhis bskor gyis btul bar mdzad pa'i dus kyi lha de nyid dang*/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa nas brgyud pa'i rta mgrin dmar po dbyug tho can gyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi bdag po 'gro bzang lugs kyi phyag na rdo rje'i dbang zhwa lu pa ye shes rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga'i steng nas dang*/ phyag na rdo rje khang bu brtsegs pa'i rjes gnang*/ dza ya warma'i lugs sam ma ṇe ka badz+ra'i lugs kye rdo rje'i rigs kyi khro bo rnam par 'joms pa mthing nag lha bcu dgu'i dbang rnams thob bo// nor can gyi rigs las/ rnam thos sras dmar po gsung mchog snyan grags sgrub pa dang*/ rnam thos sras dmar po mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa dang*/ a pa ra dzi ta dkar po'i rjes su gnang ba rnams dang*/ rta mgrin yang gsang lha dgu'i khrag 'thung rig pa'i dbang*/ lha dbang*/ dur khrod chas dbang*/ gtor dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ bzhi pa'i dbang dang bcas pa/ rdzong chung lugs kyi tshe dbang zab mo/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas byang gter tshe dpag med sprul sku'i dbang rnams thob bo// ༈ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i chos skor las/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim rwa khrid mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud kyi nyams khrid zab mo dang*/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rjes gnang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog bong zhal can lha so bdun gyi dbang bskur ba/ dpal sgyu ma chen po lha lnga ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ 'khor lo bde mchog sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/
