bde mchog dkar po lhan cig skyes pa'i byin rlabs/ de la brten pa'i tshe sgrub rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge'i lung dang bcas pa/ phag mo dkar mo shes rab gsal byed ma'i byin rlabs/ dur khrod bdag po'i rgyud gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i lung*/ gur nas gsungs pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang*/ rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le lha lnga'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ ku ru kul+le gsang sgrub lha lnga sin+dhu ra la brten pa'i rjes gnang*/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po la bram ze mchog sred kyis dngos su stsal ba'i gur gyi mgon po srin gseb ma dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong gi las sgrub pa'i lha gsum gyi nang gsel/ char dbab gcod byed pa khro bo rdo rje shugs kyi rjes gnang*/ gser chos kyi rdo rje khyung khra'i rjes gnang*/ kye rdo rje lam dus kyi dbang*/ rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad la ber nag zangs gri can bsnan pa'i rjes su gnang ba sngon du 'gro ba'i/ nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten pa'i gsang khrid thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams khrid rgyas pa zhag bcu gcig gi bar dang*/ gur gyi mgon po'i khrid kyi sa bcad kyis dngos su ma zin pa drag po sngags rgod kyi nang khrid dang sems nyid ye shes kyi rtsal 'don gsang ba'i brag rdzong dang bcas pa'i nyams khrid stsal/ sgrub dus kyi dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i rjes su gnang ba brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi lung bcas sngon du btang zhing*/ de nas brtsams te tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig bdud sde 'joms pa'i shan pa dang*/ dbang phyug rab brtan pa'i lhan thabs zin bris bsdebs pa'i steng nas/ 'khor lo bzhi ldan gyi rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i zab lam gsang khrid zab mo smin rgyas su zhag bcu gcig gi bar stsal ba nod/ beng dmar gyi rjes su gnang ba/

sangs rin pa'i yi ge'i steng nas dud sol lha mo'i rjes gnang thun mong ba/ rngog bsod nams bstan 'dzin pa'i yi ge'i steng nas dud sol lha mo gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang nan chags mar grags pa/ lha mo nam mkha'i gos can ma dang*/ dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma dang*/ dpal mgon trag shad stag zhon 'khor bcas dang*/ zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul/ bka' gdams lugs kyi mgon po gri gug can lcam dral rnams kyi rjes gnang dang*/ dmar po skor gsum gyi nang tshan ku ru kul+le'i byin rlabs/ dpal mgon dkar po tshe 'phel dang*/ ser po rgyas byed gtso 'khor dgu'i rjes su gnang ba rnams thob cing de dag gi yig cha gsar rnying phal che ba rnams kyi lung yang thos mod/ 'dir yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas ma bris la/ gzhan yang jo bo nas brgyud pa'i sgrol ma'i mdos chog mchog legs rdo rjes mdzad pa'i smyung gnas cho ga tshar chen dang mkhyen brtses mdzad pa'i seng gdong ma'i sgrub thabs chung ngu gnyis/ 'od zer can ma'i gdams pa mkhyen brtses bris pa zab mo bka' rgya can/ rdo rje gdan pa'i chos drug go rams pas mdzad pa'i ar+gha'i cho ga rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i tho bskyed cho ga gsal ba'i me long dang bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga bsod nams rgyas byed/ brag phug pas mdzad pa'i lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs gnas sbyar ma/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs gnas sbyar ma dang*/ bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngag 'don gyi lung rnams kyang legs par thos so// ༈ /bslu med skyabs kyi mchog gyur bla ma rgyal sras bcas 'dus pa'i rang bzhin gang gi gsang gsum mi zad che ba'i yon tan ji snyed skye 'phags blo ldan bye bas bskal par bsngags kyang gzhar yang mthas gtugs dben pa'i mkhas btsun grub pa mchog gi 'dren pa rje btsun dpal ldan chos skyong pa'i zhabs rdul gtsang mas gtsug gi chu mtshor lhung ba'i skal ba mchog la spyod pa na/

brtse dang byang sems gnyis su med pas phye ba'i zhal sgo nas legs par 'phos pa'i dam chos bdud rtsi'i skal ba nod pa gong du smos pa rnams dang*/ der ma thus par dpal kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi rgyu dus dang lam dus kyi dbang*/ rdo rje gur gyi mkha' 'gro lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor phyi nang*/ bir+wa pa'i srung ba phyi nang*/ grub thob brgyad cu rnams kyi byin rlabs lung dang bcas pa/ nā ro mkha' spyod dang*/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma/ mai tri mkha' spyod rnams kyi byin rlabs/ dpal mo gser gyi snying thag can/ lha mo ti nu ma/ nor rgyun ma dmar mo ste gnyen lo tsā ba'i lha gsum gyi rjes gnang dang*/ dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo/ tshe dpag med dkar po/ 'jam dpal dmar ser a ra pa tsa na/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī nas brgyud pa dang*/ dā na shī la nas brgyud pa'i dbyangs can ma dmar mo/ grwa pa mngon shes nas brgyud pa'i dzam+bha la dmar po/ dzam+bha la dkar po 'brug zhon lha lnga dang*/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu/ ba ri lugs kyi rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo ngor lugs thun mong min pa/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes su gnang ba lugs gnyis/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can/ rta mgrin dmar po skyer sgang lugs kyi rjes su gnang ba rnams dang*/ tshe dbang la grub thob thang stong pa'i lugs 'chi med dpal ster/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i lugs/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem pa'i lugs kyi lcags sdong mar grags pa/ slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig yang jo bo'i lugs kyi sgrol ma 'jigs pa kun sel ma gtso 'khor lnga/ dpal ldan shong pa'i lugs kyi mgon po dkar po yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ mi g.yo ba dkar sngo gnyis rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba/ phyag na rdo rje gtum po khyung lnga/

phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can/ rnam thos sras gser can gtso 'khor dgu'i rjes su gnang ba dang mjug tu drag po'i rjes gnang du bcas pa/ rnam thos sras dkar po tshe 'phel sogs kyi rjes gnang bco lnga'i nang nas 'ga' re dang*/ gur mgon lha brgyad mkha' 'gro sbags sgrub dang dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang*/ gur gyi mgon po lcam dral lha gsum dang*/ lha brgyad sbags te sgrub pa/ lha bcu gnyis sbags te sgrub pa/ gsang khrid kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i mgon po lha dgu dang gur mgon sprin gseb ma/ pu tra ming sring gsum dang ru mtshon gyi las mkhan bran bdud gshin rje nag po rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba/ bsnyen dus kyi dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa/ sgrub dus kyi mgon po zhal khra can thun mong ma yin pa/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i las bzhi'i mgon po las dkar po tshe 'phel gtso 'khor lnga/ ser po rgyas byed gtso 'khor dgu/ dmar po dbang sdud gtso 'khor lnga/ sngon po bgegs 'joms gtso 'khor lnga rnams dang*/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo/ dpal mgon stag zhon/ beg tse lcam dral dang 'khor mang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba rnams la legs par stsal to// bklag lung thos pa'i skor la ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i bka' 'bum po ti gsum/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi bka' 'bum po ti dang po/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub skor po ti rmor chen pas bsgrigs pa'i dkar chag ltar dang*/ gur gyi mgon po'i po ti me 'bar mar grags pa dang*/ snyan brgyud po ti'i kha skong*/ mgon po'i chos byung sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa/ dpal mgon zhal gyi po ti/ ha la nag po'i po ti/ beg tse'i po ti/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras zhi drag gi po ti gnyis rnams dang*/ gzhan yang grwa pa mngon shes lugs kyi dzam+bha la dmar po'i sgrub skor yig rnying gi lung*/

seng gdong ma'i las tshogs nyer lnga/ 'gro mgon dpal gyi ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong*/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub skor gyi yi ge gsar rnying rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa la/ tshangs pa'i bu mo dbyangs can ma la bstod pa grub pa ngag gi 'od zer zhes bya ba bram ze phur bus mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta nag mo'i khol gyis mdzad pa'i dbyangs can gyi bstod pa/ dbyangs can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs bram ze phur bus mdzad pa 'gor phyag 'tshal dang*/ rang gi snying ga'i srog gi 'od zer gyis zhes yod pa/ yang phyag 'tshal dang dbyangs can ma sgrub par 'dod pas sdig to mi dge ba spangs zhes sogs yod pa dang*/ mjug tu 'bum khri lnga stong bzlas par bya'o zhes pa'i mtha' can/ yang*/ na mo swa ra swa sti bh+yaḥ zab mo'i gdams pa mchog tu gyur pa'i dngos grub kyi gegs sel/ 'di la don gsum ste sogs dang*/ mthar gegs sel zab mo i thi'i mtha' can/ yang ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mo dbyangs can ma bsgrub pa'i skabs su dngos grub chen po bzhi 'byung ba la gegs bzhi 'byung sogs nas/ dbyangs can ma'i gegs sel khyad par can i thi'i mtha' can/ dbyangs can dga' bas sbyar ba'i lha mo dbyangs can ma'i rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa dang*/ de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gegs sel 'brel bar yod pa/ shākya'i btsun pa nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis snar thang du mdzad pa'i dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang*/ cho ga shes rab kyi 'khor lo thogs pa med par 'jug pa zhes bya ba dang*/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ de'i kha skong bcas pa'i lung*/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i dbyangs can lha mo'i bsnyen thabs/ brgyud 'debs/ bstod pa rnams kyi lung bcas rdzogs par thos so// rje btsun dpal ldan chos skyong pa rang gi gsan yig po ti dang*/ rnam par thar pa po ti dang po dang gnyis pa'i phyed tsam/

rab gnas kyi cho ga las brtsams pa'i 'bel gtam sogs rje rang gi mdzad chos 'ga' re rnams thos pa ni/ rang gis chos thos pa'i yi ger 'god pa ltar las 'dir gsal bar ma smos so// rgya chen chos kyi 'dren byed phyi nang shes bya'i gzhung lugs kun gyi dkyus su rnam par spros shing*/ mkhas par 'os pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i phrin las gser gyi 'khor los/ gnas lnga rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi ri gling ma lus par dbang sgyur ba'i shar chen chos kyi rgyal po rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i zhal snga nas dam chos nyi gzhon gyi thigs pa/ blo gros kyi 'dab stong tshal du lhung ba la/ thog mar gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu'i rjes su gnang ba/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i lugs kyi tshe dpag tu med pa'i tshe dbang*/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i rdul tshon gyi snying po bde ba chen po len pa'i grong khyer chen por sta gon dang dngos gzhi'i cho ga gnyis kyi sgo nas bcug ste smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la brten pa'i bkru byab bsrung gsum dang*/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i bka' 'bum po ti bzhi/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i gsung rab sngags skor gyi po ti'i lung sogs dam pa'i chos kyi zil mngar 'thungs shing da dung ji snyed cig btung ba'i 'dun pa mi lhod pa ni/ drang srong a gas+t+ya'i gsus rdzing ltar mi ngom par gnas so// phyi nang shes bya rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi byed po ji snyed byon pa rnams kyi bzhed pa rnam par 'grel phyir 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa nyid/ dus 'dir gnas lnga rig pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta'i skye bar zlos pa si tu sprul pa'i sku bstan pa'i snang byed chen po las/ lha mo 'od zer can ma dang sgrol ma/ grub pa'i rgyal mo'i lugs kyi tshe dbang zab khyad can dang*/ sgra mi snyan gyi rang gzungs zhwa lu lo chen gyis zhus dag byas pa'i steng nas lung bcas nos so// stobs bcu mnga' ba'i rgyal tshab dam pa dad sgrol e waṃ pa chen po'i ring lugs phan bde'i rin chen bye ba'i 'byung gnas chen por dbang bsgyur zhing*/

mkhas pa'i phrin las dag byed kyi rgyun chen phyogs brgyar 'bebs pa'i chos kyi rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa nas/ khros nag lha lnga'i dbang*/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i thugs dam gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sgrub thabs thor bur gnas pa'i gdams ngag phra mo brgya rtsar longs pa rnams/ snar thang gi mkhan po mchims nam mkha' grags kyis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa snar thang brgya rtsar grags pa'i nang gi rjes gnang yod pa sum cu tsam mchis pa rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba lung du bcas pa dang*/ dpal mgon stag zhon lcam dral dang*/ rta mgrin nag po zla ba rgyal ma lugs kyi rjes su gnang ba sogs nos so// yang sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin dbang mdo sngags gzhung lugs mang po thos pa'i dpal bzung nas/ legs par smra ba'i dbang phyug sku dbon rin po che rin chen mchog grub pa las/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i bka' 'bum po ti las kye rdo rje'i rnam bshad zla zer gyi mjug man chad nas rdzogs pa'i bar lung thob bo// rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i phrin las rgya mtsho'i snying po lung rtogs chos kyi cha shas rdzogs nas mkhas tshul gsum gyis smra ba'i kun phan gzhon nur gyur pa chos rje bstan 'dzin rdo rje pa nas/ dpal kye rdo rje grub chen ḍom+bi he ru ka'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor grub chen mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ grub chen nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i lugs kyi sku gsung thugs dang snying po kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bzhi ste/ bka' babs gsum gyi dkyil 'khor chen po drug ras bris la brten nas dbang bskur ba sta gon dngos gzhir bcas pa'i sgo nas legs par thob/ rje de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lha mo dpal gyi g.yang skyabs dang*/ brgya bzhi'i cho ga

gdugs dkar gyi 'khor lo bri thabs bcas pa'i lung rnams thos so// thams cad mkhyen pa nyi ma'i rtsa lag chen po'i lung rtogs chos kyi nor bu'i gces mdzod mtha' dag bzung nas/ ris bral gdul bya rnams kyi skal bar 'tsham pa legs par 'doms pa'i rgyal ba'i phrin las skyong ba chen po bka' 'gyur ro cog gi mnga' bdag chos rje bsod nams blo gros pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mar bsnyen te sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab rin po che thos pa la/ bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo las/ 'dul ba gzhi sh+lau ka sum khri nyis stong bdun brgya dang dgu bzhugs pa dang*/ dge slong pha'i so sor thar pa'i mdo sh+lau ka brgya bam po gnyis pa/ dge slong pha'i rnam 'byed sh+lau ka nyi khri bzhi stong dgu brgya bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa/ dge slong ma'i so sor thar pa sh+lau ka brgyad brgya bam po gnyis pa/ dge slong ma'i rnam 'byed sh+lau ka brgyad stong bzhi brgya dang bam po nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ 'dul ba lung phran tshegs sgo brgyad ka rdzogs pa sh+lau ka chig khri bdun brgya bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa/ 'dul ba gzhung bla ma'i zhu ba ma rdzogs pa sh+lau ka sum stong drug brgya bam po bcu gnyis dang*/ zhu ba rdzogs pa sh+lau ka chig khri lnga stong dgu brgya bam po lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa rnams so// bka' bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo las byung ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yum rgyas pa 'bum pa la ting nge 'dzin brgya nyer gcig sgo gsum rnam grangs bcu gcig zhus lan brgya dang nyi shu/ 'gres ring brgya lnga bcu/ phyogs skor bdun cu rtsa bzhi/ mtshan byed kyi chos bdun bcu/ 'gres rtsa bdun/ 'gres thung bsnan pa'i 'gres rtsa khri dang bzhi brgya nyer dgu/ bam po sum brgya dang le'u go gnyis byung ba dang*/ yum 'bring po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa bam po bdun bcu don brgyad dang sh+lau ka brgya le'u don drug pa dang*/

yum bsdus pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa phreng can sde can/ bzo sbyangs zhes pa ming mi gcig par gsungs pa gang zag gcig la ming mi gcig pa sna tshogs 'ong ba lta bu las tha dad pa min zhing*/ 'gyur rgyas 'bring gi khyad par tsam yin zhes bzhed pa khungs btsun par bzhed pa ltar lags shing*/ 'on te 'gyur rgyas pa phreng can dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgya stong pa bam po drug cu le'u brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri pa bam po sum cu dang sh+lau ka brgya le'u sum cu so gsum pa rnams dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sna tshogs pa'i skor la/ 'phags pa sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa bam po gcig pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rab rtsal gyi rnam par gnon pas zhus pa/ bam po bdun dang sh+lau ka drug cu pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdun brgya la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lnga brgya pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje gcod pa sum brgya pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lnga bcu pa/ sher phyin tshul brgya lnga bcu pa/ sher phyin sgo nyi shu pa/ sher phyin yi ge gcig ma/ shes rab snying po sh+lau ka nyer lnga pa/ sher phyin nyi ma'i snying po/ sher phyin zla ba'i snying po/ sher phyin kun tu bzang po/ sher phyin lag na rdo rje/ sher phyin rdo rje rgyal mtshan rnams legs par thob bo// gsum pa bka' tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo las byung ba rnams kyang de sngon ma thob kyang slar zhu ba'i 'dun pa ni chu gter chen po chu klung bye ba 'bab kyang nam yang ngoms pa ma mchis pa yod cing*/ yang mdo rgyud rnams nas 'byung ba'i bka' nye bar mkho ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa bka' 'dus rin po che da ltar par du 'khod pa'i nang ltar las/ lung rgyun med pa'i dmigs bsal gzhan du yod pa 'ga' re min pa rdzogs pa'i chos tshan rnam grangs rnams ni gzhan du gsal lo// gzhan yang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i phrin las kyi zla snang dkar pos phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs pa'i mkhas btsun chos kyi rje tshul khrims dbang phyug pa las/

thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal lha mang gi dkyil 'khor du ras bris la brten pa'i dbang bskur ba legs par thob bo// zab yangs thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son cing gsang chen sngags kyi dngos grub brnyes pa'i rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun dga' rgya mtsho pa las/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs dang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mkhas grub phyi mas byas pa'i lhan thabs zur 'debs rnams la brten nas rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs lha bcu gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor ras bris la brten pa sta gon dang dngos gzhi'i cho ga gnyis kyi sgo nas dbang bskur ba dang*/ rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa lha dgu'i dbang bskur ba lha dbang chas dbang dang bcas pa shin tu rgyas pa dang*/ rdzong chung lugs kyi tshe dbang dang bcas pa/ gur gyi mgon po lha bcu gnyis thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang*/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa sgrub dus thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang*/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i ha la nag po'i dpe bum/ mnyam med jo bo rje'i thugs dam du bcang ba'i chos chung brgya rtsar grags pa dang*/ khro phu lo tsā ba'i man ngag brgya rtsa'i lung*/ chos rgyal dge ba'i dbang po yab sras kyis byas pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi lung rnams nos/ stobs bcu mnga' ba gdung 'tshob kyi phreng ba ji snyed byon pa'i mdo sngags chos kyi tshul ma lus pa 'dzin cing*/ 'chad pa la dbang 'byor bas bstan pa'i snang byed dam par gyur pa skyor mda' ba bsod nams dbang phyug pa las/ dpal mgon khyung zhal can gyi rjes su gnang ba dang*/ dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang tshe dbang dang bcas pa thob/ thar lam dgon gyi mkhas dang btsun pa'i yon tan dang gzhung mang thos pa'i nor gyis phyug pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' rnam rgyal dang*/ grub dbang nam mkha' legs pa'i dbon brgyud du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas btsun gyi yon tan 'dzin pa bstan 'dzin phun tshogs gnyis ka las/

sde snod 'dzin pa chos rnam rgyal gyi yi ge'i steng nas khros ma nag mo lha lnga'i dbang bskur chos kyi sgo 'byed dang*/ bsod nams mchog grub pa'i yig cha'i steng nas drung lugs kyi dbang bskur chos kyi sgo 'byed gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i lung gi skor la/ gcod zab don thugs kyi snying po sogs pradz+nyā'i mtshan can dang*/ drung kun dga' rin chen dang*/ bsod nams mchog grub rnams kyis mdzad pa phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i dpe bum gyi lung rnams thos so// tshe gcig bsnyen sgrub kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i grub brnyes sgom chen bstan 'dzin phun tshogs pa las/ nag po chen po'i chos skor las/ snyan brgyud yang skong du grags pa'i po ti'i lung legs par thos so// gnas lnga rig pa'i yul la rnam par dpyod pa'i mkhyen rab nyin mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor ltar gsal zhing*/ gsar rnying rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs kyi dbang bskur byin rlabs gdams pa'i chu klung rab 'byams ngoms par bzhes nas/ legs par 'doms pa'i legs bshad kyi dag byed kyi klung rgyun grangs med 'gyed pa'i smra ba'i dbang phyug ze chen rab 'byams pa pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin pa las/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gter bdag gling pa 'gyur med rdo rje/ bka' dang gter byon lugs kyi mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sgrub skor nye bar mkho zhing*/ shin tu dkon pa rnams kyi rgyun mi nub pa'i phyir phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa sgrub thabs 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang zhes bya ba nas 'byung ba'i dbang bskur byin rlabs rjes su gnang ba rig gtad bzlas lung la sogs pa'i bka' srol ji snyed bzhugs pa rnams legs par thob pa la/ thog mar bla ma zhi ba'i skor la/ bla ma gsang 'dus las thod phreng rtsal sgos sgrub kyi zlum po bzhi dbang*/

gsang 'dus gtor dbang gnad kyi shog gcig mar grags pa/ nyang gter bla ma yongs rdzogs kyi gtor dbang rnams so// bla ma drag po'i skor la/ nyang gter drag dmar bde 'dus kyi dbang bka' rdo rje spyi blugs/ 'bring po me'i spu gri'i dbang chog che 'bring gnyis ka dang 'brel ba'i byin rlabs lu gu brgyud/ drag dmar bka' ma 'o bran lugs/ byang gter drag po rtsal gyi byin rlabs thugs rje'i dbang bskur rnams so// tshe dpag med kyi skor la/ tshe dpag med lung lugs sangs rgyas gsang ba'i man ngag chos dbang gi gter ma bla ma longs sku'i rdzong chen tshe dbang*/ byang gter tshe sgrub lcags sdong ma/ pad gling tshe sgrub rdo rje phreng ba'i tshe dbang sgrub khog las gsung rgyun bzhin phyungs pa/ grub thob thang stong pa'i gdams pa 'chi med dpal ster gyi tshe sgrub rnams so// spyan ras gzigs kyi skor la/ thugs rje chen po rgyal po lugs phyag bzhi pa/ rgyal po lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho bde gshegs bzhi sgril gyi sgrub thabs rnams so// 'jam dpal tshe bdag yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i rnon po nad gcod kyi dbang bka'o// rta mgrin gyi skor la/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub shangs lugs/ nyang gter rta nag lcags ral can/ chos dbang lugs rta nag gi sgrub thabs rnams so// phyag rdor gyi skor la/ las 'brel rtsal gyi phyag rdor dregs 'dul bum pa dang gtor ma'i las tshogs la brten pa/ byang chub gling pa'i phyag rdor gtum po drag po/ grwa pa'i gtor ma phyag rdor khang brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs rnams so// phag mo'i skor la/ nyang gter mkha' 'gro chen mor grags pa phag mo zhal gnyis ma/ rdo rje phag mo don grub ma/ phag mo dbu bcad ma/ khros nag gi sgrub thabs rnams so// shes rab kyi lha'i skor la/ ma ti lugs kyi 'jam dpal dkar po/ dam pa sangs rgyas lugs kyi 'jam dpal smra seng*/

'phags ma dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs rnams so// phrin las kyi lha'i skor la/ rnam 'joms sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lugs/ rnam 'joms ba ri lugs/ chos dbang lugs gyi drang srong lok+t+ri pā la/ rin chen gling pa'i nā ga rak+sha'i sgrub thabs rnams so// bstan srung mgon po'i skor la/ dpal mgon legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag po/ nyang gter dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa/ mgon po dkar po'i tshe dbang*/ chos dbang lugs kyi ma ning*/ gnubs lugs kyi dpal mgon stag zhon/ gnubs lugs kyi mgon po beng gi sgrub thabs rnams so// bstan srung sna tshogs pa'i skor la/ ye shes ma mo e ka dza ṭī sde bdun gyi sbags sgrub/ snying thig ma mo e ka dza ṭī gtso rkyang*/ re ti rang byung ma bka' gter gnyis ldan/ nyang gter gshog rgod ma/ las 'brel lugs lha mo srog sgrub ma/ las 'brel lugs gza' rgod dug gi spu gri/ las 'brel lugs gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar nag rdor legs kyi sgrub thabs gter brgyud gnyis ldan/ rgyal sras legs ldan pa'i gter byon zhing skyong seng gdong can/ nyang gter dur khrod ma mo/ chos dbang gi brtan ma bcu gnyis/ nyang gter dkor bdag pe ha ra'i sgrub thabs rnams so// nor lha'i skor la/ rnam sras phyi sgrub ser chen sprin gseb ma/ nang sgrub mdung dmar can rta sngon ma/ gsang sgrub drag po rta sngon ma/ yang gsang phyag mtshan bzhi pa/ gnod sbyin zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul/ dzam dmar chags pa rdo rje/ lha chen dbang phyug chen po'i sgrub thabs rnams te/ de rnams las 'jam dkar dang*/ 'jam dpal smra seng*/ dbyangs can ma/ rnam 'joms rigs gnyis rnams ni gsar ma las brgyud pa yin cing*/ drag po 'o bran lugs/ tshe dpag med lung lugs/ dpal mgon legs ldan/ rnam sras gsang sgrub drag po rta sngon ma rnams ni snga 'gyur bka' ma dang*/ stag zhon dang beng rang byung ma rnams ni bka' gter gnyis ldan dang*/

gzhan rnams ni zab gter sna tshogs las byung ba'i gdams pa sha stag go /de ltar le tshan lnga bcu rtsa gsum la brgyud pa'i bka' srol dang cho ga'i khyad par las nang gses su phye bas drug cu rtsa bdun rnams legs par thob bo// rje btsun e waṃ pa'i bstan pa'i rjes su zhugs shing*/ bka' gter chos tshul rgya mtsho'i thos bsam bsgom pas thugs rgyud legs par sbyangs pa'i bla ma bsod nams lhun grub pa las/ 'jam dpal khro chu dug gdong gi dbang bskur ba dang*/ de'i 'don chog po ti sgrub skor dang zin bris kyi skor phal che ba rnams legs par thob cing*/ gzhan yang klong gsal lugs kyi phyag rdor dbang*/ sgrub thabs kyi lung dang bcas pa/ seng gdong dmar mo'i dbang*/ de'i sgrub thabs dbang chog gtor bzlog dang bcas pa'i lung*/ 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i snying po nang bcud kyi dbang snyan brgyud kyi yi ge dang*/ yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i rgyun 'khyer gyi steng nas dbang bskur lung dang bcas pa/ rin chen gling pa'i lugs kyi rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can gyi dbang bskur ba/ gter gzhung gi las byang dang*/ chags med pas mdzad pa'i dbang chog gi steng nas thob/ rdo rje gro lod kyi dbang dang sde brgyad kyi srog dbang*/ rdo rje gro lod phur mjug can gyi rjes su gnang ba dang*/ de la dgos pa'i yi ge rnams kyi lung*/ rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi bka' gtad sngon du 'gro bas/ de'i zhi ba'i sgrub skor cha tshang bka' gtad kyi yi ge bcas dang*/ chags med pas mdzad pa'i zin bris rnams kyi lung*/ rig 'dzin chen po las 'brel rtsal gyi gter ma la/ chags med pas gsal byed mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas/ gza' mchog chen po'i sgo nas nad pa rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ de'i cho ga'i lung dang bcas pa/ rin chen gling pa'i lugs kyi 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha'i rjes su gnang ba 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang las 'byung ba'i yi ge la brten nas thob cing*/

gnam chos thugs gter gyi 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha'i sgo nas gtad khrol dang klu'i gdon khrol khyer bde/ chags med pa'i yi ge'i steng nas gtad khrol lung dang bcas pa thob/ lung rkyang gi skor la/ gu ru chos dbang lugs kyi zhi ba mgron drug can/ sa chog rgyas bsdus gnyis dang bcas pa/ 'jam dpal gshin rje king kang rlung sgrub dmar chung gi las byang rgya zhang khrom pa'i lugs la rig 'dzin dbang po'i sdes bsgrigs pa/ dmod byang sngags tshan re'i mtshams su 'don bya/ gshin rje dmar po'i sgo nas dgra mnan zab pa'i mthar thug ces bya ba dang*/ 'jam dpal ya man+ta ka king kang gi dgra mnan rlung sgrub zab mo'i don 'dus man ngag gis brgyan pa lag len du dril ba shin tu gsal ba rnams kyi lung dang*/ chags med kyis mdzad pa'i skor la/ sdong brgyan mdos kyi nang gsang gsum gcig tu bsdoms pa/ gnam chos thugs gter las/ dzam+bha la nyer gcig gi g.yang skyabs yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ dgongs gter las dbang phyug zor mdos/ gnam chos dang dgongs gter las byung ba'i keg bsgyur lag len gtan la phab pa/ gnam chos lugs kyi zhi ba dkar blugs/ gnam chos thugs gter nas bsgrigs pa'i lha mo'i gtor 'bul nad rims bzlog byed/ tshe ring gtor ku/ 'ug bzlog gnam chos kyi khengs bzlog las hur drag mo/ gza' 'jog sa bdag 'khrugs bcos dang*/ sa bdag dbang chen bsdus pa/ sa bdag snying gter dang bum gter sba thabs/ dgongs gter las dbang phyug ma'i zor mdos/ mgon po'i dgra chos nyung ngu*/ dgra chos dang dgra bzlog gnam chos dme brtsegs ljang gu'i las tshogs/ ma hā ba la'i 'don 'grigs/ las gang gi thog mtha' bar gsum gyi sngon 'gro dkar gtor 'bul ba'i 'don 'grigs/ sreg los/ dur los/ klu bsang*/ dgongs gter klu'i rgyal po dga' bo'i sgrub thabs klu mchod bsags thabs khyer bde/ srid pa'i rgyal mo mu kha le'i sgo nas gza' gdon 'grol ba bka' gter zung 'jug 'khyer bde rnams smad mdo chags med par grags pas mdzad pa rnams kyi lung dang*/

gzhan yang*/ zab mo sngags kyi yang sdeb zab pa'i mthar thug snying gzer nag po zhes bya ba/ u rgyan snying tig gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gis lho brag gnam skas can nas gdan drangs pa/ de'i rgyas bshad/ gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// sngags bdag dregs pa'i tshogs la 'dud// man ngag snying po nag po'i don// bkrol zhing rgyas par bshad pa la// zhes pa nas mthar/ sdeb kyi nang nas yang sdeb 'di// yongs rdzogs bstan srung mthar thug yin// o rgyan snying tig 'di kho na'o// -i thi/ rje 'bangs grogs gsum bskul phyir brtsams// shes rab blo ldan snying rje can dang phrad par shog /ces yod pa'i lung*/ yang man ngag snying gzer nag po'i yig chung*/ ngan sngags gnad kyi lde mig ces pa/ 'gor/ zhi gro yongs rdzogs bla ma la/ zhes dang mthar/ gzhan la mi spel i dam rgya/ 'khor lo can gyi dkrugs yig yin ak+kha khak+nga sogs dkrugs pa'i yi ge 'ga' re yod pa rnams kyi lung legs par thob bo// 'jam dpal gzhon nu 'gro ba gdul slad mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i skye ba bzung ba dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i legs gsungs kyi bdud rtsi skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun gyi dpe zlar thos pa'i lang tsho rab tu rgyas pa'i mdo sngags rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas bzang po pa nyid/ lhun grub steng 'dir rdo rje phur pa'i slob dpon dang*/ rgyud sde chen po rnams nas bstan pa'i dbang bskur byin rlabs rjes su gnang ba khrid lung rnams kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun spel slad du byon pa de nyid zhabs kyi pad+mar bsten pa'i skabs/ thog mar rdo rje phur pa sa lugs kyi smad las drag po dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rjes gnang*/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros pas bsgrigs pa'i yi ge'i steng nas bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor ras bris la brten pa'i rig pa gtad pa'i dbang dang*/

yig cha de nyid kyi lung dang bcas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can lha bcu bdun ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i dbang bskur ba/ gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor las snyan brgyud po ti'i lung*/ dmar po skor gsum gyi gdams ngag po ti gsum gyi lung rnams legs par thos pa'i bcud kyis rna ba'i dbang po skal ba can du bsgrubs pa'i tshul rnams gleng ba chos thos pa'i rnam grangs 'di dag ngor sogs grwa sar bsdad pa nas bzung ste da ltar yan chad kyi dus dang gnas skabs tha dad pa nas thob pa yin yang*/ 'dir snga phyi thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdoms nas smos pa yin no// 'dir smras pa/ ston pa'i bstan skyong mkhan slob gsang ston sogs// dge 'dun dbus su tshigs gsum rim 'bogs kyis// dge slong dngos por bkas gnang bslab pa'i gzhir// slob rung sdom pas shākya'i sras su bskrun// dus gsum rnam 'dren kun bgrod lam po che// gzhan don bla med byang chub sems bskyed kyi// cho ga'i bka' srol brgyud pa zung ldan dang*// dbu ma lugs bcas rgyal ba'i myu gur bskyed// bde gshegs rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso// tha dad min par sprul pa'i zlos gar gyis// rdo rje'i theg sgor 'khrid byed mkhas rnams las// rig sngags 'chang gi dam tshig sdom pa blangs// mdo sngags bstan pa'i snying po bi rū pa'i// srol chen sa skya'i dad sgrol thugs kyi bcud// gsung ngag snyan brgyud tshad ma'i nyams khrid rgyun// cha lag ma tshang med pas yid 'tshor sim// dgyes pa'i rdo rje gur dang saṃ pu ṭa// dus 'khor bde mchog lugs bdun 'dus pa gsum// gshin rje'i gshed gyur dmar nag 'jigs byed gnyis// smin byed dbang bzhi'i bka' srol phal cher bcas// rnal 'byor rgyud kyi thams cad rig pas mtshon// sku dang thugs gsung yon tan phrin las dang*// 'das par 'jig rten skyong bskor maṇ+ḍa la// bcu gnyis dbang bskur zur bka' che gnyis bcas// spyod rgyud mi 'khrugs a ra pa tsa na// rnam par 'joms pa bya rgyud rigs gsum dbang*// tshe dpag med gnyis bsrung lnga dri med gnyis// gtsug tor gdugs dkar rigs gnyis dbang bskur dang*// sa skya'i gser chos zab chos dmar mo gsum// dmar po dmar chung gsum gsum seng ge'i gdong*// 'jam dpal khyung khra bstan srung rnam gnyis sogs// dbang dang byin rlabs nyams khrid gdams pa'i lung*// rdo rje phur pa gur drag bde gshegs 'dus// rta mgrin yang gsang gtum po gsang ba'i bdag

/gshin rje khro chu sman gdong tshe bdag sogs// bka' gter lugs kyi smin byed 'ga' yang nos// dngos grub zung gi 'byung gnas lhag pa'i lha'i// rje gnang thun mong min pa'i skor rnams dang*// thun mong brgya rtsa rgya mtsho snar thang lugs// grags pa'i brgya rtsa rgya bod gzhung dang bcas// bka' dang gter byon lhag pa'i lha srung gi /dbang bskur rjes su gnang dang bka' gtad rigs// zab gces bsdoms pa'i 'dod 'jo'i bum pa bzang*// sgos bka'i rigs 'ga' thos pa'i rna ba yangs// ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu'i thugs kyi bcud// sgyu lus dbang chen sngon 'gro'i zab chos kyi// nyams khrid rjes 'brel byin rlabs sgos bka' rnams// dal rten skyed ma'i drin lan bsams nas mnyan// bsod nams zong brgyas bsgrubs kyang thob dka' ba'i// rgyal ba'i bka' lung nor bu rin che ba// bshes gnyen blo gros ded dpon gyis drangs pa// mi dman skal ba'i mdzod du 'ga' zhig khugs// bka' lung dgongs pa 'phags bod yul gru cher// byon pa'i mkhas grub mkhyen pa'i 'od brgya pas// legs phye bstan bcos pad+ma'i phreng dngar ba// nyer mkho'i rigs can mgrin pa'i rgyan du bsrel// zhes chos smra ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas skye ba phal pa'i rkang 'thung dge sdig 'dres ma'i las kyi yal ga phan tshun 'dzings par bde sdug gi lo 'dab dus kyi rgyal mos re mos su bsgyur ba'i tshul mchid pa las/ rten de la brten nas thos bsam ji ltar byas pa'i sarga ste bzhi pa'o// //thos don phyi nang shes bya'i gnas// bzhugs tshul rtogs tsam rang gzhan don// bsgrub par bzod kyi som nyi'i 'phrang*// 'khrid pa'i 'phyon 'drid des ci bya// lnga pa rang gzhan gyi don gnyis spel mar sgrub pa'i tshul ni/ de'ang ji skad du mgon po byams pas/ gal te thos pa tsam gyis don mthong 'gyur na sgom pa don med 'gyur/

gal te ma thos par yang bsgom 'jug 'gyur na bstan pa don med 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas kyang*/ des na sangs rgyas gsung rab dang*// mkhas pa rnams kyi bstan bcos kyi// tshig don la ni byin rlabs yod// 'di 'dra nyan bshad byed pa la// thos pa zhes ni brjod pa yin// de don dpyod pa bsam pa yin// nan tan gyis ni de sgrub pa// sgom pa yin par shes par bya// thos bsam sgom gsum de ltar gyis// zhes gsungs pa ltar ji ltar thos pa'i chos de dag kyang thos pa tsam gyis chog par mi blta bar de'i don la dpyad pa'i sgo nas legs par gtan la 'bebs dgos pa'ang*/ ston pa nyid kyis kyang*/ bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du// legs par brtags la nga yi bka'// blang bar bya yi gus phyir min// zhes gsungs pa ltar phyi nang shes bya'i gzhung gang du'ang mngon gyur la dpyod pa na mngon sum gyis gnod pa med pa/ cung zad lkog gyur la dpyod pa na dngos stobs rjes dpag gis gnod pa med pa/ shin tu lkog gyur la dpyod pa na lung rnam dag gis gnod pas dben pa dang*/ de'ang ji skad du/ lung yang nges don tshad ma bzung*// drang ba'i don la yid ma rton// rigs pa'ang dngos po stobs zhugs gzung*// rigs pa ltar snang snying po med// ces pa ltar/ lung de'ang lung gi gnas skabs gang yin dang mthun par gtan la phab nas nyams su len pa la 'jug dgos kyi/ de ltar ma yin na ni/ de nyid kyis/ tshe 'di'i bya ba cung zad la'ang*// de 'dra'i 'bad pa byed pa mthong*// skye ba gtan gyi legs nyes ni// dam pa'i chos la rag las kyang*// chos 'di khyi yi zas bzhin du// bzang ngan gang du'ang mi dpyod par// gang 'phrad de la gus par 'dzin// zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu'i gral mjug tu brten ma dgos tsam ni gsung rab chen po rnams kyi drang nges kyi dgongs don dpyod par bzod pa'i blo nus ni shin tu phra mod/

'on te rang gzhan dag la nye bar mkho ba'i rigs gyur gang dag thos pa rnams la rang gi blo gros kyis rtog dpyod ci nus dang*/ rnam par dpyod ldan rnams kyi spyan sngar 'dri gtugs kyi tshul gyis/ rang gzhan gyi nyams su blang ba'i dbang du song na the tshom gyi g.yang kha chen por mchongs ma dgos tsam re bgyid pa'i zol bgyis shing*/ de la brten nas bsgom byung gi shes rab kyi dbang pos dpyad par bya ba'i yul rnams kyang rim gyis grol bar 'gyur ba'ang rang gi rtun pa'i grogs kyis ma bslus na/ rje btsun 'khrul pa zad pa'i dbang po rnams kyi zhal lung gsung rab tshad ma rnams kyis bslu bar mi 'gyur snyam pa'i yid rton 'cha' btub pa tsam du rtogs so// gnas skabs su rgyal dang rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob chen po rnams kyis legs par bshad pa rnams kyi tshig don gyi cha la dag dang ma dag gi dpyad bya 'ga' zhig la dpyod du btub pa ni/ yi ge'i brda'i sbyor ba nas brtsams te/ shes bya rig pa'i gzhung lugs che phra dag la bslab sbyang cung zad bgyis pa'i mthus/ brda sprod pa'i gnas brgyad kyi sgo nas bya byed las gsum dang sbyor tshul dang*/ ti la sogs pa bdag gzhan don can gyi sgo nas dus gsum gyi dbye ba'i 'jug yul rnams la go rtogs rags pa tsam skyes pa'i stobs kyis/ da ltar dpyad 'og tu ma chud pa 'ga' re min pa brda dag bgyid kyin yod pa 'di dag gis kyang bsam pas sgro 'dogs dpyod pa'i grangs su mchi'am snyam mo// de ltar dpyad don bsgom pa'i sgo nas nyams su len pa'ang chu shing gi snying po'i rjes su ma song tsam zhig ni/ gong du smos ltar gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag gis mtshon te/ da ltar rang lugs la dar srol gyi rgyun bzhugs pa'i lam gyi rim pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i rim pa gang dag thos pa rnams kyi sbyang gzhi/

sbyong byed/ sbyang tshul/ sbyangs 'bras rnams lam byed rnam pa bzhi dang sbyor tshul rnams kyi go rtogs rgyud la bskyed pa'i tshul rnams bag chags 'jog lor bgyis mod/ nyams rtogs rgyud la ma skyes bar du sbyang stsol mi nus pa ni/ rang nyid le lo'i snying grogs dbang gis btsan pa 'dis bshol btab pa dang*/ zhu dag la sogs pa'i rnam g.yeng dri bzhon gyi 'tshubs ma'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i stabs kyis/ dkar nag las kyi rgyu 'bras dag la brtsi 'jog mi dgos pa'i nyams rtogs mthon po'i rigs ni rgyud la 'khrungs ma thub/ de'i dbang gis dus gsum gyi mngon par shes pa dang rdzu 'phrul dang grub rtags 'jog pa rnams ni ci yang bstan du ma rnyed par/ deng dus thun mong ba rnams dang chabs cig 'grogs nas/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin pa dang*// nyan dang klog dang 'dzin pa dang*// 'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang*// de sems pa dang sgom pa ste// spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid ni// bsod nams phung po dpag tu med// ces gsungs pa'i phan yon tsam rjes su thos nas/ yi ge 'dri klog sogs kyi bgyi 'os 'gar rtun pa bskyed pa las 'os ci zhig de mthun mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub kun gyi byung gnas lhag pa'i lha tshogs rnams la tshe rabs kun du las 'brel gyi sa bon 'jog pa'i phyir dang*/ bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas par// dkyil 'khor las la 'jug pa dang*// zhes sogs kyi ltung ba mi 'byung ba'i ched du bsnyen pa'i rigs kyang kye rdo rje dang*/ 'jigs byed/ brag rdzong sogs sngon du smos zin pa ltar dang*/ kho bo'i spun zla sha nye bsod nams byams pa 'das pa'i dge brdzong rnams bsgrub/ sa dkar dgon du kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi tshogs gral du 'bod par yang song*/ kun rig gi bsnyen pa zla ba gsum pa sbyin sreg dang bcas pa zhig grub nas zos dal du bsdad yod par/

sde dge'i mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub pa'i sku mdun nas snga thabs 'dir sleb par byed dgos zhes 'phrin yig 'byor ba dang*/ mi ring bar bteg 'ongs par lhun grub steng gi phan bde gling bla brang du son par/ 'bod pa'i rgyu mtshan skabs der mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid mkhan po chen po nyid nas/ sa skyong bstan pa'i sbyin bdag bstan pa tshe ring pa la/ sa skyong chos rgyal chen po rang gi sngon bsags bsod nams kyi stobs dang smon lam dbang gis/ rgyal ba'i bka' lung 'gyur ro 'tshal par bsgrubs pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa rin po che la sku drin che ba'i ngo mtshar bsngags pas mi zad pa'i rang bzhin che la/ da dung mkho che ba bka' lung spyi dang bye brag gi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos kyi nyin mor byed pa lta bur gyur pa ni/ sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma lnga'i gsung rab 'di rnams yin mod/ 'di dag gi dpe rgyun shin tu dkon pas/ rjes su 'jug pa'i slob grwa'i gang zag blo gsal zhing don du gnyer ba rnams kyang*/ bka' 'bum gyi dpe gras mthong thos dkon pa'i dbang gis nyan bshad kyi rgyun dang*/ klog 'dzin byed pa'i don gnyer nyag phrar song ba dang*/ 'gro ba skal ba dman pa kha cig ni bstan pa rnam dag gi rjes su dad cing 'jug pa'ang ches dkon pa dang*/ rmongs dad can chos la dad pa 'ga' zhig lung dang rigs par 'brel zhing brgyud rim tshad ma las byung ba'i man ngag mi bslu nges pa can dang mi phrad par/ gang zag spyi brtol can gyis byas pa'i 'chal gtam nyan sgom byed pa'i rjes su/ smig rgyu'i chu la ri dwags sred pas rgyug pa'i rnam thar rjes su snyegs pa'i ngal ba snying pos dben pa'i rigs can rnams la'ang*/ chos dang chos min gyi dbye ba'i bstan bcos 'di dag mthong thos kyi sgo nas 'jug ldog byed pa'i rgyur yang 'gro srid pas/

'di dag par du bsgrub pa'i bka' drin byung na dgos pa dang phan yon shin tu che ba mchi na ci gnang*/ zhes stsal pa na/ sa skyong nyid nas ji ltar bka' lung gi nor bu rin po che gtsug tu stsal ba ltar/ kho bos par du 'khod pa'i zhabs 'degs bsgrub pa gor ma chag mod/ sa skya'i bka' 'bum 'di rnams sngar yang dad rten du tshar gcig rten bzhengs byas pa yin yang*/ dag po zhig byung ba yod pa'i lo rgyus ma mchis pas/ par du brko ba la ni shin tu dag pa zhig ma byung na/ phyogs thams cad du khyab par 'gyur bas mtshang che/ des na zhu dag la rje btsun dam pa nyid nas gzigs pas khyab pa zhig ni grub mi 'gro bas ji ltar bgyi zhes zhus pa na/ mchod yon gnyis ka nas sngon dus kye rdo rje'i rnam bshad zla zer zhus dag bgyis pa sogs kyis bka' bgros te/ zhu dag par khyod rang gis dgos pa bgyis yod ces phebs par/ kho bos gong ma lnga'i bka' 'bum gyi bsgrigs rim tsam zhig ni sngar lung zhus skabs rtsad dpyad byas pas shes pa min pa sngan chad gsung rab chen po'i zhu dag gi 'gor 'dug ma myong ba dang*/ las byed mang po'i kha ta byed mi shes pas de ltar mi gsung ba zhu zhes/ nan cher zhus kyang khyod kyis shes dgos gsungs nas dgongs grol ma byung bar shes rlom byed pa las 'os ma byung bar bsdad/ zhu dag gi grogs ldan pa ni/ dpal ldan thu mi lo tsā ba'i gzhung gi lugs srol la rnam par dpyod pa'i 'dren byed gsal ldan mgon po bkra shis dang*/ spo lu drung yig blo gros pa/ rmugs sangs sbyin pa rgya mtsho gsum dang bcas te/ bka' 'bum gyi phyi mo ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin dam pa mang pos byon pa'i gdan sa/ skyor mda' bsam gling nas bka' bum shin tu dag pa tshar gcig rga nas ā nan dam pa'i thugs dam rten du bzhengs pa chos rje khu dbon gyi bka' 'bum gser dngul bkra ma bzo rgyu khyad par 'phags pa'i glegs bam drug

ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi dngos slob rab 'byams pa ā nan+da dz+nyā na'i thugs dam rten yin pa thar lam dgon du bzhugs pa dpe khungs ldan yongs rdzogs tshar gcig lhun grub steng 'dir sngar sde dge gong ma rnams kyis bzhengs pa tshang rgyas tshar gcig gzhan yang lcags ra bsam 'grub rtse dang*/ gling mgo zi nas spyan drangs pa tshar gnyis te/ khyon gong ma lnga ka'i gsung rab yongs rdzogs cha lnga dang*/ thor bu'i rigs mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i phyag dpe dngos ma 'ga' re/ gong dkar ba'i par ma gang 'byor rnams dang bcas par gtugs te/ zhus dag bgyis par skabs 'ga' nas tshig don gyi cha mi 'dra ba shas cher byung ba rnams dpyad pa na/ rje btsun dkar po rnam gsum gyi dang po'i gsung rtsom mdzad pa'i gzhi ma brtsams zin 'phral nas slob ma so sos phyogs phyogs su bsnams song ba rnams ni tshig sdud shin tu che ba byung ba dang*/ rtsom gzhi 'ga' zhig la rtsom pa pos slar yang gzigs pas gtan la phab ste bzhag pa'i dpe rgyun yin pa'i rtags su nges pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas dang por gsang chen sngags kyi bstan bcos logs su mdzad pa'i dgongs pa nye bar bzhag pa ni/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba sogs kyi mjug tu bstan pas gsal mod/ phyis su gong ma gsum gyi gsung rab rnams 'gro don shin tu rgyas pa byung na legs par 'gyur ba'i dgongs pas/ sngags kyi bstan bcos chen po logs su ma mdzad par/ gong ma gsum po'i gsung rab rnams la zhu dag gi tshul gyis gtan la phab pa'i byi dor bgyis pa'i phyag rjes su/ skabs 'ga' nas tshig sna cung zad bsring ba lta bur mdzad pa dang*/ bsdus don ha cang rgyas pa rnams cung zad nyung ngur mdzad pa sogs kyang mang du mthong ba rnams ni de dag gi dbang du btang*/ rdo rje'i tshig gi dka' gnas 'ga' zhig la dogs gnas byung ba yid la nges pa byung ba rnams kho bos zhib dpyod kyi sgo nas gang nges kyi thad sor bzo bcos bgyis/

dka' 'grel 'ga' zhig gi tshig don dpyod dka' ba rnams ni/ bka' dang bstan bcos gang yin gyi rtsa ba dang gtugs te/ de dang mthun shas gang che'i dbang du btang ba sogs kyis zhus dag nan cher slan chad yid rton byar rung ba'i khul du bgyis so// de 'phral yig mkhan mang po'i khrod nas bkrabs pa bcu drug dang*/ dbu lha 'dri mkhan lha ris pa gcig dang*/ par brkos mkhas btus brgya lnga bcu tsam bkrabs te/ kun dga' zhes pa chu stag gi lo'i hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes lnga gza' skar dge ba'i nyin par gzhi 'dri ba'i 'go tshugs pa nas brtsams te shing yos khrums stod kyis nya ba'i zhag gi phung po'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin yig mkhan rnams kyis rdzogs par bris grub pa dang*/ me 'brug gi gnam lo'i zla tshes dge bar par gyi zhu dag dang bcas yongs su grub pa byung ngo*// de 'phral sa skyong chen po nyid nas par du bkod pa'i dkar chag mkhan chen sku zhabs nyid nas bka' rtsom gnang dgos par bskul mod/ 'di dag gi skabs kun du dgun zla rnams su kho bo cag las byed grogs ldan pa rnams dang bcas pa rang yul du btang nas/ lo gsar nas brtsams te hor zla dgu pa'i nang bar du 'dri zhus sogs kyi las tshan thams cad 'dzom dgos srol yod pas/ 'di skabs kyang nam zla hor lugs kyi zla ba dgu pa rdzogs nas bcu pa'i 'go zin te/ zla bzhin dgun gyi rgyal mos tsha ba'i gdung bas nyen pa'i 'gro ba rnams la phan byed ut+pal dkar po lta bu'i kha ba'i phye mas phyogs kyi sa 'dzin dbang po'i phreng ba dag kyang rab dkar kā shi ka'i ras kyis thod bcing byas pa lta bu'i reg byas bskul te/ las byed rnams kyang ngal gso'i bdud rtsi'i dga' ston spyad phyir so sor gyes pa dang*/ mnyam du rang nyid kyang pha yul du bteg cing der slebs 'phral nas/ sngon dus rdo rje 'dzin dbang chen po dbang bla kun dga' bstan 'dzin pas dbang bskur gyi skabs su/

khyod kyis 'di'i bsnyen sgrub bgyis na legs pa 'ong tshul phebs pa ltar/ rdo rje tshe'i ras bris nyin gang gis tshar phyin pa zhig sug bris su bgyis te/ phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i bsnyen pa dang rdo rje tshe'i sgrub pa bcas la zla ba gsum pa zhig bsdad/ de grol nas mi ring bar sa skyong chen po nas bsu mkhan gyis son pa dang mnyam du bteg nas 'ongs pa lhun grub steng du bde bar son pa na/ skabs der mkhan chen nyid zhabs 'bam gyis snyun nas mchis par/ sngon mar khyod kyis bka' 'bum gyi dkar chag rtsom pa'i gzhi khod dang de rjes nged kyis bzo bcos gang 'os byed na min pa sa skyong thugs rtsol che bas ma 'gyang bar byed pa legs zhes kho bor bka' stsal gnang ba ltar/ bdag gis de 'phral du brtsams nas mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa chog gi spyan sngar gzigs su phul bar bzo bcos cung zad re mdzad pa ma gtogs yang bzo ma dgos par/ mang nyung 'tsham pa sogs gang ci nas 'di kho nas chog par 'dug ces thugs dgyes pa dang bcas te/ de 'phral nyid du sa skyong chos kyi sbyin bdag nyid la gzigs 'bul du btang bar/ thugs dgyes nang ba'i tshul gyis de 'phral nyid du par la 'khod pa mdzad song ngo*// de'i rjes su ngor lugs dkyil 'khor bdun du grags pas mtshon pa'i tshogs 'don cho ga dang chos brjod kyi par sngon nas bzhugs pa rnams ni 'gro don ha cang ches pas par gyi ngo brdar bas gsal por ma byung ba dang*/ sngon gyi par rnyings 'ga' re ni dag po ma byung bas bslad pa rnams bcas gsar bskrun gyis zhes gsungs pa rnams bsdoms pa po ti bdun tsam gsar du zhus dag dang 'dri rkos byed pa'i 'go tshugs nas po ti gsum gyi dod tsam bris zin pa byung ngo*// de mtshams dgun zla dang por rang gi pha yul du bteg ldan sa dkar dgon der sngon mar kye rdo rje'i bsnyen pa'i kha gsos zhag po nyer gcig tsam dang*/

de'i mthar las bzhi'i sbyin sreg du bcas pa byas/ de mthar 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na dmar ser gyi bsnyen pa zla ba gcig bsdad par rmi lam la dge ba'i ltas 'dra ba byung*/ de'i skabs mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa'i sku dbon mkhas btsun bla ma tshul khrims dbang phyug pas byon nas/ da lam khong la ba ri lugs kyi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang dgos tshul gsung byung bar/ kho bos de sngon phan chad lung rkyang tsam min pa/ dbang bskur dang rjes gnang sogs chos 'chad kyi rtsol ba ci yang ma byas kyang*/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang pos dbus gtsang phyogs su chibs kyi gdong bsgyur nye ba na/ nga'i nu bo tshul khrims dbang phyug 'di la chos dang 'jig rten gyi bslab ston gang 'tsham khyod kyis mi 'phyugs par gyis zhes bka' lung gser gyi 'phrin yig spyi bor stsal ba rjes su dran pa dang*/ gcig tu na deng 'dir dam pa'i chos ston dgos zhes zhu ba po byung ba'i zhu ngo bzlog na rten 'brel mi legs pa'i rgyur yang 'gro snyam nas/ sngon chad rjes gnang gi gong bshad kyi dpe tsam yang nyer bsdogs bsgrubs pa med mod/ gsung ngag snang ba gsum gyi khrid yig las 'byung ba'i dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i bshad pa sogs la bltas shing bsgrigs pa dang bcas te/ phyi nyin gza' skar dge ba zhig kyang 'dzom par brten/ sgrub thabs rang gzhung na rjes gnang gi thog mar thub pa rdo rje gdan pa gtso 'khor bzhugs na'ang*/ chos bshad thog ma'i rten 'brel du chos sgo dbye ba'i shis par brjod pa'i sgo lta bur 'jam dpal gyis byas na legs snyam pas/ 'jam dpal brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i rjes gnang nyid sngon du blangs pa nas brtsams te rjes su gnang ba rgya bod kyi gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa rdzogs par phul/ gzhan yang seng gdong sngon mo la sogs pa'i rjes su gnang ba zur pa 'ga' re'ang byas te/

'di dag ni bdag gi gzhan don chos bshad phrin las kun gyi sngon ma nyid yin no// de'i tshe gong bshad de nyid kyang yi ger 'god dgos zhes zhu ba po de nyid kyis gsungs pa'i ngor/ dbang dang rjes gnang sogs kyi gong du spro bar 'os pa'i chos gtam dbyar gyi rnga gsang zhes bya ba de dus su bskrun pa yin/ de mtshams nas slar mtshams bcad de bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang*/ 'jam dpal dkar po paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti'i lugs kyi bsnyen pa'ang zhag shas byas/ dgon der dge slong lhun grub bzang po zhes mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan ldan pa zhig bzhugs pa des dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ bsil ldan ljongs kyi grub chen gnyen tshem bu pa'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid rgyas pa nyin dgur rdzogs pa zhig dang*/ bdag gi drin chen skyed byed ma bo chog can la kun rig dbang tshar lnga tsam byas/ slar yang de'i rjes su mgon bla bgres po dang dge slong bsod nams legs grub sogs don gnyer gyi slob bu bcu gsum tsam dang rang gi ma rgan bcas la dmar khrid rgyas pa tshar gcig 'don khul bgyis/ don gnyer nyung shas la lam 'bras lugs kyi lus sbyangs byas bsdus dang phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi 'khrul 'khor rnams bslab grogs bgyis/ dmar ser zhes pa me sbrul gyi gnam lo gsar tshes nang lhun grub steng du 'ongs nas sngar gyi las 'phro lus pa rnams 'dri zhus dang dbu lha par byang lañca na wartu la'i rigs sug bris dgos pa rnams 'dri rtsol bgyis so// de mtshams nas brgya phrag rigs kyi cod paṇa rnam 'dren bstan pa'i snang byed mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub pa'i zhal snga nas/ phyag mdzod gu ru bkra shis can brgyud de sa skyong rgyal ba'i sras chen gang der/ 'di skad du gsol ba rjes su thos te/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po nyid nas par du bsgrub dgos kyi chos sbyin sngon chad brtsams pa thams cad legs par grub pa'i mtshams yin 'dug par/

slar yang thub pa'i bka' lung gi dgongs 'grel bod du 'gyur ro 'tshal 'di rnams ni/ ji skad du/ mgon po byams pas/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'du// legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel bcas// de yi dbang gis shākya'i bstan pa ni// 'jig rten khams su yun ring gnas par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal ba'i bka' lung rin po che dgongs 'grel du bcas pa gang du bzhugs pa de na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs par bzhugs pa yin pa dang*/ mdo sngags kyi chos thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi dgongs don dang mthun nam mi mthun dpyod pa'i 'dren byed lta bu med du mi rung ba'i bstan bcos yin pas dgongs 'grel 'di dag par bsgrubs pa zhig byung na sngon chad ma grags pa'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mchog gi mdzad par 'gro bas de ltar sgrub pa ci gnang zhes bskul ba na/ sa skyong chen po nas de skad bskul ba snyan dbang du dengs pa'i 'phral nyid du thugs dgyes bla na med pa'i 'dzum dkar gyi phreng ba brgya phrag grol ba ni/ sprin bral nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od zer phog pa'i chu skyes gzhon nu'i tshal gyi 'dab stong lhan cig 'dzum pa lta bu'i ji ltar phebs don cis kyang bsgrub mod/ dgongs 'grel 'di dag chos tshan shin tu che bas nga rang kho nas 'grub dka' bsams kyang 'di lor 'go brtsams byas na rjes 'dzin khong tsho'i sku ring tshun la mi 'grub pa'i don ci la yod lags pas de ltar bgyi'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes nas/ hor zla lnga pa'i dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gsum pa'i gral tshes gza' skar dge ba'i dus sbyor 'dzom par mgo brtsams pa'i nyer bsdogs su/ mdo sdud par ji skad du/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba mang*// zhes chos sgrub pa la nag phyogs bdud ris rnams kyis tho btsams shing bar chad mang bar bshad pa ltar gegs rkyen sel byed du/

mgon khang chen por mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang nyid tshogs dbur spyan drangs pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis bskang gso dang*/ rten bzhengs kyi gnang ba zhu ba dang bar chad mi 'byung ba'i 'phrin las bcol/ mgon khang shar du de bzhin du bskang gso dang 'phrin las bcol ba mdzad de/ par gyi gzhi ma'i zhu dag dang 'dri ba'i las tshan gyi 'go dpon dang*/ zhu dag pa/ yig mkhan rnams 'di lor snga mkhor gnas pa rnams dang*/ da gzod nas yig mkhan sogs las tshan grogs ldan kha bsabs rgyu'i bkod pa bcas legs par stsal to// de la kho bo cag ni 'di snyam du sems te/ ji ltar bka' lung phebs pa ltar thams cad nas bsgrub pa'i nus pa rang rang la 'byung bar gyur na/ mi bdag chen pos snga na med pa'i byang chub kyi spyad pa rmad du byung ba spyod pa la zhugs pa'i bzhed pa sgrub pa'i zhar la rang rang nas kyang bstan pa la las bzang byas pa'i dam pa dam pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro ba dang*/ sa skyong chen pos legs byas chu gter chen po'i spun zlar bskrun pa der/ rang re'i las bzang chu thigs tsam res lhung ba'i rgyun yang de srid kyi bar du 'dzad par mi 'gyur ba'i phan yon dang*/ chos ldan rgyal po yab sras kyis kun mkhyen nyi ma'i rtsa lag chen po sras slob bcas pa'i bstan pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar srid zhi'i dgos 'dod ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas gang de mi nub par ring du gnas pa'i snying stobs kyi khur chen bskyed pa la/ rang res kyang las bzang gi 'brel pa bzhag pa'i skal ba mchog tu sbom pa/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus rnyed pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa dang mjal zhing dam pa'i chos la bya ba byas pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro bar 'gyur ba sogs tshul 'di la bsams na/ las byed pa kun kyang spro ba mchog tu brtas pa ni/ dper na chu 'dzin stug por 'khrigs pa'i khrod nas dbyar gyi rnga gsang lhod por dgod pa'i sgra dbyangs thos pa'i gtsug phud can bzhin kun dga' sar pa'i zlos gar bsgyur pa'i rang bzhin du mchis mod/

ma la shes bya'i gnas thams cad la chos kyi 'dren byed dri bral brnyes pas stobs bcu mnga' ba'i legs gsungs mtha' dag rang dbang 'grel pa la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i smra ba'i dbang phyug chen po rnams kyi bstan bcos kyi phung po rnams shin tu zab cing ches brling ba dag gi tshig don la dag dang ma dag so sor dpyod pa'i dpang por byed pa'i nus pa med bzhin du shes rlom mgrin bzang gi lus la gzig lpags kyis bklubs pa'i g.yo thabs lta bur bgyid pa bas/ da lam skabs 'dir dgongs pa zhus te gyi nar bsdad pa legs che zhing*/ sde dge bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po 'di lta bu la zhus dag byed pa'i dpang pos thabs chag 'ong mi 'gro snyam ste/ gnas tshul zhib par zhu 'bul byed du bcug mod/ deng rten bzhengs 'di'i zhu dag la las tshan gzing rtsod mi 'byung ba sogs gang ci nas khyed dge lam che ba byung bas khyed med pas mi chog par mkhan chen bstan pa'i bdag po nyid dang*/ mi bdag bstan pa'i sbyin bdag ste mchod yon chen po nyi zla zung du 'brel ba lta bu gnyis ka nas bkod sbyar byas pa yin pas 'di la'ang cis kyang lta grogs byed dgos zhes bka' nan bzlas te phebs pa/ de nyid las brgal bar ma nus par khas 'ches nas bsdad pa yin no// de ltar bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i nyer bsdogs kyi bkod pa stsal nas/ dus tshes dge ba'i nyin de nyid nas 'dri zhus kyi 'go brtsams te/ dgongs 'grel gyi bzhugs tshul ltar na mchog dman gyi rim pas thog mar rgyud kyi 'grel pa nas 'dri bar 'os na'ang*/ de nyid bka' gnyan cing mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi 'khu ldog che bar bsams nas/ sngon du mtshan nyid theg pa'i 'dri 'don gyi 'go brtsams so// de la'ang spyir sangs rgyas dang rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can rnams yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ de dag gi bsam pa sna tshogs pa dag mkhyen nas rnam par 'phrul pa'ang sna tshogs pa bstan pa las/

'dir mtha' 'khob kyi sems can rnams chos la gzud pa'i phyir bho ṭa'i yul du rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa'i skye bar bzhes pa rnams kyi thugs bskyed dang*/ de dag gis 'phags bal kasmi ra la sogs pa'i yul nas spyan drangs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta dang grub pa'i sa la gnas pa'i skyes bu dam pa mang po spyan drangs pa dang*/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po 'jig rten kun gyi mig tu gyur pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyi thugs bskyed dang brtson pa chen pos rgya gar gyi yul gru tha dad pa gang dag tu bzhugs pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos ji snyed pa phal cher gangs can pa'i brda'i lam du bsgyur ba dang*/ bshad pa dang*/ dpyad pa gsum gyis gtan la phab/ khyad par rgyal po sad na legs mjing yon gyi sku ring la ban+de dpal brtsegs rak+ṣi ta la sogs pa 'phang thang ka med na bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams bam po'i tshad byas te chos tshan gyi rnam grangs so sor bkod pa la dkar chag 'phang thang ma grags pa brtsams/ de'i rjes su ban+de dpal brtsegs dang*/ 'khon klu'i dbang pos bsrungs pa la sogs pas stong thang ldan dkar gyi pho brang na bzhugs pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal rnams sh+lau ka dang bam po'i grangs tshad nges par gtan la phab pa rnams kyi mtshan byang btab pa la dkar chag ldan dkar mar grags pa brtsams/ de'i rjes su btsad po khri lde srong btsan pho brang 'on cang gi rdor bzhugs pa na/ nyi 'og gi mkhan po ā tsar+ya dzi na mi tra dang*/ su ran+d+ra bod+dhi la sogs par rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang bstan bcos kyi rigs sngar bsgyur ba rnams skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ ma bsgyur ba rnams gsar du bsgyur du bcug bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su'ang chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs bskyed dang*/ rig pa'i gnas lnga smra ba'i dbang phyug rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyi sku drin gyis dam pa'i chos sngar ma bsgyur ba rnams bsgyur ba dang bshad pa la sogs pas dar rgyas su byas so// phyi dus shig nas snar thang gi 'jam dbyangs ral gri dang 'jam sgeg pak+shi gnyis ka'i slob ma dbus pa blo gsal byang chub ye shes kyis/

bka' dang bstan bcos la bam tshad dang 'gyur byang nges pa'i dkar chag brtsams/ 'jam sgeg hor rgyal bu yan du'i bla mar dbang bskur ba des rgya nag nas yo byad mang po gnang ste/ lo tsā ba bsod nams 'od zer dang dbus pa blo gsal sangs rgyas 'bum/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum gsum gyis 'bad pa chen pos dbus gtsang thams cad nas phyi mo btsal te/ bka' dang bstan bcos bod du 'gyur ro 'tshal bzhengs pa la snar thang gi bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur zhes grags pa byung ste/ de las rim gyis mched cing 'phel lo// bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal ni/ sku zhang chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i sras kyi thu bo gtsug lag zung la mkhyen dpyod nyi zla ltar gsal ba dpon chen kun dga' don grub pas rten bzheng gi phyi mor snar thang na bzhugs pa gzhir bzhag der ma bzhugs pa'i dpe tshan gyi rigs dbus gtsang phyogs gang rnyed bsdoms te bzhengs pa na/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po mkhas grub bu ston gyis/ chos rnams kyi mtshan byang dang mdzad 'gyur mtha' dpyad dang bcas pas gtan la phab pa'i dkar chag nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i phreng ba zhes bya ba brtsams so// de rjes tshal pa si tu dge ba'i blo gros kyis skyid shod tshal gung thang du/ zhwa lu'i gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i dgongs 'grel rnams phyi mor bzung*/ der ma chud pa phyis su rnyed pa dang*/ gsar du 'gyur ba bcas bsnan pa'i glegs bam gyi tshogs rnams bzhengs te/ kun mkhyen bu ston chen pos slar bsnan pa rnams bcas pa'i dkar chag yid bzhin nor bu rin po che'i za ma tog ces pa brtsams so// dus phyis shes bya'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag gi bzhed don ngo mtshar gzugs kyi snang ba ji snyed mkhyen dpyod kyi kun mthong gcig tu rnam par bkra zhing*/ tshul bzhin legs par 'doms pa'i dbang phyug mi rje sangs rgyas rgya mtshos/ gsar rnying ris bral gyi bstan pa'i snang byed rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho zhes yongs su grags pa gang de'i zhabs kyi chu skyes mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khri 'phang du brtan phyir/

'phying bar stag rtse'i pho brang du dgongs 'grel 'gyur ro 'tshal bzhengs pa'i tshe bu ston gyis bsgrigs pa'i dkar chag sor gnas kyi khar/ dbus phyogs kun du btsal nas 'byor ba dang*/ gsar 'gyur gyi rigs mdo sngags rig gnas kyi rigs dpe khungs btsun pa bsabs pa dpe tshan bdun brgya brgyad cu tsam bsnan te bzhengs pa'i tshe/ phyi mo'i sdeb kyi zhu chen rnam gling paṇa chen dkon mchog chos grags kyis gtsos pa'i brda dag rig gnas la sbyangs pa mang pos dag par byas te bzhengs pa/ de'i dkar chag 'jig rten gsum gyi bde skyid pad tshal bzhad pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos brtsams te/ de dag las mched pa'i dgongs 'grel gyi dpe rgyun dbus gtsang phyogs kyi gdan sa chen po rnams su dar rgyas che ba bzhugs pa gor ma chag 'on te mdo smad kyi ljongs 'dir 'thor bu'i rigs mang ba tsam las/ yongs su tshang ba dkar chag rgyas pas zin pa zhig 'dri srol cher ma byung bar phyi mor btub pa'i dpe ma 'tshal zhing*/ rga stod phyogs na ā gnyan dam pa zhes/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma'i thu bor gyur cing dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po gang de/ chen po hor gyi rgyal khams su'ang ā gnyen pak+shi zhes yongs su grags pa gang de'i rigs kyi dbon du gyur pa zhig gis zhwa lu gser khang na bzhugs pa'i dgongs 'grel 'gyur ro 'tshal la phyi mor bgyis te bzhengs pa'i glegs bam gyi tshogs tshar gcig dus phyis si tu sprul pa'i sku karma chos kyi 'byung gnas pas/ 'phying bar stag rtse'i pho brang na bzhugs pa'i dpe rgyun ltar las/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skabs kyi kha bskang byas pa rnams ma rdzogs pa ma gtogs bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi phyi mo khungs thub tshar gcig dang*/ dus gsum gzigs pa'i dbang po karma pa mthon mthing cod paṇa 'chang ba rim par byon pa nas/

karma pa ye shes rdo rje'i bar byon pa rnams kyi thugs dam rten du bzhugs pa/ dus phyis sa skyong chos rgyal chen po bstan pa tshe ring pa la bsod nams tshogs bsags kyi rten du stsal ba tshar gcig dang*/ sa skyong bstan pa tshe ring pas/ karma si tu pas bzhengs pa la phyi mor bzung ste mthing shog gi gzhi la rin po che dngul dkar gyis bris pa tshar gcig gzhan yang sa skya pa'i mkhas pa g.yag rong sogs kyi sku ring la/ tshad ma mdo dang rnam 'grel tshad ma'i skor// 'dul ba mdo dang mdo rtsa 'dul ba'i skor// kun las btus dang mdzod gnyis mngon pa'i skor// byams chos lnga dang spyod 'jug phar phyin skor// dbu ma rtsa 'jug gzhi gsum dbu ma'i skor// rig gter sdom gsum tshad ma spyi yi skor// zhes po ti grags chen bco brgyad zhes bya ba'i tha snyad byung ba rnams dbus gtsang phyogs su dar rgyas che bas par la 'khod pa rnams kyi phyi mo'ang bsags/ de rnams kyi nang nas/ rga ā gnyan pa nas byung ba'i bstan bcos ni mdo phyogs kyi skor dang*/ rgyud 'grel nyung shas shig ni skabs re nas 'gyur khyad mi 'dra tsam ma gtogs shin tu dag pa yid rton rung ba mchis mod/ de las gzhan pa'i rgyud 'grel rnams dang*/ brda sprod rig pa'i skor dang*/ tshad ma rig pa'i skor nas phyis su phal cher 'thor god song bas yin nam snyam pa ma tshang ba mang*/ der ma tshang ba 'ga' zhig ni rjes ma 'gas kha skong thon lo byas pa'ang*/ yig mkhan mkhas po ma byung ba dang chad lhag mang ba sogs yid brtan 'char ma btub mod/ skabs re nas chad mthud cung zad res phan thogs pa byung ngo*// de bzhin du karma pa nas stsal ba'i glegs bam gyi tshogs rnams glegs thag glegs shing phyi nang gi na bza' rnams ni ngo mtshar mig gi bdud rtsir mchis rung*/ yig mkhan su byung gang byung gis bris pa dang*/ bris zin 'phral nas zhus dag song ba'i rjes tsam yang med pa'i ma dag pa shin tu mang ba dang*/

rig gnas kyi bstan bcos skor ni nyung tsam min pa gzhan ltar rgyas pa'ang ma bzhugs/ 'on kyang snga mo nas gyes pa'i dpe rgyun las mched pa yin nam snyam pas bcad 'khrugs pa'i mtshams dang*/ skabs re nas cung zad phan 'dogs nus pa byung*/ sa skyong nyid kyis bzhengs pa ni/ phyi mo dngos dang ma bur snang bas lhag chad mnyam por byung bas phan 'dogs nus pa ma byung ngo*// phyi mo de thams cad kyi nang nas/ si tu pas dbus 'gyur 'chang nas bzhengs pa'i bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal nyid ni tshang zhing rgyas pa dang*/ khyad par mtshan nyid theg pa'i skor dang sngags kyi theg pa'i skabs 'ga' nas shin tu dag che ba byung bas 'di nyid gtso bor bzung*/ 'di'i nang nas kyang tshad ma'i skor la sogs 'ga' zhig nas yig mkhan gyis bslad skyon chad lhag dang bri nor byas pa brtag dka' ba ma nyung tsam du mchis par phyi mo gzhan la yod pa nas cung zad re las phan skyed cher ma byung yang*/ de las gzhan pa'i dpe rgyun ni ma rnyed par sor bzhag de'ang phyis su sa skyong bstan pa tshe ring pa'i sku ring la dngul bris can bri ba'i skabs rga ā gnyan pa nas bzhengs pa'i dgongs 'grel g.yar nas de dang zhu dag byas tshe/ gang zag rang stobs kyi go tshul mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis bzo bcos ches song bas lan nam/ de skabs zhu dag gnon mkhan mkhas 'phring mang po bskos nas/ so so'i zhus dag byas pa'i lag rjes/ la las sems bying rgod dbang gis ma mthong ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis go ba dpyis phyin ma byung yang bzo bcos ci rigs pa re byas pa dang*/ kha cig gis gzhan la dri gtugs byas na rang nyid ma shes pa'i gral du lhung ba'i dogs pas shes rlom lta bus bzo bcos ci rigs pa re byas/ bzo bcos byas pa'i rjes de slad nas zhu dag mkhan rjes mas bltas tshe/ gal te bcos nor byas pa shes nas slar yang bzo dgos pa byung ba na/ de skabs tshe ring 'phel dang karma dpal grub pa sogs 'go pa rnams kyi bca' khrims ha cang dam ches pas yi ge pas bri nor dang*/

zhus dag pas bcos nor lan re byung ba la nas 'dong gang re/ lan gnyis byung ba 'dong do sogs nyes pa'i chad las mjal dgos byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ gal te slar bcos nor byas pa'i rjes mthong du shor na chad pas phog pa sogs kyi dogs pas/ dpe cha bcos gzhi gang la phyi mo gzhan gyi nang ltar bzo bcos byas/ de'ang mchan bu lta bu'ang ma byas par/ sngon mar ci yod gri so rnon pos rjes mi mngon par bzhar nas/ de'i mal du gsar pa bris nas bsnan pa'i rjes shin tu mang bas 'ga' re yin los yod kyang*/ 'ga' re ni 'brel ma chags snyam pa'i lag rjes kyis mang du bslad 'dug par/ bzo bcos ma byas pa'i sngon ma'i rjes ci yod kyang shin tu dpyod dka' ba snang zhing*/ gsar du bris pa nyid ni 'brel ma chags pa mchis snyam pa rnams/ rang dang 'don grogs rnams kyis gang shes dpyad par phal cher go ba'i shugs kyis shes par 'gyur mod/ 'ga' re nas ni tshig bar bcu nyi shu lta bu yal song ba'i rjes shul dpyod dka' ba 'ga' zhig nas lo tsā ba'i 'gyur snga phyi'i khyad par yod pa rnams dang gtugs nas/ tshig snga phyi 'jog tshul mi 'dra bar yod pa rnams rang rang gi lugs sor bzhag la/ tshig zlos pa dang*/ ma tshang bar mi 'gro bar dbri bsnan bya ba'i tshul gyis bzo tshul dang*/ 'ga' zhig ni 'grel bya'i mdo rgyud gang yin nam gzhung gi rtsa ba dang dka' 'grel gang yin la gtugs nas de dang 'gros mthun gyi bshad pa'i bzo tshul dang*/ 'ga' zhig tu sa bcad gong 'og 'khrugs pa'i mtshams mthong ba rnams la'ang dpyod cing 'khrugs pa go rims su bsdebs pa'i sgo nas bzo tshul bgyis shing*/ sngags kyi tshig 'bru rnams la'ang legs sbyar yin nges kyi sngags rnams la phyi mo 'dra min byung ba'i thad nas dang*/ dag dang ma dag byung ba'i thad nas 'ga' re min pa cung zad dpyod par sla mod/ zur chag gi skad dang*/ rang bzhin pa'i skad dang*/

sha za'i skad kyis bzhugs pa rnams ni gzu lums kyis bcos lhad ci yang ma song bar phyi mo sor bzhag bgyis/ tshul de dag gis kyang dogs sel ma bzod pa rnams la rtags dang mchan bus mtshan par byas te zhu dag bgyis pa'i khul du bgyis so// de lta na'ang sangs rgyas kyi rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing 'di nyid ni 'bras spungs kyi par yig la phyi mo bgyis nas sngon ma nyid nas bri rgyur byas par/ der sngon du zhwa lu lo chen sogs kyis 'gyur bcos nan tan mdzad pa la/ slar yang par du 'khod par gnang skabs kyang rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang 'dar lo ngag dbang phun tshogs pa rnam gnyis kyis rgya dper legs sbyar gyi skad la yod pa bod skad la med pa dang*/ bod skad yod pa legs sbyar gyi skad la med pa rnams kyang skad dod bsgrigs nas kha skong ba dang bcas te skad gnyis shan sbyar du bkod pa'i bstan bcos dpyod ldan yongs kyi 'dren byed dbang po'i dga' ston bla na med pa nyid du bzhugs tshul shin tu legs pa mchis mod/ par du 'khod skabs kyi phyi mo de gshar yig zhig la brten nas bris pa'i rtags su/ yig mkhan rnams kyis pa dang sa/ ra dang ta/ la dang ma/ ra'i mgo can rta yig brtsegs ma sogs phan tshun 'dzol te bris pa ni/ dper na don mthun gyi skad dod sār+tha la/ pat+tha/ ri bo'i skad dod parba ta la sarba ta/ sbrul gyi skad dod sar+pa la sarba/ de bzhin du kalpa la kam+pa/ daṇ+ḍa la darta/ at+ma la arma bris pa lta bu mang du mchis par/ kho bos bzo bcos gang nges rnams nas zhu dag byas pa yig sdeb lnga bcu'am drug cu tsam tshar ba'i skabs nas/ nang blon mdun na 'don gnyer a srung can de dus khyim bdag yin pas khong la grub mtha'i phyogs ris yod dgos ci la yod kyang*/ grub mtha'i phyogs lhung lta bu yin nam/ rang nyid mi thabs la ma mkhas pas len nam/ gang gis yin shes dka' ba zhig gis/

kho bos ji ltar bgyis kyang thugs dgyes bskyed mi bzod pa lta bu'i tshig zur rtag tu 'byon pa zhig bzhugs pa'i zhal nas chos srid thams cad gcig shes kun grol lta bu'i dgongs pas rtogs brjod 'khri shing la zhu dag byed pa mi 'thad pa dang*/ zhu dag gis bcos che ba mi legs pa'i tshul gyi gsung sgros gzhan 'ga' la btang gin yod pa thos mod/ bden nges med dam snyam nas rang gis gang shes phyogs nas zhu dag byed pa'i skabs yin na'ang*/ thugs rgyud snying rjes shin tu mnyen par gyur pa'i dam pa rnams ni yid 'ong dar gyi srad bu khab rjes su mi 'brang ba med pa ltar/ gzhan gyis bsgyur ba la dka' las ci zhig yod de/ mi ring bar sa skyong chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa'i mdun du kho bo las tshan bcas pa'i bzhugs gral ston mo'i skabs nas/ kho bo la 'di skad du gleng ba thos te/ khyod kyis deng dus ci zhu dag byed kyin yod ces phebs par/ bdag gis rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi legs sbyar gyi skad la zhus dag byed skabs lags zhus par/ dpag bsam 'khri shing sde pa gzhung gis zhus dag yang yang byas pa la da zhu dag byed rgyu ci yod/ lar zhu dag gis bcos che ba 'di rnams mi dga' du zhes phebs byung bar/ 'phral du mi chen la gsung len bzlas na mi dgyes par 'gyur srid snyam nas ci yang ma zhus par bzhag stod cha cung zad bcos zin pa ma gtogs pa de phyin nas legs sbyar skad snga ma sor bzhag nas bris nor byung ba mngon sum mthong ba rnams kyang sbyin bdag gi dgongs pa dang mthun par bzhag dgos byung yod par/ slad char brda sprod gzhung la sbyangs pa dag gis bltas na shes par 'gyur srid snyam pa las ci byar yod de/ ji skad du sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ ma bslabs pa la kun mkhyen zhig /byung na rgyu 'bras ga la bden// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa 'di// thams cad mkhyen pa'i khyad chos yin// zhes gsungs pa'i skabs su bab pas so// de mtshams nas kho bos chos tshan gzhan rnams nas zhu dag dang yin min dpyod pa'i grogs ldan ci nus bgyis/

skabs der ldan yul nas rang gi dal 'byor gyi rten skyed pa'i drin mtha' gzhal du med pa'i ma rgan dus kyi chos su yol ba'i bya ma rtas slebs byung bar/ 'da' kar phrad pa zhig ma byung snyam pas 'gyod cing skyo sems drag po skyes kyang*/ 'di nas rten bzhengs chen po'i las tshan gyi 'go par song bas dgongs pa zhu 'os ma mchis/ 'on kyang 'di nyid nas mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub par rjes su 'dzin par gsol ba btab pas ngan song sbyong ba kun rig gi dkyil 'khor chen por sgrub mchod dang dbang bskur byang zhus dang bcas pa rgyas par mdzad pa'i bka' drin gyis bskyang*/ gzhan du phan thogs 'byung min ji ltar yin rung rang gis drin lan bsabs pa'i ched du dgung bdun gyi bar cho ga 'don pa zhig byung na dgos pa che ba go mod/ rang gis kun rig tshar gsum tsam dang*/ sde dge grwa tshang rnams su smon lam rnam bzhi 'don rten phul ba tsam las gzhan dge bskul 'grub pa'i stabs 'grigs ma byung*/ sa dkar rang du tshogs par kun rig stong tshar dang dgung zhag mi grangs bgrangs nas 'don pa'i lugs dang*/ nga rang gis 'don pa'i tshab tu dge slong bsod nams legs grub ces pa rang gi bu slob bya ba tshad ldan byed pa zhig yod pa de la dgung zhe dgu'i bar du kun rig gi cho ga khrus dbang dang bcas pa byed du bcug ngor bla brang mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong pa khrir bzhugs pa'i skabs yin pa/ de nyid sngar khams su byon pa'i skabs kyang dbang chos kyi 'brel pa mang du thob pa dang*/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa las kye rdo rje'i rgyu dbang*/ sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang dang*/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi dbang krī ya sa muts+tsha bcas pas mtshon pa'i dbang dang rjes su gnang ba'i chos kyi 'brel pa mang du thos pa ste/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gnyis kyi drung du tshogs bsngo gsung rten bcas phul/

de ltar dgongs 'grel gyi zhu dag byed pa'i zhar la/ spo lu drung yig dang*/ rmugs sangs bla ma sbyin pa rgya mtsho sogs don gnyer 'ga'i ngor gser chos rdo rje khyung khra'i rjes su gnang ba man ngag las tshogs rnams kyi lung bcas dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī nas brgyud pa'i dbyangs can dkar mo'i rjes su gnang ba lung bcas dang*/ gser chos kyi seng ge'i gdong can sngon mo'i rjes gnang sogs dgos pa 'gas re ba'ang bskang*/ lo der glegs bam phyed dang bzhi tsam gyi 'dri zhus zin/ de tsam nas mtshar sdug dus kyi rgyal mos kyang ga pur tshos su btsos pa'i bgo bas phyogs kyi sa 'dzin phal cher stod g.yogs su mdzes par bklubs te/ skye 'gro kun kyang rta bdun bdag pos thugs rje'i 'od zer drod kyi reg pa can spros pa la bdag gir bgyid par gyur pas/ las byed pa rnams rang yul du des pa dang mnyam du rang nyid kyang bteg nas sga len steng du zhag mal babs nas der bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug pa dang*/ bkra shis dpal bzang pa sogs grwa pa bcu gcig tsam la dpal mgon trag shad kyi rjes gnang byas/ rang yul du slebs 'phral nas rang gi rkyen sel du seng gdong can sngon mo'i bsnyen pa zhig bsdad/ de grol mtshams nas sa dkar gyi dge slong rnams dang*/ rab bkram drung pa bstan 'dzin phun tshogs pa dang*/ rag chu dgon gyi dge slong 'ga' zhig la rdo rje gur rigs bsdus pa ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i dbang tshan pa gsum tsam dang*/ mkha' spyod skor gsum gyi byin rlabs gur mgon lha dgu gsang khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i rjes gnang dang*/ bkrag lung sogs don gnyer gyi re ba bskang*/ dge slong bsod nams legs grub pas rang bstod dgos zhes bskul ngor/ rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las gdul bya'i ngor// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum pa zhig dang*/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dgos zhes pa'i ngor/

a phreng dang ka phreng la spel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i zla ba zhes bya ba bris byin/ de dag gi skabs mtshams kun du chos 'khor chos rje rab 'byams 'phags pa ye shes pa'i dngos slob dge slong ye shes rgya mtsho bas brda sprod pa'i gzhung ka lā pa byā ka ra ṇa'i ri mo bslab grogs dgos zhes byung bar/ zhwa lu lo chen gyis mdzad pa'i cha bsags mdo'i bshad sbyar gyi 'grel pa ka ra ṭīka gi steng nas tshar gcig dang*/ slob dpon shān+ti pas mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas kyi ri mo dang bcas pa bslab pa'i grogs bgyis so// gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ba dang por bsu mis slebs/ 'bri klung gser ldan ma'i rgyun chen 'bab pa'i pha rol sing nas mkhas btsun dge ba'i bshes gnyen dpal ldan 'jam dbyangs pas 'bod du btang byung bar song*/ der tshe dpag med lha dgu pa'i dbang dang*/ ku ru kul+le'i rjes gnang*/ gur mgon lcam dral lha brgyad dang*/ gsang khrid lha dgu pa'i rjes gnang*/ de'i gsang khrid dgos gsungs kyang*/ 'gro dgos stabs kyi brel bas lung khrid kyi sgo nas brda 'phrod pa zhig byas/ de las khom skabs ma byung*/ tshur slebs pa'i 'phral du bteg nas 'ong*/ sga len steng bla ma bkra shis dpal bzang pas mar lam gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dbang bskur dgos zhes gsungs pa bsu mkhan la'ang nan tan gnang mchis pa ltar lam bar kun du sgrub thabs dang dkyil 'khor cho ga sogs dpe cha bltas shing rta thog nas blo gshar byed kyin 'ongs pas/ sga len steng du slebs pa'i phyi nyin nas 'don rung tsam byung bas/ bla ma grwa pa nyer gsum tsam la sta gon btang nas phyi nyin dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur tshar gcig grub par byas/ des rgyu rkyen byas te bla ma bkra shis dpal bzang sogs 'grogs bshes 'ga' lhan cig byed rgyus dgon der gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub mchod lo dus bzhin rgyun gnas 'dzugs pa zhig kyang byung song ngo*// lhun grub steng slebs par las tshan gzhan rnams kyang mi ring bar rim gyis 'dzom byung zhing*/

zhag gi phung po de nyid kyi gral tshes bcu drug nyin sa skyong chen po bstan pa tshe ring pa'i sku la bro 'tshal bar grub mtha' ris bral kun gyis bsgrubs pa'i zhabs brtan rkyen rtsi gang gis kyang 'tsho thabs ma rnyed par ring zhig nas gnas skabs snga pa'i dus kyis bgrod bya gang yin pa der dal gyis zhugs par gyur to// de lta na'ang bka' lung gi dgongs 'grel chen po'i chos sbyin par gyi 'phrul sgo bskrun pa'i thog mtha' bar gyi 'gan bzhes thams cad kyi gtso bo khri chen bla ma phun tshogs bstan pa'am kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i sde zhes bya ba nyid nas gnang*/ mi ring bar lha btsun phun tshogs bstan pa nyid lha sa dang sa skya dang ngor sogs kyi grwa sar rten mjal dang chos zhur bteg de'i dus kyi drung yig shes rab grags pas bskul ngor/ gzhung sa mchod yon dang*/ bkra shis lhun po'i paṇa chen dang*/ sa skya gong ma rin po che dang*/ ngor bla brang khag rnams su 'bul chen stobs pa'i gong brjod dang*/ bshad pa mdor bsdus dgos tshul gleng ba rnams bris nas bskur/ dgun ngo der ldan yul sa dkar du phyin nas dgon der tshe sgrub kyi bsnyen mtshams bcad cing bsdad/ rag chu rnam rgyal dgon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rje slob dpon pa sogs sgrub mchod pa rnams kyi ngor gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi dbang bskur nyer lnga'i tshan gcig dang*/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang dang*/ gnod sbyin beg tse lha mang gi rjes gnang rnams phul/ sa dkar gyi grwa rigs dang yul pa pho mo phal cher la jo bo lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes su gnang ba dang*/ gtsug lag khang du dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi cho gas sdom pa 'bogs tshul byas/ slar yang bsu mkhan gyis 'byor ba dang mnyam du bteg cing 'ongs nas sga len steng du nye phyogs kyi ser skya phal cher 'dus par gtsug lag khang du dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga tshar gcig phul/

lhun grub steng du 'ongs par bstan pa'i gegs chags stobs su bdo ba'i stabs kyis mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun grub grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa nyid snyun gyis zin nas/ mi ring bar ngur smrig 'chang chen po'i gzugs skur zlos pa'i gar gyis ljongs 'di'i gdul bar bya'i 'gro don re zhig rdzogs nas mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dpa' mo'i sprul pa'i ngo mtshar ltas bzang du ma'i bsu ba dang lhan cig tu 'di nas mi snang bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pas bdag sogs gdul dka'i 'gro ba rnams kyi rgyud la 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag par dngos su bstan pa'i sgo nas skyo ba bskyed pa'i mdzad pa tha ma nyid bstan no// dgongs 'grel rin po che'i 'dri zhus ni/ lo ngo phyed gsum gyi hor zla bdun pa'i nang mtshan nyid theg pa dang rig gnas skor gyi bstan bcos glegs bam brgya dang nyer brgyad bzhugs pa rnams bris zin pa byung ngo*// de mtshams nas gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud 'grel rnams 'dri ba'i nyer bsdogs su mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la gnang ba nod pa dang bar chad mi byung bar phrin las gzhol ba'i phyir/ mgon khang nub shar gnyis su bla ma dge 'dun zhib 'tshogs su bgyis pas bskang gso phrin las 'chol ba bcas mdzad du bskul ba ltar gegs sel gyi bskang gso rgyas pa dang*/ mgon khang gnyis su dge slong gsum re gsar 'phar gyi rtag 'don dang*/ zla re bzhin rnam 'joms gtor chen gnyis re rten bzhengs mthar phyin gyi bar de srid du mdzad song*/ de'i tshe bstan srung dbang po rnams la gnang ba zhu ba dang 'dod don gsol ba tshigs su bcad pa'i phreng ba snyan shal du bris nas phul/ las byed rnams la'ang rgyud 'grel gnyen po 'dri 'don byed du 'jug pa'i gsang sgrogs kyi nyes ltung dang bar chad mi 'byung ba'i ched du dmigs nas/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i rjes su gnang ba zhig byas nas rgyud 'grel 'dri zhus byed pa'i 'go tshugs so// chos tshan gyi dbu lhar yum shes phyin dang*/

pang skong phyag brgya pa nas 'byung ba'i phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo las 'byung ba'i ltung ba bshags pa'i sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga dang*/ byams pa lung bstan gyi mdo sogs las 'byung ba'i 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug dang*/ me tog bkod pa'i mdo las 'byung ba'i phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi rigs mang po dang*/ rgyud 'grel rnams la 'grel byed kyi slob dpon rags rim dang*/ yi dam chos srung gi rigs kyi sku brnyan rnams bris nas/ de rnams kyi mtshan byang la mi mchog sras dang bcas pa'i mtshan gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba ltar bris/ de dag gi dgongs mo rnams su lhun grub steng gi bla ma grwa rigs sogs don gnyer 'ga' zhig gi ngor tshe dpag med lha dgu/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang*/ 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i lha bcu gsum gyi dbang*/ nā ro mkha' spyod dang phag mo dkar mo/ gu ru drag dmar chen po mnga' bdag nyang lugs rnams kyi byin rlabs dang de'i rjes su gnang ba/ rta mgrin skyer sgang pa'i lugs/ jo bo rje'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig dzam+bha la 'brug zhon lha lnga/ bka' gdams lha bzhi/ dam pa sangs rgyas nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge ma ti'i lugs kyi 'jam dpal dkar po/ sa skya pa'i lugs kyi 'jam dpal dmar ser a ra pa tsa na/ gser chos lugs kyi 'jam dpal nag po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams pa'i yig cha ltar dang*/ rmor chen pa'i yi ge ltar rjes gnang sgom lung 'bogs pa dang*/ ye shes yon tan bzang po'i bstod sgrub kyi rig gtad/ rdo rje rnam 'joms ba ri lugs/ dme brtsegs ljang nag 'od zer can ser mo zur pa/ gnyen sgrol yan lag drug pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang*/ phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs me dbang can/
