u tsar+ya/ khang bu brtsegs pa/ phyag rdor gtum po khyung lnga/ ye shes khyung dmar po/ dus kyi 'khor lo nas gsungs pa'i khro bo rdo rje shugs/ brtan g.yo'i dug zhi bar byed pa gser chos rdo rje khyung*/ chu bur gyi nad zhi bar byed pa'i lha mo sna tshogs yum/ yang chos rgyal rigs ldan nas brgyud pa'i khyung khra/ gser chos lugs kyi khyung nag rtog pa las gsungs pa'i gza' yum gtso 'khor rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba'i rigs rnams don du gnyer ba'i rigs so so'i ngor re re la'ang lan mang du bgyis/ rdo rje 'chang bla ma bkra shis bzang po pa dang*/ nam mkha' dpal bzang pa sogs kyi ngor las kyi gshin rje rigs gsum dang dmag zor rgyal mo'i rjes gnang*/ gzhan yang gur mgon lha brgyad/ lha bcu gnyis pa dang*/ thang stong rgyal po la zhal gzigs pa'i sprin gseb ma/ mgon po khro bcu/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum/ las kyi gshin rje rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba rnams kyang bsnyen pa bskyal mkhan sogs kyi don du lan grangs mang du byas/ rdo rje gur gyi sgrub mchod pa rnams la mkha' 'gro lnga rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang bskur ba ras bris la brten pa nyer lnga'i tshan gnyis dang*/ bla ma rab 'byams pa sogs bla ma grwa rigs 'gar nā ro mkha' spyod kyi nyams khrid rgyas pa nyin bdun pa zhig dang*/ khrid yig rnam bshad skor gyi lung phal cher dang*/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i bka' 'bum po ti gsum gyi lung dang*/ gzhan yang kye rdo rje'i rnam bshad zla zer rnam bshad kyi rigs dang bsnyen thabs skor sogs nye bar mkho ba'i lung gi rigs rnams dang thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid tshem bu pa'i lugs snga phyi tshar gsum rnams dgongs mo dang skabs gsing rnams nas don gnyer so so'i ngor bgyis/ bla ma

ga zi'i phyogs nas/ rnam rgyal bzang po pas byon par gur mgon lha brgyad dang*/ zhal bzhi pa/ mgon po khro bcu rnams kyi rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos 'ga' re bshad/ dbon po stod nas mkhas btsun gyi yon tan dang ldan pa bla ma dkon mchog dpal bzang pas byon te gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dbang dang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs dang khrid bcas gsan du byon par dgongs bzhed ltar dbang tshan gcig dang khrid rgyas pa dang dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed sdom pa bcas phul/ 'dzom thog dgon nas mkhas btsun gyi yon tan rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid chos rje bstan 'dzin rdo rje byon pa la sgra mtshams spyod lnga pa'i ri mo dang*/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang bskur phul ba dang mnyam du lhun grub steng gi bla ma grwa rigs bcas la dbang tshan pa gsum bgyis/ mkhan chen sku dbon 'jam dbyangs chos kyi bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes pa dang bla ma bkra shis dpal bzang po sogs la/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs dang ku ru kul+le lha lnga'i dbang*/ gur gyi mgon po brag rdzong gi rjes gnang dang*/ phyi khrid bsrung bzlog bsad gsum gyi khrid rgyas pa dang*/ nang dang gsang ba'i brag rdzong bcas dang*/ thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang dang 'brel pa'i dmar khrid rgyas par phul nas/ de'i dmar khrid 'chad pa'i tshul gyi tho yig zhib par yi ger 'god dgos zhes gsungs pa ltar bris nas phul/ gzhan yang sngar ma gsan pa'i rjes gnang zur pa dgos gsungs pa rnams kyang phul/ de nyid la mkhan chen pa'i bka' nan phebs ltar/ sgra mdo ka lā pa byā ka ra ṇa'i ri mo kar ṭīka gi steng nas yongs rdzogs dang*/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas kyi gzhung prāstā ra/ naṣ+ṭa/ u dhiṣ+ṭa/ yang ba rtogs byed grangs rtogs byed a dh+wa bcas bslab grogs zhus/ slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung dang*/ 'grel pa dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs kyi steng nas snyan dngags me long gzhung gi khrid zhib rgyas rtsom rgyug dang bcas te bslab pa'i grogs bgyis pa snyan dngags la gsung rtsom re legs zhig byung song zhing*/

sgra gzhung gi go bab bzang tsam las sbyang bstar chen po mdzad rgyu ma byung ba 'dra snyam/ bskul ba po dag gi ngor dur khrod bdag po'i bsnyen sgrub bya tshul lung gi rgyud mang zhes bya ba dang*/ seng ge'i gdong can ma'i sgrub mchod kyi cho ga phrin las zla 'od sar pa'i pho nya/ kun rig ras bris la brten pa'i bsnyen sgrub gsal bar byed pa gtam gyi rgyud mangs/ bstod pa/ 'dod gsol/ bsngo byang 'bul yig gi rigs sogs so so'i blo dang 'tsham pa ci rigs pa'ang bris/ bar skabs de dag tu rang gzhan la pha rol gyis byad gtad yod pa lta bu'i rmi lam gyi ltas 'ga' zhig byung bar mgon khang du bskang gso brgya tshar dang*/ rang gis kyang seng gdong gi bsrung bzlog gi kha ton gzabs tshul byas shing*/ de la bstod pa bdud las rgyal ba'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba 'dod gsol dang bcas pa zhig kyang bris shing*/ sprel lo der/ sdom brtson sa skyong bla ma sku mched rnams kyi lhas bskos gser gyi shing rta'i 'phrul gyis/ e waṃ chos ldan gyi chos grwa chen po nas/ sdom gsum bstan pa'i snang byed chen po/ zla bral mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid mkhan po chen po dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po nyid mdo khams ljongs kyi skye 'gro'i skyabs gnas su spyan drangs nas mchod yon bstan srid nyi zla zung gi snang ba chen pos phyogs bral du khyab pa'i dge mtshan legs pa byung ba gang gi tshe/ mkhan chen de nyid kyi dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi me long du gang dag shar ba'i lung gis bstan pa rin po che spyi dang*/ sgos su sde dge'i 'dri mtsho bstan jus rgyas par 'gyur ba'i gegs sel dang*/ sa skyong bla ma chen po sku mched rnams kyi sku'i rkyen sel dang*/ rten bzhengs chen po'i bya ba mthar phyin 'gyur gyi gegs sel du/ mnga' 'og tu gtogs pa'i grub mtha' ris bral gyi dgon sde mtha' dag la sku rim gyi gtong sgo rgya che ba lan gnyis su dgram pa dang*/

lhun grub steng gi chos grwa 'di nyid du'ang zla ba byung ngo cog tu gtor bzlog gtor chen la sogs pa'i rkyen sel rim gro mang du bsgrubs song*/ don grub ces pa'i gnam lor sde dge bla ma phun tshogs bstan pa nyid sde dge gong ma'i bstan srid kyi khri 'phang mthon po rgyal phran la sogs pa stobs 'byor che dgu kun gyi yan lag mchog gi lan brgyar btud pa'i gnas ga la ba der/ 'khor 'das kyi yon tan che ldan 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis/ bkra shis pa'i cho ga rdzas rtags dang*/ lha mi'i yul gyi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa dag gi mdun bdar te mnga' gsol to// lo de nyid du sngags skor gyi dgongs 'grel rnams 'dri brkos bgyis pas khyi lo'i ston mjug nas po ti lnga drug ma gtogs phal cher par du bsgrubs zin pa yang*/ de dag gi bar skabs rnams nas mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang*/ sde dge'i bstan jus kyi rim gro dang lus can spyi'i bsod nams gsog pa'i rten du/ byang rdo kho mar lha khang bzhengs pa'i nang du 'jog rgyu'i gnas brtan bcu drug sogs kyi sku brnyan rnams dbus phyogs nas lha bzo ba rnams kyi bzo ba'i kha bkod dang bzo bcos rnams kyang khyod kyis byos zhes stsal ba rnams kyi ngag bkod gang lcog bgyis/ 'on kyang gtso bo thub chen nyid bzo ba'i skabs der/ ngod rang na ba'i skabs su song bas blta rgyu ma byung bar gser sku zhig sku'i dbyibs blta yul bskur ba yin yang des kyang ma phan par phyis su grub zin par bltas pa na yid 'gro 'byon legs zhig ma byung yang sor bzhag las bya thabs ma byung ba 'di ltar lags so// dgun po der sde dge'i pho brang du mtshams dam par byas nas bsdad/ sa skyong bla ma chen po nyid nas rab byung nyi ma'i chu phag gsar tshes kyi gza' skar dge ba'i nyin/ bka' lung gi dgongs 'grel chen po'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi las kyi 'gan 'degs mthar son byung ba/

de bzhin da lam dkar chag 'di'ang*/ bstan pa'i byung tshul nas brtsams te mjug bsngo ba'i bar rgyas tsam dang*/ khyad par sde dge yab mes gong ma rnams nas brtsams te da lta'i bar gyi lo rgyus rnams rgyas tsam dang bcas te khyod kyis brtsams dgos zhes pa'i bka' mchid gser gyi cod paṇa ltar lji ba bkra shis pa'i lha dar gyi gnang sbyin bcas spyi bor bcings pa yar bzlog ma spobs par ji ltar phebs don bzhin rang gis gang shes 'dri ba'i khul byas shing thugs dgongs la 'bab mi 'bab spyan 'bebs zhu gan bgyid ces gsol to// de nyid gza' skar legs pa nas shis brjod kyi thog drangs par 'dri ba'i 'go tshugs/ de nas bzung ste 'dri ba'i khul bgyis par/ dkar chag gi stod cha tsam grub pa'i skabs der/ rang gzhan dag gi rmi lam du byad gtad yod pa 'dra ba 'ga' zhig byung ba dang*/ mi ring bar grib gdon gyi gnod pas rkyen pa'i nad gzhi che tsam byung bar/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong bar cir 'gyur zhus par/ rje btsun dam pa de nyid nas dbang khrus kyi rim pa mang du stsal ba dang*/ sa skyong bla ma chen por zhu dag bla ma bro 'tshal gyi gzhi che ba dang*/ brtag pa bgyi ba'i tshul sogs kyi gsung bkod stsal 'phral nyid nas/ par khang nas ja khor drug brgyad cu blangs nas lcags ra dgon dang*/ dpal spungs dang*/ dpal yul/ ka thog sna 'brang mgo zul rgyud dgon khag gsum sogs su tshe chog tshe sgrub/ badz+ra gu ru dang*/ seng gdong ma'i bsnyen pa dung phyur sogs kyi rten du bskur/ dgon chen 'di nyid du'ang sbyin sreg bcu tshar tsam/ bskang gso/ 'jigs byed drug cu'i gtor bzlog sogs kyi rkyen sel mang du bsgrubs song ba/ 'tsho byed pa 'gru tshe bh+rūm̐ pa'i slob rgyud 'dzin pa'i gsang sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod lhur len pa gzungs skyabs zhes sman dpyad gang zab mdzad pa bcas rim gyis je bder song bas/

dkar chag bri 'phro rnams kyang 'dri ba'i tshul bgyis pas/ shing byi'i hor lugs kyi zhag gi phung po bdun pa'i mtha' tsam nas bris grub pa dang*/ sa skyong bla ma nyid la gzigs 'bul du btang bar/ de nyid yon mchod nas kyang zhib gzigs gnang mthar rang gis yid la gang bsam ltar tshang ba'i shin tu legs pa zhig byung 'dug pas/ par gzhi myur du 'dri chog par bka' stsal/ slar par mkhan rnams la dgram du nye ba'i skabs der/ lnga rig chos kyi snang byed chen po si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas pa nyid rgyal khab 'dir chibs bsgyur gnang ba dang stabs 'grigs byung ba na/ sa skyong bla ma chen po nyid nas/ de nyid kyi spyan sngar yang gzigs 'bul du btang ba na'ang gzigs pas phab ste legs po byung 'dug pa'i bka' stsal phebs/ de 'phral nyid nas par brkos rnams la bkram nas mi 'gyang bar par du bkod grub pa byung ngo*// gang gi tshe rngul mda' dgon nas dgongs 'grel rin po che'i zhu dag dang dkar chag bcas mthar son dge ba byung ba'i legs gsol du kho bo gtsug lag khang du bos nas bla ma chos khrims grwa mang sogs nas so so nas mdun 'jog legs par stsal bar/ der bzhugs kun la grub thob thang stong rgyal po nas brgyud pa'i tshe sgrub kyi dbang zhig phul nas bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs zhus so// thag lung dgon gyi bla ma kun dga' rnam rgyal dang*/ 'khri 'du lho drung sku skye dang*/ chos rje tshul khrims dbang phyug dbu mdzad dkon lhun pa rnams dang*/ dgon sde 'di phyogs nas ldan yul bar gyi don gnyer snga phyi rnams kyi ngor/ lam 'bras lugs kyi nyams len pa zhes byed pa rnams la dgos gal che ba'i lus sbyong rgyas bsdus dang phrin las so gnyis kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi lag len rnams kyang slob dpon nas lag khrid du ji ltar mnos pa ltar bslab pa'i grogs bgyis/ phyi lor sa skyong bla ma phun tshogs bstan pas/

par khang rnying pa la brtan nas dgongs 'grel rin po che'i par gyi tshogs rnams bzhugs su gsol ba'i gtsug lag khang bcas rgya bskyed cing gsar bskrun mdzad song ba'i nang gi lha ris rnams 'dri ba'i mgo tshugs pa na/ mchod yon zung nas 'dri rgyu'i lha bkod kyi bka' lung bkod sbyar gnang ba dang bcas te/ logs bris kyi gtso bo ni sngar gyi las 'phro lta bur song bas khyod kyis 'di dgos zhes stsal ba ltar dbus kyi gtso chen ston mchog thub dbang bdud 'dul phyag rgya can bdag gis 'dri rgyu dang*/ gzhan rnams dpal yul ba dang karma lha steng pa sogs lha ris pa dpon g.yog mang du bsags te/ thams cad kyi zhal bkod gtso bor sa skyong bla ma nyid bzo gnas phal cher la ring nas sbyangs pa lta bu'i goms 'dris che ba la shin tu thugs dgyes bzod par dka' bar brten/ de nyid nas bka' gang stsal ltar dang*/ nang sgos su bzo bcos gang dgos kyi kha ta ba dang lhan cig bcas phyi nang kun du 'dri khyon che ba mchis na'ang gegs med du mthar son pa byung ngo*// de'i dkar chag chos 'byung bkra shis sgo mang rten dang brten par bcas pa bskrun pa las brtsams pa'i gleng ba bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng zhes bya ba bcas rnams mthar son gyi zhabs 'degs bsgrubs/ dgun bor ldan yul la bteg nas mtshams bsnyen byas bsdad/ lcags lug lo'i hor zla tshes la chos sde'i lha khang rnying pa rnams arga'i cho gas gshegs gsol gyi cho ga byed dgos zer ba ltar phyin/ nged rang dang bla ma bzang po bkra shis chos sde dbu mdzad dpal ldan 'jam dbyangs sogs kyis bgyis nas/ lha khang rnying pa bshigs shul du gsar pa gtsug lag khang sku mtshams la bzhugs pas mi bzhugs pa ma gtogs pa sngar bzhugs pa rnams dang bcas pas bsgrubs so// de nas las byed 'u lag pa mang po lhan cig las pas ston ka nas gtsug lag khang pho brang dang bcas pa'i che las grub 'dug

de dag gi skabs su nged rang sa dkar du mtshams la bsdad yod par/ lcags lug lo'i ston mjug tu sde dge bla ma chen po sngar gyi snyun gzhi yod pa de sku rim rkyen bsgyur cis kyang ma bzlog par bstan 'gro spyi sgos kyi gegs chag stobs su bdo bas sku gshegs song ba'i bang chen a bsod can btang byung bar 'phral du bteg 'ongs par 'dir dgung lnga pa'i steng du sleb 'dug par/ phyi nyin nas brtsams te dgung zhe dgu rdzogs pa'i bar du ngan song sbyong ba kun rig gi cho ga phyir bzlog dbang bskur bcas dang cho ga tshar rkyang re 'don pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrubs/ bkra shis ltem nas rje mo tshe ring lags 'das pa'i stong chog gi tshogs dbur phyin cing cho ga phyir bzlog dbang bskur bsngo ba smon lam bcas pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrubs/ de dag gi bar skabs rnams nas kyang*/ rdo rje gur gyi sgrub mchod slob dpon bsod nams rin chen pa sogs sgrub mchod rnams la gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang bskur tshan pa gnyis dang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa lugs kyi dbang tshan pa gnyis/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang tshan pa gnyis/ 'dam thog dgon nas chos rje bstan 'dzin rdo rje pa sogs la gshed dmar gyi dbang tshan pa gsum/ dbon stod nas byon pa'i bla ma dkon mchog dpal bzang po'i ngor/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dbang dang*/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs sngon du 'gro ba'i nyams khrid rgyas pa dang*/ bde mchog dril bu lugs kyi dbang sogs phul/ skyor mda' nas bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug pas byon par rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i dbang dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa spyan ras gzigs lha bcu dgu'i dbang rnams phul/ gzhan yang dgon chen la nā ro mkha' spyod kyi nyams khrid dang*/ thugs rje chen po tshem bu lugs kyi smar khrid snga phyir lan gsum dang*/ gur gyi mgon po brag rdzong ma'i phyi khrid srung bzlog bsad gsum dang*/

nang khrid drag po sngags rgod dang gsang khrid sems nyid ye shes kyi rtsal 'don bcas kyi nyams khrid dang*/ gsang khrid thun mong ma yin pa rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten pa lha dgu'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor/ mthar las mkhan myang 'das kyis bsdus nas gsang rten lus sba dang bcas pa'i khrid rnams rang rang gi rjes gnang sngon du 'gro ba bcas rnams snga phyir tshar gsum tsam dang*/ brag yag nas byon pa'i bla ma dga' ldan pas mtshon pa'i dgon 'dir bzhugs pa'i bla ma dge slong bcu bdun tsam la dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga'i gsung rab po ti bcu drug gi lung dang*/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen pa'i bka' 'bum po ti gcig dang*/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i bka' 'bum po ti gsum dang*/ dpal ldan don grub pa'i bka' 'bum po ti gcig nā ro mkha' spyod sogs mkha' spyod skor gsum gyi po ti dang*/ gur mgon po ti me 'bar ma dang*/ yang skong po ti/ dpal mgon zhal gyi po ti dang*/ ha la nag po'i be bum/ beg tse'i be bum rnams kyi lung yang don gnyer snga phyi so so'i g.yar khral du 'don ci thub bgyis pa dang*/ sa skya'i phur pa bla ma dang*/ chos rje bstan 'dzin rdo rje/ mkhas btsun kun dga' rgya mtsho pa sogs dgon pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ zur mang nas kun khyab par byon nas mtshon bde mchog bong zhal can gyi dbang tshar gnyis dang*/ bya rgyud rigs gsum spyi dbang*/ chos rje bstan 'dzin rdo rje par sogs la spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal lha mangs kyi dbang 'bul ba dang*/ gzhan yang a li chos rje dang*/ ga zi phyogs nas byon pa'i piṣ+pa bla ma sogs dang*/ hor brag mgo ma zur la sogs pa phyogs nas byon pa dang*/ 'dir gnyug mar bzhugs pa sogs don gnyer sna tshogs kyi mos pa mthun pa'i dbang bka' rjes gnang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs dang*/ byin rlabs bklag lung gi rigs gang dgos don du gnyer ba rnams la sman 'dogs gang 'grub dang*/

mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong pa'i zhal snga nas bka' stsal phebs bzhin bla ma rab dkar lhun grub pa la snyan dngags me long gi rgyan gyi khrod rtsom rgyug len pa bcas dang*/ brda sprod pa'i gzhung ka lā pa'i ri mo rdzogs par 'dri ba dang*/ sdeb sbyor gyi ri mo bcas bslab pa'i grogs bgyis/ mkhar nang ba'i dbon po skal bzang par snyan dngags me long gzhung le'u gnyis pa'i rgyan gyi 'gro yul bslab pa rtsom rgyug len par bcas pa bgyis/ lcags rta lor mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong bas karma lha steng gi lha ris pa lha dga' can spun rnams bos nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing gi zhal thang 'dri ba'i ma dpe/ si tu rin po che nas phyag bkod gnang ba g.yar po zhus nas 'dri ba'i tshe yang*/ gtso bor ma dpe ltar yin na'ang*/ ri mo bzang ngan sogs ci 'gyur gyi lta rtogs ngag bkod bcas pa khyod kyis gyis la 'drir chug ces stsal ba ltar/ zhib bltas bgyis pas mgyogs las sogs su ma song ba legs rab byung song*/ de bzhin du tshe bh+rūm̐ pa nas ma phyi g.yar po zhus pa'i slob dpon dpa' bo dang*/ chos rje rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bsdoms pa'i skyes rabs brgya rtsa grags pa dang*/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi rtogs brjod sngar nas bkod pa'i shog dpe gzhir bzhag la rtogs brjod kyi yi ge dang mthun pa'i ngag bkod kyis bzo bcos kyang cung zad bgyis shing*/ der med pa'i dge bsnyen dharma tā dang*/ ha shang gi bkod pa gsar bskrun bcas bris pas legs rab zhig byung song zhing*/ de skabs shig nas chos sde'i gtsug lag khang gi ldeb ris dang lder bzo rnams kyi 'go 'dzugs chog par yod pa'i zhu 'bul bgyid pas 'byor byung bar/ mchod yon bka' bgros kyis bkod pa stsal pa/ da lam ldan phyogs kyi sa mdor sde dge tshang gi rten bzhengs byed pa legs po zhig ma byung na rnam par dpyod ldan rnams kyis dpyas gdags pa'i yul du 'gyur dogs pas/

'di nas lha dga' spun rnams kyang ri mo par btang dgos yod pa bcas bris 'bur kun gyi zhal ta par khyod 'gro dgos zhes bka' phebs gnang ba ltar ldan chos sder phyin/ chu sprel lo'i hor zla bzhi pa'i nyer brgyad la karma lha steng pa'i lha dpon tshe dbang rig 'dzin dpon g.yog rnams kyis gtsang khang dbus kyi thub chen sku brnyan bzo bar bskos nas ra shing dang nang gzungs bcings/ dbus kyi e pha'i lder bzo ba tshe brtan can gyis gnas brtan gyi sku brnyan bzo ba rnams kyi 'go brtsams/ snron zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig nas logs bris kyi dbu pa lha dga' dang sde dgon ye shes blo gros gnyis bkod de ldan phyogs na yod pa rnams dang kar shod pa'i lha ris pa bcas khyon ri mo pa nyi shu dang tshon/ tshon mdangs pa nyer gsum sogs dang bcas te mgo brtsams/ gtso bo thub chen sku bris 'bur gnyis ka'i cha tshad gzhung gi dgongs pa sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa'i lugs kyi thig 'debs kyi grogs bgyid pa sogs/ bris 'bur mkhan kun gyi bkod pa bzo bcos bcas kho bo cag gis ci nus kyi grogs ldan sgo nas 'bad rtsol gyis bskrun pas gtsug lag khang dang dri gtsang khang rgya mthongs bcas dang*/ mgon po'i bzhugs khang dang*/ lam 'bras brgyud rim bzhugs khang gi ldeb bris bcas dang*/ lder bzo ba rnams kyis dri gtsang gi gtso bo thub chen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi sku dang*/ g.yas g.yon du sangs rgyas byams pa dang tshe dpag med de/ lha chen gsum dang gnas brtan bzhugs pa'i brag ri'i bkod pa bcas dang*/ mgon khang du rdo rje gur gyi mgon po thog tshad gcig dang*/ yum chen lha mo/ bram gzugs rnams mi tshad re las mgon sogs gzhan rnams mi tshad chung tsam bcas te 'dri bzo'i bya ba thams cad hor zla dgu pa'i nyer dgu nas mthar phyin pa byung ngo*// de nas rten bzhengs mthar phyin pa'i bya ba rab tu gnas pa'ang*/

rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ gang du sku gzugs rdzogs pa la// byin ma brlabs par ring gnas na// de las bkra mi shis 'byung zhing*// ji srid mchod pa der mi 'os// zhes gsungs pa gtsor bzung nas zla ba de nyid kyi tshes bcu gnyis nas brtsams te/ kho bo cag dang dgon pa zung gi bla ma dge slong bsnyen song gang yod bsdoms pas/ gtsug lag khang du kye rdo rje la brten pa'i rab tu gnas pa bzang po drug ldan gyi cho ga nyin gsum pa rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa'i mthar sbyin bdag bsgo ba'i tshe/ lha bzo ba rnams dang der las kyi 'brel thogs pa phal cher dang bcas la tsā ru'i bza' ba 'o thug gi dga' ston bcas bstab nas yon bshad dang 'brel ba'i bsngo ba smon lam rgyas pa dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshogs mtha' brgyan par byas so// lam 'bras khang du'ang nyin gsum pa zhig mtha' bzhi pa'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa bsgrubs/ slar yang zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu dgur mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong pa nyid slob dpon bzang por bzhugs pa'i kye rdo rje la brten pa'i rab gnas nyin gsum du bdag dang*/ bla ma rin chen lhun grub/ rab bkram bstan 'dzin phun tshogs pa sogs/ rag co chos sde'i dge slong bsnyen song gang dag bzhugs pa dang lhan cig pas/ kye rdo rje la brten pa'i rab gnas nyin gsum pa dang*/ mgon khang du rab gnas nyin gang ba zhig mdzad do// mdor na rten gsum lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi mchod skyin rjed par bya ba'i yul mchog tu nges par grub bo// de mtshams sa dkar du re zhig bsdad de/ lo gsar nang du mkhan chen sga stod nas phebs pa dang mnyam du lhun grub steng 'ongs/ sa skyong lcam dral nas tsan+dan mchod rten cha brgyad kyi khang steng 'khri shing khang pa gsar bcos mdzad pa'i nang du/ dpag bsam 'khri shing gi bkod pa 'dri ba'i ngag bkod par dgos tshul gyi bka' stsal phebs pa de bzhin sgrub par gsol nas/

lha dpon smad shod a 'phel can dang*/ 'phel kho pa/ rgya tshan phyogs kyi lha ris pa tshe dbang 'phel dpon g.yog dang*/ karma'i lha bzo dang*/ dpal yul ba'i lha bzo bcas te/ gtso bo ston mchog de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ sor mo brgya dang nyer lnga pa'i lugs kyi thig 'debs dang*/ sku tshugs kyi ri mo'i 'gro sul sol ris kho bos brgyab grogs byas nas lha dpon a 'phel la 'drir bcug 'khor rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi bkod pa'i thang kha'i phyi mo dpal spungs nas g.yar pho gnang byung ba'i steng nas 'dri bar brtsam mo// lha ris gsum bzhi tsam min pa phal cher
